# Phase 8R-1: Stops of Pine's Own and Field Research: Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** The first plan of reports at stops (design `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-21-stop-reports-design.md`, sections 3, 4, 6, 7, 9; Gantt phase 17). In detail:

- **Stops of Pine's own:** staff's `/pokestop add|edit|remove` for sponsored stops Wayfarer lacks, per server, "Add anyway?" within 30 m of a known stop; `WayspotDirectory` holds them as `pine-<id>` beside the imported stops, so every stop search finds them; the Wayfarer import's preview names those within 30 m of an imported stop.
- **The task list** from Leek Duck's research page (`settings.research`, always on, defaults for every key): parsed into tasks with encounter, item and Mega Energy rewards, the last good list kept in the database, a much smaller read taken only when a second read agrees or the list is out of date.
- **Research periods** from ScrapedDuck's events feed (`extraData.generic.hasFieldResearchTasks`), the events kept in the database: the day (to midnight); an intra-day event's window, after which the day's reports come back; a big event's daily windows; a multi-day event, a rotation at its start and end and **a period per local day between** (Matt, 2026-10-22). A feed without the flags keeps what is stored.
- **`/research report task: stop: [stop2..5:] [reward:]`** and **`/research remove stop:`**: one report per stop and period, the latest replacing the earlier one (a fresh id, so an old answer never acts on the new report); the private answer with "Same task at more stops…" and Take back; free-text tasks with an optional reward; the throttle of 10 in 30 minutes.
- **The pinned post "Today at the stops"**, one per region channel and day, research grouped by task, up to three messages, redrawn at midnight, at an event's boundary, on a change of the events and at start; plain text without embeds; none in rehearsal mode; Pin Messages an optional permission.
- **`/want target:`** without `type`: a Pokémon or form opens a dialog of checkboxes (Raids, Dynamax, Gigantamax, Spawns, Research, Shadow; only those that can happen; pre-ticked), a tier Raids / Shadow raids; items and Mega Energy of the task list as targets. **`TargetWant`** keeps the Research, Dynamax and Gigantamax boxes and the reward targets. `maxWantsFiring` reads the Dynamax and Gigantamax boxes: **a species want no longer covers max battles** (changes the max-battles design's decision 6).
- **Research DMs:** one per report and region channel, linking to the pinned message holding the task, never twice for a task at a stop in a period; a second DM names only stops added later.

**Not in 8R-1:** `/rocket`, the lineups, grunt messages, hideouts, Rocket wants (8R-2); the map (8R-3).

**Architecture:**

- **Domain:** `src/domain/research/` (tasks, the Leek Duck page parser, stop reports, Pine stops), `src/domain/time/research-events.ts` and `research-periods.ts` (`periodAt`, `nextPeriodChange`), `src/domain/pogo/want-boxes.ts`, `src/domain/notify/target-wants.ts`.
- **Storage:** migration `2026_10_21_026_stop_reports` (`PineStop`, `StopReport` unique per server, stop, kind and period, `ResearchEvent`, `StopPost`, `TargetWant`, `ResearchTask`), a repository and an in-memory twin each, shared cases.
- **Services:** `PineStopService`, `ResearchTaskService`, `RaidEventService`'s research events and `onResearchChange`, `StopReportService`, `StopPostService` (one queue per channel), `NotifyService.researchReported`; `PartyGateway.pinMessage` / `unpinMessage`.
- **Discord:** `src/commands/stops/pokestop.ts`, `src/commands/research/`, `/want`'s dialog and Submit (`wantbox`), `src/render/research.ts` and `stop-post.ts`.

**Tech Stack:** TypeScript 6.0, Node 24, discord.js v14, Vitest. No new dependency. **Migration 026** (typescript-migration ends at 025, `wayfarer` at 024; first merge wins). **Commands change** (`/pokestop` and `/research` new; `/want` loses `type`): deploy the commands again before staging. **Pin Messages** is a new optional permission of region channels.

**Spec:** the design above (section 4.2 and answer 6 updated with Matt's per-day rule in this plan's commit), the brief `.superpowers/sdd/8r-1-research/design.md` and its ledger (git-ignored).

**Every diff in this plan was run before the plan was written**, on a throwaway branch (`proto-8r1`, tip `4321ab48`, tag `proto-8r1-r2`), one commit per task, on `stop-reports` 053e5c89. Each commit typechecks and its unit tests pass; on the tip the full check (8,512 tests), the build and the database suite (550) are clean.

**Reviews:** two Opus reviewers went through the prototype, one on storage, periods, the parser and the services, one on the commands, `/want`'s dialog, the notifier and the renderers (six Important: a replaced report kept its id, so an old answer's Take back or menu acted on the new report; the midnight turn deleted posts without drawing them; a real shrink of the task list was refused for good; events cancelled before their start were kept; `/want` had lost its deferral; fifteen Minor), then Matt's per-day rule for multi-day events, then a fix review (three Minor: a feed without research flags forgot the stored events; a DM's link waited for every region's redraw; Take back's wording for a replaced report), then Claude's rule for `/want`'s choices (rewards at most five places). Every finding is in the commits below.

## Decisions in this plan

Made while prototyping and reviewing, for Matt to look at:

1. **`/research` has subcommands** `report` and `remove`: Discord takes no options beside subcommands.
2. **Multi-day research events** (Matt, 2026-10-22): a rotation at the start and end, a period per local day between (`event:<id>:<date>`); daily windows only for the big events (`BIG_EVENT_TYPES`), whose days are intra-day windows with the day's research coming back.
3. **One DM per report and region channel:** a report whose stops lie in two posted regions sends one DM per region, each linking to that region's post; a stop in both is named once.
4. **"Same task at more stops…"** counts in `/research report`'s window (the throttle's `as`, the limit from the settings), answers in a message of its own with its own Take back, and gives the use back when the report has ended.
5. **The told-once record of research DMs** is in memory, like max battles' quiet hour: a restart may repeat a DM.
6. **`/want`'s choices:** Pokémon, forms, tiers and IVs first; items and Mega Energy fill what is left, at most five places when the Pokémon fill the list. The design's "today's rewards first" is not built (follow-up).
7. **The pinned post** says "Nothing reported right now." when everything is taken back, until its day ends; `/pokestop remove` asks nothing (reports keep their snapshot).
8. **`/settings show`** counts `/wants`' lines across both tables (one more read; its round-trip limit 5 → 6).
9. **Leek Duck's event tasks** (design 4.1's open item) cannot be watched before 2026-11-09: nothing built for event pages; a missing task is typed. Follow-ups say what to check on 2026-11-09 and 2026-11-21.

- Read `CLAUDE.md` first. Its hard rules apply: never push, never start the bot or contact Discord, never edit legacy JS. Never read, print or stage `.env`.

- `src/domain/` stays pure. Tests never use the network and never wait on real time (`docs/architecture/testing.md`).
- Each task carries the full diff of the prototype commit it transcribes (branch `proto-8r1`). Apply it exactly; the task's Step 4 diff must print nothing before the task is committed. Apply the diffs with `git apply`, never retype them.
- A task needs the typecheck and its own tests green. The full `npm run check`, the build and `npm run test:db` run after the last task, through the npm scripts (the suite lock), one at a time. Run `npx prettier --write` on touched files.
- Commit after every task as `Matt Legowski <googer@pobox.com>`, with the trailer `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`. Stage by explicit path, never `.idea/`, `var/`, `.superpowers/` or `.env`. No commit title starts with a slash.

## Review Focus

1. **Existing wants are unchanged** but for max battles: a raid scope means raids only, the shadow row and the legacy `!wants` codec as before; a species want no longer brings max battles.
2. **The stop report store:** one report per server, stop, kind and period, decided inside a transaction; a replaced report gets a new id; no Discord call under a lock.
3. **Periods** on the recorded events: midnight, an intra-day window and what comes back, a multi-day event's days, big events, DST days, a feed without flags.
4. **The pinned post's queue:** one per channel, the midnight turn and start, the limits of a message, rehearsal mode.
5. **Migration 026** additive and guarded; the indexes the dialog and the notifier read by.

### Task 1: 8R-1 task 1: reports at stops in the database, migration 026

Prototype commit: `c6714ccd7bca5761d74c3e294c78653802fa80e3`

One migration for the plan: PineStop (stops of Pine's own, per server),
StopReport (a report at a stop of a kind and a research period, unique per
server, stop, kind and period, the stop as a snapshot), ResearchEvent (the
feed's events with field research, as last seen), StopPost (the pinned post
of a region channel and day), TargetWant (wants by token on the member's
User and Guild rows, unique per member and token, indexed by token) and
ResearchTask (the last good task list, as the raid bosses are kept).

Each table has its repository, a twin in memory and cases both run; the
TargetWant test checks that the dialog's read of one member's targets and
the notifier's read by target go by their keys. The domain types they keep:
research tasks and their rewards (task keys and item keys), stop reports,
stops of Pine's own, research events and the TargetWant tokens with their
Stop-button arguments.

diff --git a/src/db/repositories/pine-stop-repository.ts b/src/db/repositories/pine-stop-repository.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..6e36be2533a4edf8b438bc73e940126fa3d83527
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/db/repositories/pine-stop-repository.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,118 @@
+import type { Kysely, Selectable } from 'kysely';
+import type { NewPineStop, PineStop, PineStopChange } from '../../domain/stops/pine-stop.js';
+import { inTransaction } from '../transaction.js';
+import type { DB, PineStop as PineStopRow } from '../types.js';
+
+/**
+ * The stops of Pine's own (plan 8R-1; table `PineStop` of migration 026): what `/pokestop`
+ * writes and `PineStopDirectory` holds in memory. Its twin in memory is `MemoryPineStops`
+ * (`test/support/pine-stops.ts`); both run `pineStopCases`.
+ */
+export interface PineStopStorage {
+  /** Every stop of every server, by id. */
+  all(): Promise<PineStop[]>;
+  add(stop: NewPineStop): Promise<PineStop>;
+  /** Changes a stop of a server; undefined when it has none of that id. */
+  update(
+    id: number,
+    serverId: string,
+    change: PineStopChange,
+    by: string,
+    at: number,
+  ): Promise<PineStop | undefined>;
+  /** Removes a stop of a server; gives it, or undefined when it has none of that id. */
+  remove(id: number, serverId: string): Promise<PineStop | undefined>;
+}
+
+function toStop(row: Selectable<PineStopRow>): PineStop {
+  return {
+    id: row.id,
+    serverId: row.serverId,
+    name: row.name,
+    lat: row.lat,
+    lon: row.lon,
+    address: row.address,
+    createdBy: row.createdBy,
+    createdAt: Number(row.createdAt),
+    updatedBy: row.updatedBy,
+    updatedAt: Number(row.updatedAt),
+  };
+}
+
+/** The `PineStop` table. */
+export class PineStopRepository implements PineStopStorage {
+  constructor(private readonly db: Kysely<DB>) {}
+
+  async all(): Promise<PineStop[]> {
+    const rows = await this.db.selectFrom('PineStop').selectAll().orderBy('id').execute();
+    return rows.map(toStop);
+  }
+
+  async add(stop: NewPineStop): Promise<PineStop> {
+    const made = await this.db
+      .insertInto('PineStop')
+      .values({
+        serverId: stop.serverId,
+        name: stop.name,
+        lat: stop.lat,
+        lon: stop.lon,
+        address: stop.address,
+        createdBy: stop.createdBy,
+        createdAt: String(stop.createdAt),
+        updatedBy: stop.createdBy,
+        updatedAt: String(stop.createdAt),
+      })
+      .executeTakeFirstOrThrow();
+    return {
+      ...stop,
+      id: Number(made.insertId),
+      updatedBy: stop.createdBy,
+      updatedAt: stop.createdAt,
+    };
+  }
+
+  update(
+    id: number,
+    serverId: string,
+    change: PineStopChange,
+    by: string,
+    at: number,
+  ): Promise<PineStop | undefined> {
+    return inTransaction(this.db, async (trx) => {
+      const found = await trx
+        .selectFrom('PineStop')
+        .select('id')
+        .where('id', '=', id)
+        .where('serverId', '=', serverId)
+        .forUpdate()
+        .executeTakeFirst();
+      if (!found) return undefined;
+      await trx
+        .updateTable('PineStop')
+        .set({ ...change, updatedBy: by, updatedAt: String(at) })
+        .where('id', '=', id)
+        .execute();
+      const row = await trx
+        .selectFrom('PineStop')
+        .selectAll()
+        .where('id', '=', id)
+        .executeTakeFirstOrThrow();
+      return toStop(row);
+    });
+  }
+
+  remove(id: number, serverId: string): Promise<PineStop | undefined> {
+    return inTransaction(this.db, async (trx) => {
+      const row = await trx
+        .selectFrom('PineStop')
+        .selectAll()
+        .where('id', '=', id)
+        .where('serverId', '=', serverId)
+        .forUpdate()
+        .executeTakeFirst();
+      if (!row) return undefined;
+      await trx.deleteFrom('PineStop').where('id', '=', id).execute();
+      return toStop(row);
+    });
+  }
+}
diff --git a/src/db/repositories/research-event-repository.ts b/src/db/repositories/research-event-repository.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..9143f703d3034829d9edbd82d8e895cde4de87ed
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/db/repositories/research-event-repository.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,67 @@
+import { sql, type Kysely } from 'kysely';
+import type { ResearchEvent } from '../../domain/time/research-events.js';
+import type { DB } from '../types.js';
+
+/**
+ * The events with field research of their own, as last seen in the events feed (plan 8R-1;
+ * design 9.2; table `ResearchEvent` of migration 026): a restart, or an event dropped from the
+ * feed once it ended, cannot lose a period. Twin `MemoryResearchEvents`
+ * (`test/support/research-events.ts`), both running `researchEventCases`.
+ */
+export interface ResearchEventStorage {
+  /** Every event kept, in order of their start. */
+  all(): Promise<ResearchEvent[]>;
+  /**
+   * Keeps what a read of the feed saw, each event as the feed has it now (it may move one), in
+   * one statement; `at` is when it was read. An event kept before and not seen now stays.
+   */
+  saveSeen(events: readonly ResearchEvent[], at: number): Promise<void>;
+  /** Forgets the events that ended before `before`; gives how many. */
+  removeEnded(before: number): Promise<number>;
+}
+
+/** The `ResearchEvent` table. */
+export class ResearchEventRepository implements ResearchEventStorage {
+  constructor(private readonly db: Kysely<DB>) {}
+
+  async all(): Promise<ResearchEvent[]> {
+    const rows = await this.db
+      .selectFrom('ResearchEvent')
+      .selectAll()
+      .orderBy('startsAt')
+      .orderBy('eventId')
+      .execute();
+    return rows.map((row) => ({
+      id: row.eventId,
+      name: row.name,
+      eventType: row.eventType,
+      start: Number(row.startsAt),
+      end: Number(row.endsAt),
+    }));
+  }
+
+  async saveSeen(events: readonly ResearchEvent[], at: number): Promise<void> {
+    if (events.length === 0) return;
+    const values = sql.join(
+      events.map(
+        (event) =>
+          sql`(${event.id}, ${event.name}, ${event.eventType}, ${String(event.start)},
+            ${String(event.end)}, ${String(at)}, ${String(at)})`,
+      ),
+    );
+    // MySQL's row alias (`AS new`), never `VALUES()`, deprecated since 8.0.20.
+    await sql`
+      insert into ResearchEvent (eventId, name, eventType, startsAt, endsAt, firstSeen, lastSeen)
+      values ${values} as new
+      on duplicate key update name = new.name, eventType = new.eventType,
+        startsAt = new.startsAt, endsAt = new.endsAt, lastSeen = new.lastSeen`.execute(this.db);
+  }
+
+  async removeEnded(before: number): Promise<number> {
+    const gone = await this.db
+      .deleteFrom('ResearchEvent')
+      .where('endsAt', '<', String(before))
+      .executeTakeFirst();
+    return Number(gone.numDeletedRows);
+  }
+}
diff --git a/src/db/repositories/research-repositories.db.test.ts b/src/db/repositories/research-repositories.db.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..f93fd34250443f93fab7b81cc61e7c499b665d09
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/db/repositories/research-repositories.db.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,92 @@
+import type { Kysely } from 'kysely';
+import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import { lastWarnings } from '../../../test/support/mysql-warnings.js';
+import { startMigratedDatabase } from '../../../test/support/migrated-db.js';
+import { pineStopCases } from '../../../test/support/pine-stop-cases.js';
+import {
+  INTO_THE_WILD,
+  listedTask,
+  researchEventCases,
+  researchTaskCases,
+  stopPostCases,
+} from '../../../test/support/research-store-cases.js';
+import type { DB } from '../types.js';
+import { PineStopRepository } from './pine-stop-repository.js';
+import { ResearchEventRepository } from './research-event-repository.js';
+import { ResearchTaskRepository } from './research-task-repository.js';
+import { StopPostRepository } from './stop-post-repository.js';
+
+/** The smaller tables of plan 8R-1: stops of Pine's own, pinned posts, research events, tasks. */
+describe('the repositories of reports at stops', () => {
+  let stop: () => Promise<void>;
+  let db: Kysely<DB>;
+
+  beforeAll(async () => {
+    ({ db, stop } = await startMigratedDatabase());
+  });
+  afterAll(async () => {
+    await stop();
+  });
+
+  describe('PineStopRepository', () => {
+    pineStopCases(async () => {
+      await db.deleteFrom('PineStop').execute();
+      return new PineStopRepository(db);
+    });
+  });
+
+  describe('StopPostRepository', () => {
+    stopPostCases(async () => {
+      await db.deleteFrom('StopPost').execute();
+      return new StopPostRepository(db);
+    });
+
+    it('draws no warning of MySQL as it keeps a post again', async () => {
+      await db.deleteFrom('StopPost').execute();
+      const store = new StopPostRepository(db);
+      const post = {
+        channelId: '1',
+        day: '2026-10-21',
+        serverId: '2',
+        messageIds: [],
+        updatedAt: 1,
+      };
+      await store.save(post);
+      expect(await lastWarnings(db, (trx) => new StopPostRepository(trx).save(post))).toEqual([]);
+    });
+  });
+
+  describe('ResearchEventRepository', () => {
+    researchEventCases(async () => {
+      await db.deleteFrom('ResearchEvent').execute();
+      return new ResearchEventRepository(db);
+    });
+
+    it('draws no warning of MySQL as it keeps an event again', async () => {
+      await db.deleteFrom('ResearchEvent').execute();
+      const store = new ResearchEventRepository(db);
+      await store.saveSeen([INTO_THE_WILD], 1);
+      expect(
+        await lastWarnings(db, (trx) =>
+          new ResearchEventRepository(trx).saveSeen([INTO_THE_WILD], 2),
+        ),
+      ).toEqual([]);
+    });
+  });
+
+  describe('ResearchTaskRepository', () => {
+    researchTaskCases(async () => {
+      await db.deleteFrom('ResearchTask').execute();
+      return new ResearchTaskRepository(db);
+    });
+
+    it('draws no warning of MySQL as it keeps a list again', async () => {
+      await db.deleteFrom('ResearchTask').execute();
+      const tasks = [listedTask('Make 2 Excellent Throws')];
+      await new ResearchTaskRepository(db).replace(tasks, 1);
+      expect(
+        await lastWarnings(db, (trx) => new ResearchTaskRepository(trx).replace(tasks, 2)),
+      ).toEqual([]);
+    });
+  });
+});
diff --git a/src/db/repositories/research-task-repository.ts b/src/db/repositories/research-task-repository.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..4b7b90d66d95b2f930baa5be6e0835f730cd9e4b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/db/repositories/research-task-repository.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,88 @@
+import { sql, type Kysely } from 'kysely';
+import type { ResearchTask } from '../../domain/research/task.js';
+import type { Logger } from '../../log.js';
+import { inTransaction } from '../transaction.js';
+import type { DB } from '../types.js';
+import { rewardsDocument } from './stop-report-repository.js';
+
+/** The last good task list, and when it was read (undefined while none was ever read). */
+export interface KeptTaskList {
+  tasks: ResearchTask[];
+  readAt: number | undefined;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The last good task list read from Leek Duck (plan 8R-1; design 4.1; table `ResearchTask` of
+ * migration 026), as the raid bosses' list is kept: a start without the network still offers
+ * it. Twin `MemoryResearchTasks` (`test/support/research-store.ts`), both running
+ * `researchTaskCases`.
+ */
+export interface ResearchTaskStorage {
+  /** The tasks of the last good read, in the order of the page, and when it was. */
+  kept(): Promise<KeptTaskList>;
+  /**
+   * Makes `tasks` the kept list, in one transaction: a task kept before keeps when it was first
+   * read, every task listed is read `at` in its place on the page, and one not listed is no
+   * longer kept as current.
+   */
+  replace(tasks: readonly ResearchTask[], at: number): Promise<void>;
+}
+
+/** The `ResearchTask` table. */
+export class ResearchTaskRepository implements ResearchTaskStorage {
+  /** `log` hears of a row whose rewards cannot be read (left out). */
+  constructor(
+    private readonly db: Kysely<DB>,
+    private readonly log?: Logger,
+  ) {}
+
+  async kept(): Promise<KeptTaskList> {
+    const rows = await this.db
+      .selectFrom('ResearchTask')
+      .selectAll()
+      .where('active', '=', 1)
+      .orderBy('position')
+      .orderBy('taskKey')
+      .execute();
+    const tasks: ResearchTask[] = [];
+    let readAt: number | undefined;
+    for (const row of rows) {
+      const rewards = rewardsDocument.safeParse(
+        typeof row.rewards === 'string' ? JSON.parse(row.rewards) : row.rewards,
+      );
+      readAt = Math.max(readAt ?? 0, Number(row.lastSeen));
+      if (!rewards.success) {
+        this.log?.warn({ task: row.taskKey }, 'a kept research task cannot be read; left out');
+        continue;
+      }
+      tasks.push({
+        key: row.taskKey,
+        text: row.text,
+        category: row.category,
+        rewards: rewards.data,
+      });
+    }
+    return { tasks, readAt };
+  }
+
+  replace(tasks: readonly ResearchTask[], at: number): Promise<void> {
+    return inTransaction(this.db, async (trx) => {
+      await trx.updateTable('ResearchTask').set({ active: 0 }).execute();
+      if (tasks.length === 0) return;
+      const values = sql.join(
+        tasks.map(
+          (task, position) =>
+            sql`(${task.key}, ${task.text}, ${task.category}, ${JSON.stringify(task.rewards)},
+              ${String(at)}, ${String(at)}, 1, ${position})`,
+        ),
+      );
+      await sql`
+        insert into ResearchTask
+          (taskKey, text, category, rewards, firstSeen, lastSeen, active, position)
+        values ${values} as new
+        on duplicate key update text = new.text, category = new.category,
+          rewards = new.rewards, lastSeen = new.lastSeen, active = 1,
+          position = new.position`.execute(trx);
+    });
+  }
+}
diff --git a/src/db/repositories/stop-post-repository.ts b/src/db/repositories/stop-post-repository.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..41291d927bead337e4d3a0cfe44afd060075e9e7
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/db/repositories/stop-post-repository.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,76 @@
+import { sql, type Kysely } from 'kysely';
+import { z } from 'zod';
+import type { DB } from '../types.js';
+
+/**
+ * The pinned "Today at the stops" post of a region channel and a local day (plan 8R-1; design
+ * 6, 9.5): its messages in order (the first, and those it spilled into), and the server.
+ */
+export interface StopPostRecord {
+  channelId: string;
+  /** The local day, `yyyy-mm-dd` in `settings.timezone`. */
+  day: string;
+  serverId: string;
+  messageIds: string[];
+  updatedAt: number;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Where the pinned posts are kept (table `StopPost` of migration 026), so that a restart draws
+ * the day's anew and deletes those of days that have ended; twin `MemoryStopPosts`
+ * (`test/support/stop-posts.ts`), both running `stopPostCases`.
+ */
+export interface StopPostStorage {
+  /** Every post kept, by channel and day. */
+  all(): Promise<StopPostRecord[]>;
+  /** Keeps a post, in the place of the one of its channel and day. */
+  save(post: StopPostRecord): Promise<void>;
+  /** Forgets the post of a channel and a day; nothing happens for one not kept. */
+  remove(channelId: string, day: string): Promise<void>;
+}
+
+const ids = z.array(z.string());
+
+/** The `StopPost` table. */
+export class StopPostRepository implements StopPostStorage {
+  constructor(private readonly db: Kysely<DB>) {}
+
+  async all(): Promise<StopPostRecord[]> {
+    const rows = await this.db
+      .selectFrom('StopPost')
+      .selectAll()
+      .orderBy('day')
+      .orderBy('channelId')
+      .execute();
+    return rows.map((row) => {
+      const parsed = ids.safeParse(
+        typeof row.messageIds === 'string' ? JSON.parse(row.messageIds) : row.messageIds,
+      );
+      return {
+        channelId: row.channelId,
+        day: row.day,
+        serverId: row.serverId,
+        messageIds: parsed.success ? parsed.data : [],
+        updatedAt: Number(row.updatedAt),
+      };
+    });
+  }
+
+  async save(post: StopPostRecord): Promise<void> {
+    // MySQL's row alias (`AS new`), never `VALUES()`, deprecated since 8.0.20.
+    await sql`
+      insert into StopPost (channelId, day, serverId, messageIds, updatedAt)
+      values (${post.channelId}, ${post.day}, ${post.serverId}, ${JSON.stringify(post.messageIds)},
+        ${String(post.updatedAt)}) as new
+      on duplicate key update serverId = new.serverId, messageIds = new.messageIds,
+        updatedAt = new.updatedAt`.execute(this.db);
+  }
+
+  async remove(channelId: string, day: string): Promise<void> {
+    await this.db
+      .deleteFrom('StopPost')
+      .where('channelId', '=', channelId)
+      .where('day', '=', day)
+      .execute();
+  }
+}
diff --git a/src/db/repositories/stop-report-repository.db.test.ts b/src/db/repositories/stop-report-repository.db.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..b8c3bbabecd428c6bd638fc9a461da5b82a6fcc8
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/db/repositories/stop-report-repository.db.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,67 @@
+import type { Kysely } from 'kysely';
+import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import { startMigratedDatabase } from '../../../test/support/migrated-db.js';
+import {
+  REPORT_NOW,
+  REPORT_SERVER,
+  reportedStop,
+  researchReport,
+  stopReportCases,
+} from '../../../test/support/stop-report-cases.js';
+import { createTestLogger } from '../../../test/support/test-logger.js';
+import type { DB } from '../types.js';
+import { StopReportRepository } from './stop-report-repository.js';
+
+describe('StopReportRepository', () => {
+  let stop: () => Promise<void>;
+  let db: Kysely<DB>;
+
+  beforeAll(async () => {
+    ({ db, stop } = await startMigratedDatabase());
+  });
+  afterAll(async () => {
+    await stop();
+  });
+
+  const fresh = async () => {
+    await db.deleteFrom('StopReport').execute();
+    return new StopReportRepository(db);
+  };
+
+  stopReportCases(fresh);
+
+  it('makes one report of two first reports of a stop at the same moment', async () => {
+    const store = await fresh();
+    const [one, two] = await Promise.all([
+      store.save(researchReport()),
+      store.save(researchReport({ reporter: { id: '200000000000000033', name: 'Gary' } })),
+    ]);
+    const later = [one, two].filter(({ replaced }) => replaced !== undefined);
+    expect(later).toHaveLength(1);
+    expect(await store.standing(REPORT_SERVER, REPORT_NOW)).toEqual([later[0]?.report]);
+  });
+
+  it('keeps the period of an event whose id is as long as the feed allows (review A7)', async () => {
+    const store = await fresh();
+    const periodKey = `event:${'e'.repeat(200)}:2026-11-21`;
+    const { report } = await store.save(researchReport({ periodKey }));
+    expect((await store.byId(report.id))?.periodKey).toBe(periodKey);
+  });
+
+  it('leaves out a row it cannot read, and leaves it alone', async () => {
+    const { log, entries } = createTestLogger();
+    const store = new StopReportRepository(db, log);
+    await db.deleteFrom('StopReport').execute();
+    const { report } = await store.save(researchReport({ stop: reportedStop(2) }));
+    await db
+      .updateTable('StopReport')
+      .set({ kind: 'balloon' })
+      .where('id', '=', report.id)
+      .execute();
+    expect(await store.standing(REPORT_SERVER, REPORT_NOW)).toEqual([]);
+    expect(entries.some((entry) => entry.msg === 'a stop report cannot be read; left alone')).toBe(
+      true,
+    );
+    expect(await db.selectFrom('StopReport').select('id').execute()).toHaveLength(1);
+  });
+});
diff --git a/src/db/repositories/stop-report-repository.ts b/src/db/repositories/stop-report-repository.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..bd13e4bb1b52d5f48626802f61044e53e45e67f8
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/db/repositories/stop-report-repository.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,251 @@
+import type { Kysely, Selectable } from 'kysely';
+import { z } from 'zod';
+import type {
+  NewStopReport,
+  ResearchDetail,
+  StopReport,
+  StopReportKind,
+} from '../../domain/stops/report.js';
+import type { Logger } from '../../log.js';
+import { isDuplicateEntry } from '../errors.js';
+import { inTransaction, retryOnDeadlock } from '../transaction.js';
+import type { DB, StopReport as StopReportRow } from '../types.js';
+
+/** What came of saving a report: it, and the report it took the place of, if any. */
+export interface SavedStopReport {
+  report: StopReport;
+  replaced: StopReport | undefined;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The reports at stops (plan 8R-1; table `StopReport` of migration 026); lets tests keep them in
+ * memory (`MemoryStopReports`, `test/support/stop-reports.ts`). Both run `stopReportCases`.
+ */
+export interface StopReportStorage {
+  /**
+   * Saves a report in the place of the one of its server, stop, kind and period (the latest
+   * replaces the earlier, whoever made it: design 4.3), in one transaction; gives the report as
+   * kept and the one it replaced.
+   */
+  save(report: NewStopReport): Promise<SavedStopReport>;
+  /** A report by its id, if it is kept. */
+  byId(id: number): Promise<StopReport | undefined>;
+  /** The reports of a server that have not ended at `now` (`endsAt` later), oldest first. */
+  standing(serverId: string, now: number): Promise<StopReport[]>;
+  /** The servers with reports that have not ended at `now`. */
+  serversStanding(now: number): Promise<string[]>;
+  /** Takes back a report of a server; gives it, or undefined when it is not kept (any more). */
+  remove(id: number, serverId: string): Promise<StopReport | undefined>;
+  /** Forgets the reports that ended at or before `before`; gives how many. */
+  removeEnded(before: number): Promise<number>;
+}
+
+const reward = z.discriminatedUnion('kind', [
+  z.object({
+    kind: z.literal('encounter'),
+    name: z.string(),
+    key: z.string().nullable(),
+    dex: z.number().int().nullable(),
+    shiny: z.boolean(),
+    cp: z.object({ min: z.number(), max: z.number() }).nullable(),
+    image: z.string().nullable(),
+  }),
+  z.object({
+    kind: z.literal('item'),
+    item: z.string(),
+    name: z.string(),
+    quantity: z.number(),
+    image: z.string().nullable(),
+  }),
+  z.object({
+    kind: z.literal('energy'),
+    dex: z.number().int().nullable(),
+    name: z.string(),
+    quantity: z.number(),
+    image: z.string().nullable(),
+  }),
+]);
+
+/** The rewards of a task as a document keeps them (`ResearchTask.rewards`, a report's detail). */
+export const rewardsDocument = z.array(reward);
+
+/** What a research report's `detail` holds. */
+const researchDocument = z.object({
+  text: z.string(),
+  category: z.string().nullable(),
+  rewards: rewardsDocument,
+  typed: z.boolean(),
+});
+
+const KINDS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set<StopReportKind>(['research']);
+
+/** A JSON column as the driver gives it: parsed already, or text. */
+function parsedJson(value: unknown): unknown {
+  if (typeof value !== 'string') return value;
+  try {
+    return JSON.parse(value);
+  } catch {
+    return undefined;
+  }
+}
+
+/** The `StopReport` table. */
+export class StopReportRepository implements StopReportStorage {
+  /** `log` hears of a row that cannot be read (left out and left alone). */
+  constructor(
+    private readonly db: Kysely<DB>,
+    private readonly log?: Logger,
+  ) {}
+
+  /** A row as a report; undefined (logged) for one of a kind or a detail this version cannot read. */
+  private read(row: Selectable<StopReportRow>): StopReport | undefined {
+    const detail = researchDocument.safeParse(parsedJson(row.detail));
+    if (!KINDS.has(row.kind) || !detail.success) {
+      this.log?.warn(
+        { report: row.id, kind: row.kind },
+        'a stop report cannot be read; left alone',
+      );
+      return undefined;
+    }
+    const research: ResearchDetail = detail.data;
+    return {
+      id: row.id,
+      serverId: row.serverId,
+      kind: 'research',
+      stop: {
+        key: row.stopKey,
+        name: row.stopName,
+        address: row.stopAddress,
+        image: row.stopImage,
+        lat: row.lat,
+        lon: row.lon,
+      },
+      periodKey: row.periodKey,
+      endsAt: Number(row.endsAt),
+      subjectKey: row.subjectKey,
+      research,
+      reporter: { id: row.reporterId, name: row.reporterName },
+      madeAt: Number(row.madeAt),
+    };
+  }
+
+  private columns(report: NewStopReport) {
+    return {
+      serverId: report.serverId,
+      stopKey: report.stop.key,
+      kind: report.kind,
+      periodKey: report.periodKey,
+      endsAt: String(report.endsAt),
+      stopName: report.stop.name,
+      stopAddress: report.stop.address,
+      stopImage: report.stop.image,
+      lat: report.stop.lat,
+      lon: report.stop.lon,
+      subjectKey: report.subjectKey,
+      detail: JSON.stringify(report.research),
+      reporterId: report.reporter.id,
+      reporterName: report.reporter.name,
+      madeAt: String(report.madeAt),
+    };
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * In a transaction of its own (read committed: a report not there yet locks no gap), the row of
+   * the report's identity locked when it is there, then replaced or made. Two first reports of a
+   * stop at once: one insert meets the other's row (a duplicate) and the whole runs again, then
+   * replacing it.
+   */
+  async save(report: NewStopReport): Promise<SavedStopReport> {
+    for (let attempt = 1; ; attempt++) {
+      try {
+        return await retryOnDeadlock(this.db, () =>
+          inTransaction(this.db, (trx) => this.saveIn(trx, report), {
+            isolation: 'read committed',
+          }),
+        );
+      } catch (err) {
+        if (attempt >= 3 || !isDuplicateEntry(err, 'stopreport_identity_unique')) throw err;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  private async saveIn(trx: Kysely<DB>, report: NewStopReport): Promise<SavedStopReport> {
+    const before = await trx
+      .selectFrom('StopReport')
+      .selectAll()
+      .where('serverId', '=', report.serverId)
+      .where('stopKey', '=', report.stop.key)
+      .where('kind', '=', report.kind)
+      .where('periodKey', '=', report.periodKey)
+      .forUpdate()
+      .executeTakeFirst();
+    // A replacement is a report of its own (review A1): the replaced row is deleted and a new one
+    // made, under the same lock, so an id never changes what it is; an old answer's Take back or
+    // "Same task at more stops…" finds its report gone.
+    if (before) await trx.deleteFrom('StopReport').where('id', '=', before.id).execute();
+    const made = await trx
+      .insertInto('StopReport')
+      .values(this.columns(report))
+      .executeTakeFirstOrThrow();
+    const id = Number(made.insertId);
+    return {
+      report: { ...report, id },
+      replaced: before && this.read(before),
+    };
+  }
+
+  async byId(id: number): Promise<StopReport | undefined> {
+    const row = await this.db
+      .selectFrom('StopReport')
+      .selectAll()
+      .where('id', '=', id)
+      .executeTakeFirst();
+    return row && this.read(row);
+  }
+
+  async standing(serverId: string, now: number): Promise<StopReport[]> {
+    const rows = await this.db
+      .selectFrom('StopReport')
+      .selectAll()
+      .where('serverId', '=', serverId)
+      .where('endsAt', '>', String(now))
+      .orderBy('madeAt')
+      .orderBy('id')
+      .execute();
+    return rows.flatMap((row) => this.read(row) ?? []);
+  }
+
+  async serversStanding(now: number): Promise<string[]> {
+    const rows = await this.db
+      .selectFrom('StopReport')
+      .select('serverId')
+      .distinct()
+      .where('endsAt', '>', String(now))
+      .orderBy('serverId')
+      .execute();
+    return rows.map((row) => row.serverId);
+  }
+
+  async remove(id: number, serverId: string): Promise<StopReport | undefined> {
+    return inTransaction(this.db, async (trx) => {
+      const row = await trx
+        .selectFrom('StopReport')
+        .selectAll()
+        .where('id', '=', id)
+        .where('serverId', '=', serverId)
+        .forUpdate()
+        .executeTakeFirst();
+      if (!row) return undefined;
+      await trx.deleteFrom('StopReport').where('id', '=', id).execute();
+      return this.read(row);
+    });
+  }
+
+  async removeEnded(before: number): Promise<number> {
+    const result = await this.db
+      .deleteFrom('StopReport')
+      .where('endsAt', '<=', String(before))
+      .executeTakeFirst();
+    return Number(result.numDeletedRows);
+  }
+}
diff --git a/src/db/repositories/target-want-repository.db.test.ts b/src/db/repositories/target-want-repository.db.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..e319a8e32b328e5deac333a1cafc0233acb34dec
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/db/repositories/target-want-repository.db.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,90 @@
+import { sql, type Kysely } from 'kysely';
+import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import { startMigratedDatabase } from '../../../test/support/migrated-db.js';
+import {
+  ASH,
+  DRATINI_RESEARCH,
+  MACHAMP_DYNAMAX,
+  targetWantCases,
+  WANT_SERVER,
+  WANTED_AT,
+} from '../../../test/support/target-want-cases.js';
+import type { DB } from '../types.js';
+import { TargetWantRepository } from './target-want-repository.js';
+
+describe('TargetWantRepository', () => {
+  let stop: () => Promise<void>;
+  let db: Kysely<DB>;
+
+  beforeAll(async () => {
+    ({ db, stop } = await startMigratedDatabase());
+  });
+  afterAll(async () => {
+    await stop();
+  });
+
+  const fresh = async () => {
+    await db.deleteFrom('TargetWant').execute();
+    return new TargetWantRepository(db);
+  };
+
+  targetWantCases(fresh);
+
+  it('counts a row it cannot read, leaves it in the list alone and removes it with all', async () => {
+    const store = await fresh();
+    await store.change(ASH, WANT_SERVER, { add: [DRATINI_RESEARCH], remove: [] }, WANTED_AT);
+    const row = await db
+      .selectFrom('TargetWant')
+      .select(['guildId', 'userId'])
+      .executeTakeFirstOrThrow();
+    await db
+      .insertInto('TargetWant')
+      .values({ ...row, target: 'balloon:team-leader', createdAt: String(WANTED_AT) })
+      .execute();
+    expect(await store.list(ASH, WANT_SERVER)).toEqual({
+      wants: [DRATINI_RESEARCH],
+      unreadable: 1,
+    });
+    expect(await store.count(ASH, WANT_SERVER)).toBe(2);
+    expect(await store.removeAll(ASH, WANT_SERVER)).toBe(2);
+  });
+
+  it('writes a target once when the same change comes twice at the same moment', async () => {
+    const store = await fresh();
+    await Promise.all([
+      store.change(ASH, WANT_SERVER, { add: [MACHAMP_DYNAMAX], remove: [] }, WANTED_AT),
+      store.change(ASH, WANT_SERVER, { add: [MACHAMP_DYNAMAX], remove: [] }, WANTED_AT),
+    ]);
+    expect((await store.list(ASH, WANT_SERVER)).wants).toEqual([MACHAMP_DYNAMAX]);
+  });
+
+  /**
+   * The dialog of `/want` reads one member's targets of one Pokémon within Discord's three
+   * seconds (design 7, the slow-read rule): that read, and the notifier's by target, go by keys.
+   */
+  it('reads one member’s targets by the unique key, and who wants a target by its index', async () => {
+    const store = await fresh();
+    for (let n = 1; n <= 60; n++) {
+      await store.change(
+        String(300000000000000000n + BigInt(n)),
+        WANT_SERVER,
+        { add: [DRATINI_RESEARCH, MACHAMP_DYNAMAX], remove: [] },
+        WANTED_AT,
+      );
+    }
+    await sql`analyze table TargetWant`.execute(db);
+    const row = await db
+      .selectFrom('TargetWant')
+      .select(['guildId', 'userId'])
+      .executeTakeFirstOrThrow();
+    const ofMember = await sql<{ key: string | null }>`
+      explain select target from TargetWant
+      where guildId = ${row.guildId} and userId = ${row.userId}
+        and target in ('research:pokemon:147', 'dynamax:147')`.execute(db);
+    expect(ofMember.rows[0]?.key).toBe('targetwant_member_unique');
+    const byTarget = await sql<{ key: string | null }>`
+      explain select userId from TargetWant
+      where guildId = ${row.guildId} and target in ('research:pokemon:147')`.execute(db);
+    expect(byTarget.rows[0]?.key).toBe('targetwant_target_index');
+  });
+});
diff --git a/src/db/repositories/target-want-repository.ts b/src/db/repositories/target-want-repository.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..976d5dd3ec2c76e0f16052dbdb6dab02279ae5a2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/db/repositories/target-want-repository.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,234 @@
+import type { Kysely } from 'kysely';
+import {
+  parseTargetWantToken,
+  targetWantToken,
+  type TargetWant,
+} from '../../domain/notify/target-wants.js';
+import type { DB } from '../types.js';
+import { findMemberInGuild, withMemberLocked, type MemberInGuild } from './member-rows.js';
+import { RowIds } from './row-ids.js';
+
+/** A member's targets of `TargetWant` in a server. */
+export interface TargetWantList {
+  /** Each once, in the order they were made. */
+  wants: TargetWant[];
+  /** Rows this version cannot read (a later version's tokens); left alone. */
+  unreadable: number;
+}
+
+/** The members a read by token found, each with the targets of theirs it found. */
+export interface MemberTargetWants {
+  memberId: string;
+  wants: TargetWant[];
+}
+
+/**
+ * The wants of `TargetWant` (plan 8R-1; design 9.1): per member and server, each target a token
+ * (`targetWantToken`). A member and a server are named by their snowflakes; the rows hang on
+ * the member's `User` and the server's `Guild` row, as the wants of `PokemonNotification` do,
+ * and change under `withMemberLocked`. Its twin in memory is `MemoryTargetWants`
+ * (`test/support/target-wants.ts`); both run `targetWantCases`.
+ */
+export interface TargetWantStorage {
+  list(memberId: string, guildId: string): Promise<TargetWantList>;
+  /** Those of these targets the member wants in the server (the dialog's read: one key read). */
+  of(memberId: string, guildId: string, targets: readonly TargetWant[]): Promise<TargetWant[]>;
+  /**
+   * Adds and removes targets of a member in a server, in one transaction (what is there already
+   * is not added twice, what is not there is no error). `at` is when, for a row that is made.
+   */
+  change(
+    memberId: string,
+    guildId: string,
+    change: { add: readonly TargetWant[]; remove: readonly TargetWant[] },
+    at: number,
+  ): Promise<void>;
+  /** Removes one target; false when the member had none. */
+  remove(memberId: string, guildId: string, want: TargetWant): Promise<boolean>;
+  /** Removes every row of the member in the server, unreadable ones too; gives how many went. */
+  removeAll(memberId: string, guildId: string): Promise<number>;
+  /** How many rows the member has in the server, unreadable ones too. */
+  count(memberId: string, guildId: string): Promise<number>;
+  /**
+   * The read by event: the members who want, in this server, one of these targets, each with
+   * those of theirs (no targets ask nothing). Over the index `(guildId, target)`.
+   */
+  wanting(guildId: string, targets: readonly TargetWant[]): Promise<MemberTargetWants[]>;
+}
+
+/** The `TargetWant` table. */
+export class TargetWantRepository implements TargetWantStorage {
+  /** `ids` is the process's memory of `User` and `Guild` rows it has seen (`RowIds`). */
+  constructor(
+    private readonly db: Kysely<DB>,
+    private readonly ids: RowIds = RowIds.none,
+  ) {}
+
+  private locked<T>(
+    memberId: string,
+    guildId: string,
+    create: boolean,
+    work: (trx: Kysely<DB>, member: MemberInGuild | undefined) => Promise<T>,
+  ): Promise<T> {
+    return withMemberLocked(this.db, memberId, guildId, create, work, this.ids);
+  }
+
+  private async tokens(db: Kysely<DB>, member: MemberInGuild): Promise<string[]> {
+    const rows = await db
+      .selectFrom('TargetWant')
+      .select('target')
+      .where('guildId', '=', member.guildId)
+      .where('userId', '=', member.userId)
+      .orderBy('id')
+      .execute();
+    return rows.map((row) => row.target);
+  }
+
+  async list(memberId: string, guildId: string): Promise<TargetWantList> {
+    const member = await findMemberInGuild(this.db, memberId, guildId, this.ids);
+    if (!member) return { wants: [], unreadable: 0 };
+    const wants: TargetWant[] = [];
+    let unreadable = 0;
+    for (const token of await this.tokens(this.db, member)) {
+      const want = parseTargetWantToken(token);
+      if (want) wants.push(want);
+      else unreadable += 1;
+    }
+    return { wants, unreadable };
+  }
+
+  async of(
+    memberId: string,
+    guildId: string,
+    targets: readonly TargetWant[],
+  ): Promise<TargetWant[]> {
+    if (targets.length === 0) return [];
+    const member = await findMemberInGuild(this.db, memberId, guildId, this.ids);
+    if (!member) return [];
+    const rows = await this.db
+      .selectFrom('TargetWant')
+      .select('target')
+      .where('guildId', '=', member.guildId)
+      .where('userId', '=', member.userId)
+      .where('target', 'in', targets.map(targetWantToken))
+      .orderBy('id')
+      .execute();
+    return rows.flatMap((row) => parseTargetWantToken(row.target) ?? []);
+  }
+
+  async change(
+    memberId: string,
+    guildId: string,
+    change: { add: readonly TargetWant[]; remove: readonly TargetWant[] },
+    at: number,
+  ): Promise<void> {
+    if (change.add.length === 0 && change.remove.length === 0) return;
+    await this.locked(memberId, guildId, change.add.length > 0, async (trx, member) => {
+      if (!member) return;
+      await changeTargetWants(trx, member, change, at);
+    });
+  }
+
+  async remove(memberId: string, guildId: string, want: TargetWant): Promise<boolean> {
+    return this.locked(memberId, guildId, false, async (trx, member) => {
+      if (!member) return false;
+      const gone = await trx
+        .deleteFrom('TargetWant')
+        .where('guildId', '=', member.guildId)
+        .where('userId', '=', member.userId)
+        .where('target', '=', targetWantToken(want))
+        .executeTakeFirst();
+      return Number(gone.numDeletedRows) > 0;
+    });
+  }
+
+  async removeAll(memberId: string, guildId: string): Promise<number> {
+    return this.locked(memberId, guildId, false, async (trx, member) => {
+      if (!member) return 0;
+      const gone = await trx
+        .deleteFrom('TargetWant')
+        .where('guildId', '=', member.guildId)
+        .where('userId', '=', member.userId)
+        .executeTakeFirst();
+      return Number(gone.numDeletedRows);
+    });
+  }
+
+  async count(memberId: string, guildId: string): Promise<number> {
+    const member = await findMemberInGuild(this.db, memberId, guildId, this.ids);
+    if (!member) return 0;
+    return (await this.tokens(this.db, member)).length;
+  }
+
+  async wanting(guildId: string, targets: readonly TargetWant[]): Promise<MemberTargetWants[]> {
+    const asked = [...new Set(targets.map(targetWantToken))];
+    if (asked.length === 0) return [];
+    const rows = await this.db
+      .selectFrom('TargetWant as w')
+      .innerJoin('Guild as g', 'g.id', 'w.guildId')
+      .innerJoin('User as u', 'u.id', 'w.userId')
+      .select(['u.userSnowflake as memberId', 'w.target'])
+      .where('g.snowflake', '=', guildId)
+      .where('w.target', 'in', asked)
+      .orderBy('w.id')
+      .execute();
+    const byMember = new Map<string, TargetWant[]>();
+    for (const row of rows) {
+      const want = parseTargetWantToken(row.target);
+      if (row.memberId === null || !want) continue;
+      const known = byMember.get(row.memberId);
+      if (known) known.push(want);
+      else byMember.set(row.memberId, [want]);
+    }
+    return [...byMember].map(([memberId, wants]) => ({ memberId, wants }));
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+ * Adds and removes a member's targets in a transaction that holds their row locked
+ * (`withMemberLocked`): for the dialog of `/want`, which writes these with the member's
+ * `PokemonNotification` rows in one transaction. A target there already is not made again.
+ */
+export async function changeTargetWants(
+  trx: Kysely<DB>,
+  member: MemberInGuild,
+  change: { add: readonly TargetWant[]; remove: readonly TargetWant[] },
+  at: number,
+): Promise<void> {
+  const removed = change.remove.map(targetWantToken);
+  if (removed.length > 0) {
+    await trx
+      .deleteFrom('TargetWant')
+      .where('guildId', '=', member.guildId)
+      .where('userId', '=', member.userId)
+      .where('target', 'in', removed)
+      .execute();
+  }
+  const added = [...new Set(change.add.map(targetWantToken))];
+  if (added.length === 0) return;
+  // The member's row is locked: nobody else adds theirs meanwhile, so a plain read decides.
+  const have = new Set(
+    (
+      await trx
+        .selectFrom('TargetWant')
+        .select('target')
+        .where('guildId', '=', member.guildId)
+        .where('userId', '=', member.userId)
+        .where('target', 'in', added)
+        .execute()
+    ).map((row) => row.target),
+  );
+  const fresh = added.filter((token) => !have.has(token));
+  if (fresh.length === 0) return;
+  await trx
+    .insertInto('TargetWant')
+    .values(
+      fresh.map((target) => ({
+        guildId: member.guildId,
+        userId: member.userId,
+        target,
+        createdAt: String(at),
+      })),
+    )
+    .execute();
+}

diff --git a/src/domain/notify/target-wants.test.ts b/src/domain/notify/target-wants.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..0fe02ec34e00cb26868ca3b4786af2582077f611
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/domain/notify/target-wants.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,63 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import {
+  boxTarget,
+  parseTargetWantToken,
+  readTargetWantArgs,
+  targetWantArgs,
+  targetWantToken,
+  type TargetWant,
+} from './target-wants.js';
+
+const EVERY: readonly TargetWant[] = [
+  boxTarget('research-pokemon', 147),
+  boxTarget('research-pokemon', 37, 'vulpix_alola'),
+  { kind: 'research-item', item: 'golden-razz-berry' },
+  { kind: 'research-energy', dex: 6 },
+  boxTarget('dynamax', 68),
+  boxTarget('gigantamax', 849, 'toxtricity_amped'),
+];
+
+describe('the tokens of TargetWant', () => {
+  it('spells each target as design 9.1 says, and reads it back', () => {
+    expect(EVERY.map(targetWantToken)).toEqual([
+      'research:pokemon:147',
+      'research:pokemon:37:vulpix_alola',
+      'research:item:golden-razz-berry',
+      'research:energy:6',
+      'dynamax:68',
+      'gigantamax:849:toxtricity_amped',
+    ]);
+    for (const want of EVERY) expect(parseTargetWantToken(targetWantToken(want))).toEqual(want);
+  });
+
+  it('reads nothing that is no target of this version', () => {
+    for (const token of [
+      '',
+      'research',
+      'research:pokemon',
+      'research:pokemon:0',
+      'research:pokemon:147:Dratini',
+      'research:item:Rare Candy',
+      'research:energy:6:charizard_mega_x',
+      'dynamax',
+      'dynamax:abc',
+      'grunt:dragon',
+      'giovanni',
+      'research:pokemon:147:dratini:more',
+    ]) {
+      expect(parseTargetWantToken(token)).toBeUndefined();
+    }
+  });
+
+  it('fits a custom id, and the arguments of a Stop button read back', () => {
+    for (const want of EVERY) {
+      const args = targetWantArgs(want);
+      expect(args.every((arg) => arg !== '' && !arg.includes(':'))).toBe(true);
+      expect(readTargetWantArgs(args)).toEqual(want);
+    }
+    expect(readTargetWantArgs(['rp'])).toBeUndefined();
+    expect(readTargetWantArgs(['ri', 'Rare Candy'])).toBeUndefined();
+    expect(readTargetWantArgs(['re', '6', 'x'])).toBeUndefined();
+    expect(readTargetWantArgs(['zz', '6'])).toBeUndefined();
+  });
+});
diff --git a/src/domain/notify/target-wants.ts b/src/domain/notify/target-wants.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..009bd107a1c5f74cc28924ffa4438c2f06cd4689
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/domain/notify/target-wants.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,140 @@
+import { isFormKey, isPokedexNumber } from '../pogo/notification-target.js';
+import { isItemKey } from '../research/task.js';
+
+/*
+ * The wants that are no `PokemonNotification` row (plan 8R-1; design 9.1): table `TargetWant`,
+ * one row per member, server and target, the target a token. Research rewards (a Pokémon, an
+ * item, Mega Energy of a species) and the Dynamax and Gigantamax boxes of `/want`'s dialog;
+ * plan 8R-2 adds the Rocket targets.
+ */
+
+/**
+ * A target of `TargetWant`. A Pokémon is a species (`form` absent: every form) or one form (its
+ * catalogue key), as a `PokemonTarget` is.
+ */
+export type TargetWant =
+  | { kind: 'research-pokemon'; dex: number; form?: string }
+  | { kind: 'research-item'; item: string }
+  | { kind: 'research-energy'; dex: number }
+  | { kind: 'dynamax'; dex: number; form?: string }
+  | { kind: 'gigantamax'; dex: number; form?: string };
+
+/** The kinds of `TargetWant` that are a Pokémon (a box of `/want`'s dialog). */
+export type PokemonBoxKind = 'research-pokemon' | 'dynamax' | 'gigantamax';
+
+/** A Pokémon's target of a box: the species, or one form. */
+export function boxTarget(kind: PokemonBoxKind, dex: number, form?: string): TargetWant {
+  return { kind, dex, ...(form === undefined ? {} : { form }) };
+}
+
+const PREFIX: Readonly<Record<TargetWant['kind'], string>> = {
+  'research-pokemon': 'research:pokemon',
+  'research-item': 'research:item',
+  'research-energy': 'research:energy',
+  dynamax: 'dynamax',
+  gigantamax: 'gigantamax',
+};
+
+/**
+ * A target as the column holds it (design 9.1): `research:pokemon:<dex>[:<form>]`,
+ * `research:item:<key>`, `research:energy:<dex>`, `dynamax:<dex>[:<form>]`,
+ * `gigantamax:<dex>[:<form>]`. At most 88 characters (a form key is 64 at most).
+ */
+export function targetWantToken(want: TargetWant): string {
+  switch (want.kind) {
+    case 'research-item':
+      return `${PREFIX[want.kind]}:${want.item}`;
+    case 'research-energy':
+      return `${PREFIX[want.kind]}:${String(want.dex)}`;
+    default:
+      return `${PREFIX[want.kind]}:${String(want.dex)}${want.form === undefined ? '' : `:${want.form}`}`;
+  }
+}
+
+function dexOf(text: string | undefined): number | undefined {
+  if (text === undefined || !/^[1-9]\d*$/.test(text)) return undefined;
+  const dex = Number(text);
+  return isPokedexNumber(dex) ? dex : undefined;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The target a token names; undefined for any other text (a row of a later version, or a token
+ * that cannot be one): such a row is left alone, never deleted on its own.
+ */
+export function parseTargetWantToken(token: string): TargetWant | undefined {
+  const parts = token.split(':');
+  const [head, second] = parts;
+  if (head === 'research') {
+    const [, , value, form, ...more] = parts;
+    if (more.length > 0) return undefined;
+    if (second === 'item') {
+      return form === undefined && value !== undefined && isItemKey(value)
+        ? { kind: 'research-item', item: value }
+        : undefined;
+    }
+    const dex = dexOf(value);
+    if (dex === undefined) return undefined;
+    if (second === 'energy')
+      return form === undefined ? { kind: 'research-energy', dex } : undefined;
+    if (second !== 'pokemon') return undefined;
+    if (form !== undefined && !isFormKey(form)) return undefined;
+    return boxTarget('research-pokemon', dex, form);
+  }
+  if (head === 'dynamax' || head === 'gigantamax') {
+    const [, , form, ...more] = parts;
+    const dex = dexOf(second);
+    if (dex === undefined || more.length > 0) return undefined;
+    if (form !== undefined && !isFormKey(form)) return undefined;
+    return boxTarget(head, dex, form);
+  }
+  return undefined;
+}
+
+/** Whether two targets are the same want. */
+export function sameTargetWant(a: TargetWant, b: TargetWant): boolean {
+  return targetWantToken(a) === targetWantToken(b);
+}
+
+/**
+ * A target as the arguments of a custom id (`dm:<server>:stop:<these>`, a list's Remove), as
+ * `stopArgs` spells the other reasons: `rp:<dex>[:<form>]`, `ri:<item>`, `re:<dex>`,
+ * `dx:<dex>[:<form>]`, `gx:<dex>[:<form>]`.
+ */
+export function targetWantArgs(want: TargetWant): string[] {
+  switch (want.kind) {
+    case 'research-item':
+      return ['ri', want.item];
+    case 'research-energy':
+      return ['re', String(want.dex)];
+    case 'research-pokemon':
+      return ['rp', String(want.dex), ...(want.form === undefined ? [] : [want.form])];
+    case 'dynamax':
+      return ['dx', String(want.dex), ...(want.form === undefined ? [] : [want.form])];
+    case 'gigantamax':
+      return ['gx', String(want.dex), ...(want.form === undefined ? [] : [want.form])];
+  }
+}
+
+const ARG_KINDS: Readonly<Record<string, PokemonBoxKind>> = {
+  rp: 'research-pokemon',
+  dx: 'dynamax',
+  gx: 'gigantamax',
+};
+
+/** The target a custom id's arguments spell (`targetWantArgs`); undefined for anything else. */
+export function readTargetWantArgs(args: readonly string[]): TargetWant | undefined {
+  const [kind, value, form, ...more] = args;
+  if (kind === undefined || value === undefined || more.length > 0) return undefined;
+  if (kind === 'ri') {
+    return form === undefined && isItemKey(value)
+      ? { kind: 'research-item', item: value }
+      : undefined;
+  }
+  const dex = dexOf(value);
+  if (dex === undefined) return undefined;
+  if (kind === 're') return form === undefined ? { kind: 'research-energy', dex } : undefined;
+  const box = ARG_KINDS[kind];
+  if (box === undefined) return undefined;
+  if (form !== undefined && !isFormKey(form)) return undefined;
+  return boxTarget(box, dex, form);
+}
diff --git a/src/domain/research/task.test.ts b/src/domain/research/task.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..60e4a1ea5d559ff663b9c59f8c29e758ad552e9e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/domain/research/task.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,62 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import {
+  foldTaskText,
+  isItemKey,
+  isTaskKey,
+  itemKey,
+  rewardsInShort,
+  taskKeyOf,
+  type TaskReward,
+} from './task.js';
+
+describe('a task’s text and key', () => {
+  it('folds case, accents, signs and gaps', () => {
+    expect(foldTaskText('Catch 7 Pokémon!')).toBe('catch 7 pokemon');
+    expect(foldTaskText('  make 2   EXCELLENT throws ')).toBe('make 2 excellent throws');
+    expect(foldTaskText('Win a three-star raid or higher')).toBe('win a three star raid or higher');
+  });
+
+  it('gives one text one key of 16 hex digits, another text another', () => {
+    const key = taskKeyOf('Make 2 Excellent Throws');
+    expect(isTaskKey(key)).toBe(true);
+    expect(taskKeyOf('make 2 excellent throws!')).toBe(key);
+    expect(taskKeyOf('Make 3 Excellent Throws')).not.toBe(key);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('an item’s key', () => {
+  it('is its folded name with hyphens', () => {
+    expect(itemKey('Golden Razz Berry')).toBe('golden-razz-berry');
+    expect(itemKey('Poké Ball')).toBe('poke-ball');
+    expect(isItemKey(itemKey('Silver Pinap Berry'))).toBe(true);
+    expect(isItemKey('Rare Candy')).toBe(false);
+    expect(itemKey('×')).toBe('');
+  });
+});
+
+describe('rewards in short', () => {
+  const candy: TaskReward = {
+    kind: 'item',
+    item: 'rare-candy',
+    name: 'Rare Candy',
+    quantity: 3,
+    image: null,
+  };
+  const mon = (name: string): TaskReward => ({
+    kind: 'encounter',
+    name,
+    key: null,
+    dex: null,
+    shiny: false,
+    cp: null,
+    image: null,
+  });
+
+  it('names the first three and counts the rest', () => {
+    expect(rewardsInShort([mon('Dratini'), mon('Bagon'), mon('Axew'), candy])).toBe(
+      'Dratini, Bagon, Axew +1',
+    );
+    expect(rewardsInShort([candy])).toBe('Rare Candy ×3');
+    expect(rewardsInShort([])).toBe('');
+  });
+});
diff --git a/src/domain/research/task.ts b/src/domain/research/task.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..c19b4ef48faba9d3e057e8bf1379ac1085a1ee59
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/domain/research/task.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,114 @@
+import { foldText } from '../search/text.js';
+
+/*
+ * Field research tasks (plan 8R-1; design `2026-10-21-stop-reports-design.md`, 4.1): what a
+ * PokéStop's task is, as Leek Duck's research page lists it. Pure: the page is read by
+ * `leekduck.ts`, the list is kept by `ResearchTaskService`.
+ */
+
+/** A reward a task may give (one is drawn per player from the task's rewards). */
+export type TaskReward =
+  /**
+   * A Pokémon to catch: `key` and `dex` are the catalogue's entry where the page's name and
+   * picture agree (`identifyBoss`), null where the game data does not know it (it is shown by
+   * `name` and wanted by nobody); `cp` the page's range at level 15, when it gives one.
+   */
+  | {
+      kind: 'encounter';
+      name: string;
+      key: string | null;
+      dex: number | null;
+      shiny: boolean;
+      cp: { min: number; max: number } | null;
+      image: string | null;
+    }
+  /** An item (`item` is its key, `itemKey`), with how many of it. */
+  | { kind: 'item'; item: string; name: string; quantity: number; image: string | null }
+  /**
+   * Mega Energy of a species (`dex` from the page's picture, null when it gives none), with how
+   * much. `name` is the page's (`Sceptile Mega Energy`).
+   */
+  | {
+      kind: 'energy';
+      dex: number | null;
+      name: string;
+      quantity: number;
+      image: string | null;
+    };
+
+/**
+ * A task: its key (`taskKeyOf` its text), its text as the page writes it, its category (the
+ * page's heading without "Tasks": Catching, Throwing, Battling, Exploring, Training, Buddy &
+ * Friendship, Team GO Rocket, Sponsored) and its rewards in the page's order.
+ */
+export interface ResearchTask {
+  key: string;
+  text: string;
+  category: string;
+  rewards: TaskReward[];
+}
+
+/** How long a task's text may be, as kept and shown. */
+export const MAX_TASK_TEXT = 200;
+
+/** How long a task a member typed may be (design 9.8; Matt's answer 5). */
+export const MAX_TYPED_TASK = 100;
+
+/**
+ * A task's text as it is compared: folded (no case, no accents), every run of what is no letter
+ * or digit one space. "Make 2 Excellent Throws" and "make 2 excellent  throws!" are one task.
+ */
+export function foldTaskText(text: string): string {
+  return foldText(text)
+    .replace(/['’‘`]/g, '')
+    .split(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/u)
+    .filter((word) => word !== '')
+    .join(' ');
+}
+
+const FNV_OFFSET = 0xcbf29ce484222325n;
+const FNV_PRIME = 0x100000001b3n;
+const MASK = (1n << 64n) - 1n;
+
+/**
+ * A task's key (design 9.8): FNV-1a of its folded text (UTF-8), 64 bits as 16 hex digits. The
+ * value of an autocomplete choice and a report's `subjectKey`; the same text always has it.
+ */
+export function taskKeyOf(text: string): string {
+  let hash = FNV_OFFSET;
+  for (const byte of new TextEncoder().encode(foldTaskText(text))) {
+    hash = ((hash ^ BigInt(byte)) * FNV_PRIME) & MASK;
+  }
+  return hash.toString(16).padStart(16, '0');
+}
+
+/** Whether a text can be a task's key. */
+export function isTaskKey(text: string): boolean {
+  return /^[0-9a-f]{16}$/.test(text);
+}
+
+/**
+ * An item's key, made of its name as the page writes it: folded, words joined by `-`
+ * (`Golden Razz Berry` is `golden-razz-berry`, `Poké Ball` is `poke-ball`), at most 40
+ * characters. Empty for a name without a letter or digit.
+ */
+export function itemKey(name: string): string {
+  return foldTaskText(name).replace(/ /g, '-').slice(0, 40).replace(/-+$/, '');
+}
+
+/** Whether a text can be an item's key (`itemKey`). */
+export function isItemKey(text: string): boolean {
+  return /^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/.test(text) && text.length <= 40;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The rewards of a task in short, as a choice and a line show them: `Dratini, Bagon, Axew` or
+ * `Rare Candy ×3`, the first `most` and "+N" for the rest.
+ */
+export function rewardsInShort(rewards: readonly TaskReward[], most = 3): string {
+  const names = rewards.map((reward) =>
+    reward.kind === 'encounter' ? reward.name : `${reward.name} ×${String(reward.quantity)}`,
+  );
+  const shown = names.slice(0, most).join(', ');
+  return names.length > most ? `${shown} +${String(names.length - most)}` : shown;
+}
diff --git a/src/domain/stops/pine-stop.ts b/src/domain/stops/pine-stop.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..02492d12588b518fa07720920a216bcd2ccbbc56
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/domain/stops/pine-stop.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,37 @@
+/**
+ * A PokéStop of Pine's own (plan 8R-1; design 3, decision 9): a sponsored stop, which Wayfarer
+ * does not list, added by staff with `/pokestop`. Per server (`serverId`, a snowflake), never in
+ * `Wayspot`, which belongs to the imports and is shared by all servers; an import never touches
+ * it. Its key wherever a stop is named is `pine-<id>` (`pineStopKey`).
+ */
+export interface PineStop {
+  id: number;
+  serverId: string;
+  /** As staff typed it, tidied (`tidyLine`), at most `MAX_PINE_STOP_NAME`. */
+  name: string;
+  lat: number;
+  lon: number;
+  /** As staff typed it, null for none. */
+  address: string | null;
+  createdBy: string;
+  createdAt: number;
+  updatedBy: string;
+  updatedAt: number;
+}
+
+/** What `/pokestop add` makes: the storage gives the id. */
+export type NewPineStop = Omit<PineStop, 'id' | 'updatedBy' | 'updatedAt'>;
+
+/** What `/pokestop edit` may change. */
+export interface PineStopChange {
+  name?: string;
+  lat?: number;
+  lon?: number;
+  address?: string | null;
+}
+
+/** How long a stop's name may be (the column holds 255; a stop's title in the game is far shorter). */
+export const MAX_PINE_STOP_NAME = 100;
+
+/** How long its address may be. */
+export const MAX_PINE_STOP_ADDRESS = 200;
diff --git a/src/domain/stops/report.ts b/src/domain/stops/report.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..c4cf85d4423b2d84c0d9ea97b2cd238df3b9a2b8
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/domain/stops/report.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,83 @@
+import type { TaskReward } from '../research/task.js';
+
+/*
+ * Reports at stops (plan 8R-1; design `2026-10-21-stop-reports-design.md`, decision 1): a stop,
+ * what is there and until when. Field research is the kind of this plan; Team GO Rocket's
+ * hideouts (plan 8R-2) add a kind with a detail of its own.
+ */
+
+/** The kinds of report at a stop. */
+export type StopReportKind = 'research';
+
+/**
+ * A stop as a report keeps it (design 3: a snapshot, as a spawn report keeps its place): its key
+ * (a kept Wayspot's Wayfarer id, a stop of Pine's own as `pine-<id>`), name, address line (null
+ * for none), picture (null for none) and point. A report still shows a stop renamed or removed
+ * later the same day.
+ */
+export interface ReportedStop {
+  key: string;
+  name: string;
+  address: string | null;
+  image: string | null;
+  lat: number;
+  lon: number;
+}
+
+/**
+ * What a research report says: the task's text, its category (null for a typed one), its
+ * rewards as the list had them when it was reported (one typed reward, or none, for a task
+ * typed in full), and whether it was typed (`typed`: no task of the list).
+ */
+export interface ResearchDetail {
+  text: string;
+  category: string | null;
+  rewards: TaskReward[];
+  typed: boolean;
+}
+
+/** A member who reported, by id and by name as shown then. */
+export interface Reporter {
+  id: string;
+  name: string;
+}
+
+/** A report as it is kept. */
+export interface StopReport {
+  id: number;
+  /** Snowflake of the server: a report belongs to one (design 9.3). */
+  serverId: string;
+  kind: StopReportKind;
+  stop: ReportedStop;
+  /** The research period it was made in (`src/domain/time/research-periods.ts`). */
+  periodKey: string;
+  /** When it ends, epoch milliseconds: the end of its period as known when it was made. */
+  endsAt: number;
+  /**
+   * What it is of, for telling two reports of one thing apart: a task's key, a typed task's
+   * `typed:<key of its text>`.
+   */
+  subjectKey: string;
+  research: ResearchDetail;
+  reporter: Reporter;
+  madeAt: number;
+}
+
+/** A report as it is made: the storage gives its id. */
+export type NewStopReport = Omit<StopReport, 'id'>;
+
+/** The key of a stop of Pine's own (`/pokestop`). */
+export function pineStopKey(id: number): string {
+  return `pine-${String(id)}`;
+}
+
+/** The row id of a stop of Pine's own a key names; undefined for any other key. */
+export function pineStopIdOf(key: string): number | undefined {
+  const match = /^pine-([1-9]\d{0,9})$/.exec(key);
+  return match ? Number(match[1]) : undefined;
+}
+
+/** The subject of a typed task: `typed:` and the key of its text. */
+export function typedSubject(textKey: string): string {
+  return `typed:${textKey}`;
+}
diff --git a/src/domain/time/research-events.ts b/src/domain/time/research-events.ts
