````diff
@@ -0,0 +1,14 @@
+/**
+ * An event of ScrapedDuck's events feed with field research of its own (plan 8R-1; design 4.2,
+ * 9.2: `extraData.generic.hasFieldResearchTasks`), as it is kept (`ResearchEvent`): the feed's
+ * `eventID`, name and `eventType`, and its start and end (epoch milliseconds; `end` is the first
+ * moment after it). Kept as last seen, so that a restart or an event the feed dropped once it
+ * ended cannot lose a period.
+ */
+export interface ResearchEvent {
+  id: string;
+  name: string;
+  eventType: string;
+  start: number;
+  end: number;
+}
diff --git a/test/support/pine-stop-cases.ts b/test/support/pine-stop-cases.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..ad2bb931503d25f66bd3c169722b11344267134c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/test/support/pine-stop-cases.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,74 @@
+import { expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import type { PineStopStorage } from '../../src/db/repositories/pine-stop-repository.js';
+import type { NewPineStop } from '../../src/domain/stops/pine-stop.js';
+
+export const STOP_SERVER = '100000000000000021';
+export const OTHER_STOP_SERVER = '100000000000000022';
+export const STAFF = '200000000000000051';
+export const STOP_ADDED_AT = Date.UTC(2026, 9, 21, 15);
+
+/** A sponsored stop added by staff to `STOP_SERVER`. */
+export function newPineStop(overrides: Partial<NewPineStop> = {}): NewPineStop {
+  return {
+    serverId: STOP_SERVER,
+    name: 'Coffee Corner (sponsored)',
+    lat: 40.4412,
+    lon: -79.9961,
+    address: '12 Market Street',
+    createdBy: STAFF,
+    createdAt: STOP_ADDED_AT,
+    ...overrides,
+  };
+}
+
+/**
+ * What the stops of Pine's own do, run against the repository and its twin in memory alike.
+ * `made` gives a fresh, empty store.
+ */
+export function pineStopCases(made: () => Promise<PineStopStorage>): void {
+  it('adds stops, each with an id, and reads them all back', async () => {
+    const store = await made();
+    const one = await store.add(newPineStop());
+    const two = await store.add(newPineStop({ serverId: OTHER_STOP_SERVER, address: null }));
+    expect(one).toEqual({
+      ...newPineStop(),
+      id: one.id,
+      updatedBy: STAFF,
+      updatedAt: STOP_ADDED_AT,
+    });
+    expect(two.id).not.toBe(one.id);
+    expect(await store.all()).toEqual([one, two]);
+  });
+
+  it('changes a stop of its own server only', async () => {
+    const store = await made();
+    const one = await store.add(newPineStop());
+    expect(await store.update(one.id, OTHER_STOP_SERVER, { name: 'Elsewhere' }, STAFF, 1)).toBe(
+      undefined,
+    );
+    const changed = await store.update(
+      one.id,
+      STOP_SERVER,
+      { name: 'Coffee Corner', address: null },
+      '200000000000000052',
+      STOP_ADDED_AT + 60_000,
+    );
+    expect(changed).toEqual({
+      ...one,
+      name: 'Coffee Corner',
+      address: null,
+      updatedBy: '200000000000000052',
+      updatedAt: STOP_ADDED_AT + 60_000,
+    });
+    expect(await store.all()).toEqual([changed]);
+  });
+
+  it('removes a stop of its own server only, once', async () => {
+    const store = await made();
+    const one = await store.add(newPineStop());
+    expect(await store.remove(one.id, OTHER_STOP_SERVER)).toBeUndefined();
+    expect(await store.remove(one.id, STOP_SERVER)).toEqual(one);
+    expect(await store.remove(one.id, STOP_SERVER)).toBeUndefined();
+    expect(await store.all()).toEqual([]);
+  });
+}
diff --git a/test/support/pine-stops.ts b/test/support/pine-stops.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..d5a3b64d255f3f440a2dc41cb5677604f5dd193a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/test/support/pine-stops.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,70 @@
+import type { PineStopStorage } from '../../src/db/repositories/pine-stop-repository.js';
+import type { NewPineStop, PineStop, PineStopChange } from '../../src/domain/stops/pine-stop.js';
+
+/** Methods a test can make fail (`failing`). */
+type Method = keyof PineStopStorage;
+
+/**
+ * The stops of Pine's own in memory (`PineStopStorage`), for tests: the twin of
+ * `PineStopRepository`, running `pineStopCases` as it does. `rows` by id; `failing` makes a
+ * method reject with the error given.
+ */
+export class MemoryPineStops implements PineStopStorage {
+  readonly rows = new Map<number, PineStop>();
+  readonly failing = new Map<Method, Error>();
+  private nextId = 1;
+
+  constructor(stops: readonly PineStop[] = []) {
+    for (const stop of stops) {
+      this.rows.set(stop.id, { ...stop });
+      this.nextId = Math.max(this.nextId, stop.id + 1);
+    }
+  }
+
+  private fail(method: Method): void {
+    const err = this.failing.get(method);
+    if (err) throw err;
+  }
+
+  all(): Promise<PineStop[]> {
+    this.fail('all');
+    return Promise.resolve(
+      [...this.rows.values()].sort((a, b) => a.id - b.id).map((s) => ({ ...s })),
+    );
+  }
+
+  add(stop: NewPineStop): Promise<PineStop> {
+    this.fail('add');
+    const made: PineStop = {
+      ...stop,
+      id: this.nextId++,
+      updatedBy: stop.createdBy,
+      updatedAt: stop.createdAt,
+    };
+    this.rows.set(made.id, made);
+    return Promise.resolve({ ...made });
+  }
+
+  update(
+    id: number,
+    serverId: string,
+    change: PineStopChange,
+    by: string,
+    at: number,
+  ): Promise<PineStop | undefined> {
+    this.fail('update');
+    const row = this.rows.get(id);
+    if (row?.serverId !== serverId) return Promise.resolve(undefined);
+    const changed = { ...row, ...change, updatedBy: by, updatedAt: at };
+    this.rows.set(id, changed);
+    return Promise.resolve({ ...changed });
+  }
+
+  remove(id: number, serverId: string): Promise<PineStop | undefined> {
+    this.fail('remove');
+    const row = this.rows.get(id);
+    if (row?.serverId !== serverId) return Promise.resolve(undefined);
+    this.rows.delete(id);
+    return Promise.resolve(row);
+  }
+}
diff --git a/test/support/research-store-cases.ts b/test/support/research-store-cases.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..f3ead0a6a235fdb249400abe1d7115c3ebc5e033
--- /dev/null
+++ b/test/support/research-store-cases.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,112 @@
+import { expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import type { ResearchEventStorage } from '../../src/db/repositories/research-event-repository.js';
+import type { ResearchTaskStorage } from '../../src/db/repositories/research-task-repository.js';
+import type { StopPostStorage } from '../../src/db/repositories/stop-post-repository.js';
+import { taskKeyOf, type ResearchTask } from '../../src/domain/research/task.js';
+import type { ResearchEvent } from '../../src/domain/time/research-events.js';
+
+/** Into the Wild 2026 as the events feed of 2026-10-21 has it, in New York (10:00 to 20:00 EST). */
+export const INTO_THE_WILD: ResearchEvent = {
+  id: 'into-the-wild-2026',
+  name: 'Into the Wild',
+  eventType: 'event',
+  start: Date.UTC(2026, 10, 9, 15),
+  end: Date.UTC(2026, 10, 14, 1),
+};
+
+/** Pawniard Community Day as the events feed of 2026-10-21 has it (14:00 to 17:00 EST). */
+export const PAWNIARD_DAY: ResearchEvent = {
+  id: 'november-communityday2026',
+  name: 'Pawniard Community Day',
+  eventType: 'community-day',
+  start: Date.UTC(2026, 10, 21, 19),
+  end: Date.UTC(2026, 10, 21, 22),
+};
+
+/** A task of the list, by its text. */
+export function listedTask(text: string, overrides: Partial<ResearchTask> = {}): ResearchTask {
+  return {
+    key: taskKeyOf(text),
+    text,
+    category: 'Throwing',
+    rewards: [
+      {
+        kind: 'item',
+        item: 'rare-candy',
+        name: 'Rare Candy',
+        quantity: 3,
+        image: 'https://cdn.leekduck.com/assets/img/items/Rare Candy.png',
+      },
+    ],
+    ...overrides,
+  };
+}
+
+/** What the pinned posts' storage does, for the repository and its twin. */
+export function stopPostCases(made: () => Promise<StopPostStorage>): void {
+  it('keeps a post per channel and day, in the place of the one there was', async () => {
+    const store = await made();
+    const post = {
+      channelId: '300000000000000001',
+      day: '2026-10-21',
+      serverId: '100000000000000001',
+      messageIds: ['400000000000000001'],
+      updatedAt: 1,
+    };
+    await store.save(post);
+    await store.save({ ...post, day: '2026-10-20' });
+    await store.save({
+      ...post,
+      messageIds: ['400000000000000001', '400000000000000002'],
+      updatedAt: 2,
+    });
+    expect(await store.all()).toEqual([
+      { ...post, day: '2026-10-20' },
+      { ...post, messageIds: ['400000000000000001', '400000000000000002'], updatedAt: 2 },
+    ]);
+    await store.remove(post.channelId, '2026-10-20');
+    await store.remove(post.channelId, '2026-10-19');
+    expect((await store.all()).map((one) => one.day)).toEqual(['2026-10-21']);
+  });
+}
+
+/** What the research events' storage does, for the repository and its twin. */
+export function researchEventCases(made: () => Promise<ResearchEventStorage>): void {
+  it('keeps the events seen, as the feed has them now, and keeps those it no longer lists', async () => {
+    const store = await made();
+    await store.saveSeen([PAWNIARD_DAY, INTO_THE_WILD], 1);
+    const moved = { ...PAWNIARD_DAY, start: PAWNIARD_DAY.start + 3_600_000 };
+    await store.saveSeen([moved], 2);
+    await store.saveSeen([], 3);
+    expect(await store.all()).toEqual([INTO_THE_WILD, moved]);
+  });
+
+  it('forgets the events that ended before a moment', async () => {
+    const store = await made();
+    await store.saveSeen([PAWNIARD_DAY, INTO_THE_WILD], 1);
+    expect(await store.removeEnded(INTO_THE_WILD.end)).toBe(0);
+    expect(await store.removeEnded(INTO_THE_WILD.end + 1)).toBe(1);
+    expect(await store.all()).toEqual([PAWNIARD_DAY]);
+  });
+}
+
+/** What the kept task list does, for the repository and its twin. */
+export function researchTaskCases(made: () => Promise<ResearchTaskStorage>): void {
+  it('has no list before the first read', async () => {
+    const store = await made();
+    expect(await store.kept()).toEqual({ tasks: [], readAt: undefined });
+  });
+
+  it('keeps the last list read, in the order of the page (review A8)', async () => {
+    const store = await made();
+    const throws = listedTask('Make 2 Excellent Throws');
+    const catches = listedTask('Catch 7 Pokémon', { category: 'Catching' });
+    const hatch = listedTask('Hatch an Egg', { category: 'Exploring', rewards: [] });
+    await store.replace([throws, catches], 1_000);
+    await store.replace([hatch, { ...throws, category: 'Throwing tasks' }], 2_000);
+    expect(await store.kept()).toEqual({
+      tasks: [hatch, { ...throws, category: 'Throwing tasks' }],
+      readAt: 2_000,
+    });
+  });
+}

diff --git a/test/support/research-store.ts b/test/support/research-store.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..bfbe7b771992373228f957be6a4aca688aa6205f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/test/support/research-store.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,130 @@
+import type { ResearchEventStorage } from '../../src/db/repositories/research-event-repository.js';
+import type {
+  KeptTaskList,
+  ResearchTaskStorage,
+} from '../../src/db/repositories/research-task-repository.js';
+import type {
+  StopPostRecord,
+  StopPostStorage,
+} from '../../src/db/repositories/stop-post-repository.js';
+import type { ResearchTask } from '../../src/domain/research/task.js';
+import type { ResearchEvent } from '../../src/domain/time/research-events.js';
+
+/**
+ * The pinned posts in memory (`StopPostStorage`), the twin of `StopPostRepository`; `rows` by
+ * `<channel> <day>`, `failing` per method.
+ */
+export class MemoryStopPosts implements StopPostStorage {
+  readonly rows = new Map<string, StopPostRecord>();
+  readonly failing = new Map<keyof StopPostStorage, Error>();
+
+  private fail(method: keyof StopPostStorage): void {
+    const err = this.failing.get(method);
+    if (err) throw err;
+  }
+
+  all(): Promise<StopPostRecord[]> {
+    this.fail('all');
+    return Promise.resolve(
+      [...this.rows.values()]
+        .sort((a, b) => a.day.localeCompare(b.day) || a.channelId.localeCompare(b.channelId))
+        .map((row) => ({ ...row, messageIds: [...row.messageIds] })),
+    );
+  }
+
+  save(post: StopPostRecord): Promise<void> {
+    this.fail('save');
+    this.rows.set(`${post.channelId} ${post.day}`, { ...post, messageIds: [...post.messageIds] });
+    return Promise.resolve();
+  }
+
+  remove(channelId: string, day: string): Promise<void> {
+    this.fail('remove');
+    this.rows.delete(`${channelId} ${day}`);
+    return Promise.resolve();
+  }
+}
+
+/** The research events in memory (`ResearchEventStorage`), the twin of `ResearchEventRepository`. */
+export class MemoryResearchEvents implements ResearchEventStorage {
+  readonly rows = new Map<string, ResearchEvent & { firstSeen: number; lastSeen: number }>();
+  readonly failing = new Map<keyof ResearchEventStorage, Error>();
+
+  constructor(events: readonly ResearchEvent[] = []) {
+    for (const event of events) this.rows.set(event.id, { ...event, firstSeen: 0, lastSeen: 0 });
+  }
+
+  private fail(method: keyof ResearchEventStorage): void {
+    const err = this.failing.get(method);
+    if (err) throw err;
+  }
+
+  all(): Promise<ResearchEvent[]> {
+    this.fail('all');
+    return Promise.resolve(
+      [...this.rows.values()]
+        .sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start || a.id.localeCompare(b.id))
+        .map(({ id, name, eventType, start, end }) => ({ id, name, eventType, start, end })),
+    );
+  }
+
+  saveSeen(events: readonly ResearchEvent[], at: number): Promise<void> {
+    this.fail('saveSeen');
+    for (const event of events) {
+      const firstSeen = this.rows.get(event.id)?.firstSeen ?? at;
+      this.rows.set(event.id, { ...event, firstSeen, lastSeen: at });
+    }
+    return Promise.resolve();
+  }
+
+  removeEnded(before: number): Promise<number> {
+    this.fail('removeEnded');
+    let gone = 0;
+    for (const [id, event] of this.rows) {
+      if (event.end < before) {
+        this.rows.delete(id);
+        gone += 1;
+      }
+    }
+    return Promise.resolve(gone);
+  }
+}
+
+/** The kept task list in memory (`ResearchTaskStorage`), the twin of `ResearchTaskRepository`. */
+export class MemoryResearchTasks implements ResearchTaskStorage {
+  readonly rows = new Map<
+    string,
+    { task: ResearchTask; firstSeen: number; lastSeen: number; active: boolean; position: number }
+  >();
+  readonly failing = new Map<keyof ResearchTaskStorage, Error>();
+
+  private fail(method: keyof ResearchTaskStorage): void {
+    const err = this.failing.get(method);
+    if (err) throw err;
+  }
+
+  kept(): Promise<KeptTaskList> {
+    this.fail('kept');
+    const active = [...this.rows.values()]
+      .filter((row) => row.active)
+      .sort((a, b) => a.position - b.position || a.task.key.localeCompare(b.task.key));
+    const readAt = active.length === 0 ? undefined : Math.max(...active.map((row) => row.lastSeen));
+    return Promise.resolve({ tasks: active.map((row) => structuredClone(row.task)), readAt });
+  }
+
+  replace(tasks: readonly ResearchTask[], at: number): Promise<void> {
+    this.fail('replace');
+    for (const row of this.rows.values()) row.active = false;
+    for (const [position, task] of tasks.entries()) {
+      const firstSeen = this.rows.get(task.key)?.firstSeen ?? at;
+      this.rows.set(task.key, {
+        task: structuredClone(task),
+        firstSeen,
+        lastSeen: at,
+        active: true,
+        position,
+      });
+    }
+    return Promise.resolve();
+  }
+}
diff --git a/test/support/stop-report-cases.ts b/test/support/stop-report-cases.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..3ed11b5c61d60ae98ab03be0a12bbfbc56889fcc
--- /dev/null
+++ b/test/support/stop-report-cases.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,143 @@
+import { expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import type { StopReportStorage } from '../../src/db/repositories/stop-report-repository.js';
+import type { NewStopReport, ReportedStop } from '../../src/domain/stops/report.js';
+import { taskKeyOf, type TaskReward } from '../../src/domain/research/task.js';
+
+/** When the reports of these cases are made (2026-10-21 10:00 in New York). */
+export const REPORT_NOW = Date.UTC(2026, 9, 21, 14);
+/** Local midnight after `REPORT_NOW` in New York: the end of the day's period. */
+export const REPORT_MIDNIGHT = Date.UTC(2026, 9, 22, 4);
+export const REPORT_SERVER = '100000000000000001';
+export const OTHER_SERVER = '100000000000000002';
+export const REPORTER = { id: '200000000000000031', name: 'Brock' };
+export const OTHER_REPORTER = { id: '200000000000000032', name: 'Misty' };
+
+/** The Dratini reward of "Make 2 Excellent Throws", as the page lists it. */
+export const DRATINI: TaskReward = {
+  kind: 'encounter',
+  name: 'Dratini',
+  key: 'dratini',
+  dex: 147,
+  shiny: true,
+  cp: { min: 397, max: 430 },
+  image: 'https://cdn.leekduck.com/assets/img/pokemon_icons_crop/pm147.icon.png',
+};
+
+/** An invented stop: a kept Wayspot by its key (`n` makes another). */
+export function reportedStop(n = 1, overrides: Partial<ReportedStop> = {}): ReportedStop {
+  return {
+    key: `${String(n).padStart(32, 'a')}.16`,
+    name: `Yellow Mural ${String(n)}`,
+    address: 'Market Street',
+    image: null,
+    lat: 40.44 + n / 10_000,
+    lon: -79.99,
+    ...overrides,
+  };
+}
+
+/** A report of "Make 2 Excellent Throws" (Dratini) by Brock at stop 1, in the day's period. */
+export function researchReport(overrides: Partial<NewStopReport> = {}): NewStopReport {
+  const text = 'Make 2 Excellent Throws';
+  return {
+    serverId: REPORT_SERVER,
+    kind: 'research',
+    stop: reportedStop(),
+    periodKey: 'day:2026-10-21',
+    endsAt: REPORT_MIDNIGHT,
+    subjectKey: taskKeyOf(text),
+    research: { text, category: 'Throwing', rewards: [DRATINI], typed: false },
+    reporter: REPORTER,
+    madeAt: REPORT_NOW,
+    ...overrides,
+  };
+}
+
+/**
+ * What the reports at stops do, run against the repository and its twin in memory alike. `made`
+ * gives a fresh, empty store.
+ */
+export function stopReportCases(made: () => Promise<StopReportStorage>): void {
+  it('keeps a report and reads it back by id and among the standing ones', async () => {
+    const store = await made();
+    const { report, replaced } = await store.save(researchReport());
+    expect(replaced).toBeUndefined();
+    expect(report).toEqual({ ...researchReport(), id: report.id });
+    expect(await store.byId(report.id)).toEqual(report);
+    expect(await store.standing(REPORT_SERVER, REPORT_NOW)).toEqual([report]);
+    expect(await store.standing(OTHER_SERVER, REPORT_NOW)).toEqual([]);
+    expect(await store.serversStanding(REPORT_NOW)).toEqual([REPORT_SERVER]);
+  });
+
+  it('replaces the report of the same server, stop, kind and period, whoever made it', async () => {
+    const store = await made();
+    const first = await store.save(researchReport());
+    const text = 'Catch 7 Pokémon';
+    const second = await store.save(
+      researchReport({
+        subjectKey: taskKeyOf(text),
+        research: { text, category: 'Catching', rewards: [], typed: false },
+        reporter: OTHER_REPORTER,
+        madeAt: REPORT_NOW + 60_000,
+      }),
+    );
+    expect(second.replaced).toEqual(first.report);
+    // An id never changes what it is: the replacement is a report of its own, the replaced one
+    // gone (an old answer's Take back finds nothing).
+    expect(second.report.id).not.toBe(first.report.id);
+    expect(await store.byId(first.report.id)).toBeUndefined();
+    expect(await store.remove(first.report.id, REPORT_SERVER)).toBeUndefined();
+    expect(await store.standing(REPORT_SERVER, REPORT_NOW)).toEqual([second.report]);
+  });
+
+  it('keeps reports of other stops, periods and servers apart', async () => {
+    const store = await made();
+    const one = await store.save(researchReport());
+    const otherStop = await store.save(researchReport({ stop: reportedStop(2) }));
+    const otherPeriod = await store.save(
+      researchReport({ periodKey: 'event:november-communityday2026' }),
+    );
+    const otherServer = await store.save(researchReport({ serverId: OTHER_SERVER }));
+    for (const saved of [otherStop, otherPeriod, otherServer])
+      expect(saved.replaced).toBeUndefined();
+    expect((await store.standing(REPORT_SERVER, REPORT_NOW)).map((r) => r.id)).toEqual([
+      one.report.id,
+      otherStop.report.id,
+      otherPeriod.report.id,
+    ]);
+    expect(await store.serversStanding(REPORT_NOW)).toEqual([REPORT_SERVER, OTHER_SERVER].sort());
+  });
+
+  it('stands until its end, and is forgotten once ended', async () => {
+    const store = await made();
+    const { report } = await store.save(researchReport());
+    expect(await store.standing(REPORT_SERVER, REPORT_MIDNIGHT - 1)).toEqual([report]);
+    expect(await store.standing(REPORT_SERVER, REPORT_MIDNIGHT)).toEqual([]);
+    expect(await store.removeEnded(REPORT_MIDNIGHT - 1)).toBe(0);
+    expect(await store.removeEnded(REPORT_MIDNIGHT)).toBe(1);
+    expect(await store.byId(report.id)).toBeUndefined();
+  });
+
+  it('takes back a report of its own server only, once', async () => {
+    const store = await made();
+    const { report } = await store.save(researchReport());
+    expect(await store.remove(report.id, OTHER_SERVER)).toBeUndefined();
+    expect(await store.remove(report.id, REPORT_SERVER)).toEqual(report);
+    expect(await store.remove(report.id, REPORT_SERVER)).toBeUndefined();
+    expect(await store.standing(REPORT_SERVER, REPORT_NOW)).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it('keeps a typed task with its typed reward and no category', async () => {
+    const store = await made();
+    const text = 'Win 3 raids in the rain';
+    const { report } = await store.save(
+      researchReport({
+        subjectKey: `typed:${taskKeyOf(text)}`,
+        research: { text, category: null, rewards: [DRATINI], typed: true },
+      }),
+    );
+    expect(await store.byId(report.id)).toMatchObject({
+      research: { text, category: null, typed: true, rewards: [DRATINI] },
+    });
+  });
+}

diff --git a/test/support/stop-reports.ts b/test/support/stop-reports.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..e09b96cba1286ecbce64605e241d3225f29eb5ec
--- /dev/null
+++ b/test/support/stop-reports.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,88 @@
+import type {
+  SavedStopReport,
+  StopReportStorage,
+} from '../../src/db/repositories/stop-report-repository.js';
+import type { NewStopReport, StopReport } from '../../src/domain/stops/report.js';
+
+/** Methods a test can make fail (`failing`). */
+type Method = keyof StopReportStorage;
+
+/**
+ * The reports at stops in memory (`StopReportStorage`), for tests: the twin of
+ * `StopReportRepository`, running `stopReportCases` as it does. `rows` are the kept reports by
+ * id; `failing` makes a method reject with the error given.
+ */
+export class MemoryStopReports implements StopReportStorage {
+  readonly rows = new Map<number, StopReport>();
+  readonly failing = new Map<Method, Error>();
+  private nextId = 1;
+
+  private fail(method: Method): void {
+    const err = this.failing.get(method);
+    if (err) throw err;
+  }
+
+  save(report: NewStopReport): Promise<SavedStopReport> {
+    this.fail('save');
+    const before = [...this.rows.values()].find(
+      (row) =>
+        row.serverId === report.serverId &&
+        row.stop.key === report.stop.key &&
+        row.kind === report.kind &&
+        row.periodKey === report.periodKey,
+    );
+    // A replacement is a report of its own: the replaced one's id is gone for good.
+    if (before) this.rows.delete(before.id);
+    const id = this.nextId++;
+    const kept: StopReport = structuredClone({ ...report, id });
+    this.rows.set(id, kept);
+    return Promise.resolve({ report: structuredClone(kept), replaced: before });
+  }
+
+  byId(id: number): Promise<StopReport | undefined> {
+    this.fail('byId');
+    const row = this.rows.get(id);
+    return Promise.resolve(row && structuredClone(row));
+  }
+
+  standing(serverId: string, now: number): Promise<StopReport[]> {
+    this.fail('standing');
+    return Promise.resolve(
+      [...this.rows.values()]
+        .filter((row) => row.serverId === serverId && row.endsAt > now)
+        .sort((a, b) => a.madeAt - b.madeAt || a.id - b.id)
+        .map((row) => structuredClone(row)),
+    );
+  }
+
+  serversStanding(now: number): Promise<string[]> {
+    this.fail('serversStanding');
+    return Promise.resolve(
+      [
+        ...new Set(
+          [...this.rows.values()].filter((row) => row.endsAt > now).map((row) => row.serverId),
+        ),
+      ].sort(),
+    );
+  }
+
+  remove(id: number, serverId: string): Promise<StopReport | undefined> {
+    this.fail('remove');
+    const row = this.rows.get(id);
+    if (row?.serverId !== serverId) return Promise.resolve(undefined);
+    this.rows.delete(id);
+    return Promise.resolve(row);
+  }
+
+  removeEnded(before: number): Promise<number> {
+    this.fail('removeEnded');
+    let gone = 0;
+    for (const [id, row] of this.rows) {
+      if (row.endsAt <= before) {
+        this.rows.delete(id);
+        gone += 1;
+      }
+    }
+    return Promise.resolve(gone);
+  }
+}
diff --git a/test/support/target-want-cases.ts b/test/support/target-want-cases.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..a7d639bc22808ca8206bfb375c2fdd460fcf38d0

+import { expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import type { TargetWantStorage } from '../../src/db/repositories/target-want-repository.js';
+import { boxTarget, type TargetWant } from '../../src/domain/notify/target-wants.js';
+
+export const WANT_SERVER = '100000000000000011';
+export const OTHER_WANT_SERVER = '100000000000000012';
+export const ASH = '200000000000000041';
+export const GARY = '200000000000000042';
+export const WANTED_AT = Date.UTC(2026, 9, 21, 12);
+
+export const DRATINI_RESEARCH = boxTarget('research-pokemon', 147);
+export const ALOLAN_VULPIX_RESEARCH = boxTarget('research-pokemon', 37, 'vulpix_alola');
+export const RARE_CANDY: TargetWant = { kind: 'research-item', item: 'rare-candy' };
+export const CHARIZARD_ENERGY: TargetWant = { kind: 'research-energy', dex: 6 };
+export const MACHAMP_DYNAMAX = boxTarget('dynamax', 68);
+export const MACHAMP_GIGANTAMAX = boxTarget('gigantamax', 68);
+
+/**
+ * What the wants of `TargetWant` do, run against the repository and its twin in memory alike.
+ * `made` gives a fresh, empty store.
+ */
+export function targetWantCases(made: () => Promise<TargetWantStorage>): void {
+  it('adds targets once each, lists them in the order made, and counts them', async () => {
+    const store = await made();
+    await store.change(
+      ASH,
+      WANT_SERVER,
+      { add: [DRATINI_RESEARCH, RARE_CANDY], remove: [] },
+      WANTED_AT,
+    );
+    await store.change(
+      ASH,
+      WANT_SERVER,
+      { add: [RARE_CANDY, MACHAMP_DYNAMAX], remove: [] },
+      WANTED_AT + 1,
+    );
+    expect(await store.list(ASH, WANT_SERVER)).toEqual({
+      wants: [DRATINI_RESEARCH, RARE_CANDY, MACHAMP_DYNAMAX],
+      unreadable: 0,
+    });
+    expect(await store.count(ASH, WANT_SERVER)).toBe(3);
+    expect(await store.list(ASH, OTHER_WANT_SERVER)).toEqual({ wants: [], unreadable: 0 });
+    expect(await store.list(GARY, WANT_SERVER)).toEqual({ wants: [], unreadable: 0 });
+  });
+
+  it('reads only the targets asked for, and a species apart from its form', async () => {
+    const store = await made();
+    await store.change(
+      ASH,
+      WANT_SERVER,
+      { add: [ALOLAN_VULPIX_RESEARCH, MACHAMP_GIGANTAMAX, CHARIZARD_ENERGY], remove: [] },
+      WANTED_AT,
+    );
+    expect(
+      await store.of(ASH, WANT_SERVER, [boxTarget('research-pokemon', 37), MACHAMP_GIGANTAMAX]),
+    ).toEqual([MACHAMP_GIGANTAMAX]);
+    expect(await store.of(ASH, WANT_SERVER, [])).toEqual([]);
+    expect(await store.of(GARY, WANT_SERVER, [MACHAMP_GIGANTAMAX])).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it('adds and removes in one change, and removing what is not there is no error', async () => {
+    const store = await made();
+    await store.change(
+      ASH,
+      WANT_SERVER,
+      { add: [DRATINI_RESEARCH, MACHAMP_DYNAMAX], remove: [] },
+      WANTED_AT,
+    );
+    await store.change(
+      ASH,
+      WANT_SERVER,
+      { add: [MACHAMP_GIGANTAMAX], remove: [MACHAMP_DYNAMAX, RARE_CANDY] },
+      WANTED_AT,
+    );
+    expect((await store.list(ASH, WANT_SERVER)).wants).toEqual([
+      DRATINI_RESEARCH,
+      MACHAMP_GIGANTAMAX,
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('removes one target, and all of a member in a server', async () => {
+    const store = await made();
+    await store.change(
+      ASH,
+      WANT_SERVER,
+      { add: [DRATINI_RESEARCH, RARE_CANDY], remove: [] },
+      WANTED_AT,
+    );
+    await store.change(ASH, OTHER_WANT_SERVER, { add: [RARE_CANDY], remove: [] }, WANTED_AT);
+    expect(await store.remove(ASH, WANT_SERVER, RARE_CANDY)).toBe(true);
+    expect(await store.remove(ASH, WANT_SERVER, RARE_CANDY)).toBe(false);
+    expect(await store.remove(GARY, WANT_SERVER, RARE_CANDY)).toBe(false);
+    expect(await store.removeAll(ASH, WANT_SERVER)).toBe(1);
+    expect(await store.removeAll(ASH, WANT_SERVER)).toBe(0);
+    expect((await store.list(ASH, OTHER_WANT_SERVER)).wants).toEqual([RARE_CANDY]);
+  });
+
+  it('finds who wants which of the targets in a server', async () => {
+    const store = await made();
+    await store.change(
+      ASH,
+      WANT_SERVER,
+      { add: [DRATINI_RESEARCH, RARE_CANDY], remove: [] },
+      WANTED_AT,
+    );
+    await store.change(GARY, WANT_SERVER, { add: [RARE_CANDY], remove: [] }, WANTED_AT);
+    await store.change(GARY, OTHER_WANT_SERVER, { add: [DRATINI_RESEARCH], remove: [] }, WANTED_AT);
+    const found = await store.wanting(WANT_SERVER, [
+      DRATINI_RESEARCH,
+      RARE_CANDY,
+      CHARIZARD_ENERGY,
+    ]);
+    expect(found.sort((a, b) => a.memberId.localeCompare(b.memberId))).toEqual([
+      { memberId: ASH, wants: [DRATINI_RESEARCH, RARE_CANDY] },
+      { memberId: GARY, wants: [RARE_CANDY] },
+    ]);
+    expect(await store.wanting(WANT_SERVER, [])).toEqual([]);
+  });
+}

diff --git a/test/support/target-wants.ts b/test/support/target-wants.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..49a217d8ad14e45c3572f50e7572c44cb6cfb63b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/test/support/target-wants.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,110 @@
+import type {
+  MemberTargetWants,
+  TargetWantList,
+  TargetWantStorage,
+} from '../../src/db/repositories/target-want-repository.js';
+import {
+  parseTargetWantToken,
+  targetWantToken,
+  type TargetWant,
+} from '../../src/domain/notify/target-wants.js';
+
+/** Methods a test can make fail (`failing`). */
+type Method = keyof TargetWantStorage;
+
+/**
+ * The wants of `TargetWant` in memory, for tests: the twin of `TargetWantRepository`, running
+ * `targetWantCases` as it does. `rows` holds each member's tokens by server and member
+ * (`<server> <member>`), in the order they were made: a test may put a token there that this
+ * version cannot read. `failing` makes a method reject with the error given.
+ */
+export class MemoryTargetWants implements TargetWantStorage {
+  readonly rows = new Map<string, string[]>();
+  readonly failing = new Map<Method, Error>();
+
+  private fail(method: Method): void {
+    const err = this.failing.get(method);
+    if (err) throw err;
+  }
+
+  private tokensOf(memberId: string, guildId: string): string[] {
+    return this.rows.get(`${guildId} ${memberId}`) ?? [];
+  }
+
+  list(memberId: string, guildId: string): Promise<TargetWantList> {
+    this.fail('list');
+    const tokens = this.tokensOf(memberId, guildId);
+    const wants = tokens.flatMap((token) => parseTargetWantToken(token) ?? []);
+    return Promise.resolve({ wants, unreadable: tokens.length - wants.length });
+  }
+
+  of(memberId: string, guildId: string, targets: readonly TargetWant[]): Promise<TargetWant[]> {
+    this.fail('of');
+    const asked = new Set(targets.map(targetWantToken));
+    return Promise.resolve(
+      this.tokensOf(memberId, guildId)
+        .filter((token) => asked.has(token))
+        .flatMap((token) => parseTargetWantToken(token) ?? []),
+    );
+  }
+
+  change(
+    memberId: string,
+    guildId: string,
+    change: { add: readonly TargetWant[]; remove: readonly TargetWant[] },
+  ): Promise<void> {
+    this.fail('change');
+    const removed = new Set(change.remove.map(targetWantToken));
+    const kept = this.tokensOf(memberId, guildId).filter((token) => !removed.has(token));
+    for (const token of change.add.map(targetWantToken)) {
+      if (!kept.includes(token)) kept.push(token);
+    }
+    this.set(memberId, guildId, kept);
+    return Promise.resolve();
+  }
+
+  private set(memberId: string, guildId: string, tokens: string[]): void {
+    if (tokens.length === 0) this.rows.delete(`${guildId} ${memberId}`);
+    else this.rows.set(`${guildId} ${memberId}`, tokens);
+  }
+
+  remove(memberId: string, guildId: string, want: TargetWant): Promise<boolean> {
+    this.fail('remove');
+    const token = targetWantToken(want);
+    const tokens = this.tokensOf(memberId, guildId);
+    if (!tokens.includes(token)) return Promise.resolve(false);
+    this.set(
+      memberId,
+      guildId,
+      tokens.filter((one) => one !== token),
+    );
+    return Promise.resolve(true);
+  }
+
+  removeAll(memberId: string, guildId: string): Promise<number> {
+    this.fail('removeAll');
+    const n = this.tokensOf(memberId, guildId).length;
+    this.set(memberId, guildId, []);
+    return Promise.resolve(n);
+  }
+
+  count(memberId: string, guildId: string): Promise<number> {
+    this.fail('count');
+    return Promise.resolve(this.tokensOf(memberId, guildId).length);
+  }
+
+  wanting(guildId: string, targets: readonly TargetWant[]): Promise<MemberTargetWants[]> {
+    this.fail('wanting');
+    const asked = new Set(targets.map(targetWantToken));
+    const found: MemberTargetWants[] = [];
+    for (const [key, tokens] of this.rows) {
+      const [server, memberId] = key.split(' ');
+      if (server !== guildId || memberId === undefined) continue;
+      const wants = tokens
+        .filter((token) => asked.has(token))
+        .flatMap((token) => parseTargetWantToken(token) ?? []);
+      if (wants.length > 0) found.push({ memberId, wants });
+    }
+    return Promise.resolve(found);
+  }
+}
````

### Task 2: 8R-1 task 2: PokéStops of Pine's own, /pokestop

Prototype commit: `7ef8b486267428d6a4c8c8d6db9b924719048af8`

Sponsored stops Wayfarer lacks are staff's to add per server: /pokestop
add name: at: [address:], edit and remove, shaped like /gym add. Within 30
meters of a PokéStop (an imported one or one of the server's own) add asks
"Add anyway?" with the stops near; a place in no region of the server is
refused.

PineStopService keeps them in PineStop and in memory and gives them to
WayspotDirectory, which holds them beside the kept Wayspots as PokéStops by
the key pine-<id>, each in its own server's regions only: every stop search
(PlaceFinder: /wild near:, /meetup, pin names) finds them, a choice's value
stop:pine-<id> reads back, and each change bumps the directory's
generations, so the search indexes, the region editor (which shows only the
server's own) and the map build anew. A load of the imports leaves them.

The Wayfarer import's preview names the server's stops of Pine's own that
lie within 30 meters of a PokéStop of the export, for staff to remove.

````diff
+    expect(await made.offered('fountain coffee', 'near')).toContainEqual({
+      name: 'Fountain Coffee (PokéStop) · Market Street',
+      value: 'stop:pine-1',
+    });
+    await made.run({ pokemon: 'dratini', near: 'stop:pine-1' });
+    expect(textDisplays(made.reports()[0]?.message)[1]).toBe(
+      '**Where**\nby the fountain\nNear **Fountain Coffee** (PokéStop) · 12 Market Street · ' +
+        '[Map](<https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=40.07%2C-80.07>)',
+    );
+  });
+
   it('says the address of a gym, and that a power spot without one has none', async () => {
     const made = await withWayspots();
     await made.run({ pokemon: 'dratini', near: 'gym:2' });
diff --git a/src/commands/stops/pokestop.test.ts b/src/commands/stops/pokestop.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..4da989d618a3a0613dc4f0b3b7867767f4e8a427
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/commands/stops/pokestop.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,155 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import { choicesOf } from '../../../test/support/boss-commands.js';
+import { answerOf, buttonId, buttonsOf, said } from '../../../test/support/gym-commands.js';
+import { gymAdminWith } from '../../../test/support/gym-admin.js';
+import {
+  fakeAutocomplete,
+  fakeButton,
+  fakeChatInput,
+  FAKE_GUILD_ID,
+  type FakeInteraction,
+  type FakeOptions,
+} from '../../../test/support/fake-interactions.js';
+import { WEST_CHANNEL } from '../../../test/support/gyms.js';
+import { MemoryPineStops } from '../../../test/support/pine-stops.js';
+import { createTestContext } from '../../../test/support/test-context.js';
+import { keptRow } from '../../../test/support/wayspot-cases.js';
+import { wayspotsWith } from '../../../test/support/wayspots.js';
+import { InteractionRouter } from '../../discord/router.js';
+import { PineStopService } from '../../services/pine-stops.js';
+import { PlaceFinder } from '../../services/place-finder.js';
+import { NO_SUCH_STOP, pokestop, pokestopControls, STOP_NOT_HERE } from './pokestop.js';
+
+const MODERATOR = '200000000000000009';
+
+/** `/pokestop` routed as in the bot, used by a moderator in West, with a kept stop in West. */
+async function setup() {
+  const { admin } = await gymAdminWith();
+  const { wayspots } = await wayspotsWith([
+    keptRow(1, { title: 'Yellow Mural', lat: 40.06, lon: -80.06 }),
+  ]);
+  const stored = new MemoryPineStops();
+  const { ctx } = createTestContext({ gymAdmin: admin, wayspots });
+  const pineStops = new PineStopService({
+    storage: stored,
+    wayspots,
+    guilds: ctx.guilds,
+    log: ctx.log,
+  });
+  Object.assign(ctx, {
+    pineStops,
+    placeFinder: new PlaceFinder({ gyms: ctx.gyms, wayspots, regions: ctx.regions, log: ctx.log }),
+  });
+  await pineStops.load();
+  const router = new InteractionRouter(ctx, [pokestop], [pokestopControls]);
+  const staff: FakeOptions = {
+    userId: MODERATOR,
+    roleNames: ['Moderator'],
+    channelId: WEST_CHANNEL,
+    guildId: FAKE_GUILD_ID,
+  };
+  const handled = async (interaction: FakeInteraction) => {
+    await router.handle(interaction as never);
+    return interaction;
+  };
+  return {
+    ctx,
+    stored,
+    pineStops,
+    use: (subcommand: string, options: Record<string, string>, extra: FakeOptions = {}) =>
+      handled(fakeChatInput({ commandName: 'pokestop', subcommand, options, ...staff, ...extra })),
+    press: (customId: string, extra: FakeOptions = {}) =>
+      handled(
+        fakeButton({ customId, v2Message: true, ephemeralMessage: true, ...staff, ...extra }),
+      ),
+    typing: (subcommand: string, focused: string) =>
+      handled(
+        fakeAutocomplete({
+          commandName: 'pokestop',
+          subcommand,
+          focused,
+          focusedName: 'stop',
+          ...staff,
+        }),
+      ),
+  };
+}
+
+describe('/pokestop', () => {
+  it('adds a stop in the server’s regions at once where no PokéStop is near', async () => {
+    const { use, stored, ctx } = await setup();
+    const answered = answerOf(
+      await use('add', {
+        name: '  Coffee   Corner ',
+        at: '40.0701, -80.0701',
+        address: '12 Market Street',
+      }),
+    );
+    expect(said(answered)).toContain('Added the PokéStop **Coffee Corner** (`pine-1`)');
+    expect(said(answered)).toContain(`It lies in <#${WEST_CHANNEL}>.`);
+    expect([...stored.rows.values()]).toMatchObject([
+      { name: 'Coffee Corner', address: '12 Market Street', lat: 40.0701, lon: -80.0701 },
+    ]);
+    await ctx.placeFinder.built();
+    expect(
+      ctx.placeFinder.find(1, WEST_CHANNEL, 'coffee corner', ['stop']).map((one) => one.id),
+    ).toEqual(['pine-1']);
+  });
+
+  it('asks before adding a stop within 30 meters of a PokéStop, and adds it on Add anyway', async () => {
+    const { use, press, stored } = await setup();
+    const question = answerOf(await use('add', { name: 'Mural Café', at: '40.0601, -80.0601' }));
+    expect(said(question)).toContain('Add the PokéStop **Mural Café**');
+    expect(said(question)).toContain('A PokéStop lies within 30 meters of that place:');
+    expect(said(question)).toContain('**Yellow Mural**, 14 m away');
+    expect(buttonsOf(question).map(([label]) => label)).toEqual(['Add anyway', 'Cancel']);
+    expect(stored.rows.size).toBe(0);
+
+    const added = answerOf(await press(buttonId(question, 'Add anyway')));
+    expect(said(added)).toContain('Added the PokéStop **Mural Café** (`pine-1`)');
+    expect(stored.rows.size).toBe(1);
+    // Answered once.
+    const again = await press(buttonId(question, 'Add anyway'));
+    expect(said(answerOf(again))).toContain('expired');
+    expect(stored.rows.size).toBe(1);
+  });
+
+  it('adds nothing on Cancel', async () => {
+    const { use, press, stored } = await setup();
+    const question = answerOf(await use('add', { name: 'Mural Café', at: '40.0601, -80.0601' }));
+    expect(said(answerOf(await press(buttonId(question, 'Cancel'))))).toBe(
+      'Cancelled: nothing was added.',
+    );
+    expect(stored.rows.size).toBe(0);
+  });
+
+  it('refuses a place in no region of the server, and a blank name', async () => {
+    const { use, stored } = await setup();
+    expect(said(answerOf(await use('add', { name: 'Far', at: '40.9, -80.9' })))).toBe(
+      STOP_NOT_HERE,
+    );
+    expect(said(answerOf(await use('add', { name: '  ', at: '40.07, -80.07' })))).toBe(
+      'A PokéStop needs a name.',
+    );
+    expect(stored.rows.size).toBe(0);
+  });
+
+  it('offers, changes and removes the server’s own stops', async () => {
+    const { use, typing, stored, ctx } = await setup();
+    await use('add', { name: 'Coffee Corner', at: '40.0701, -80.0701' });
+    await use('add', { name: 'Tea House', at: '40.075, -80.075', address: 'Elm Street' });
+    expect(choicesOf(await typing('edit', 'tea'))).toEqual([
+      { name: 'Tea House · Elm Street', value: 'pine-2' },
+    ]);
+    const changed = answerOf(await use('edit', { stop: 'pine-2', name: 'Tea Room', address: '-' }));
+    expect(said(changed)).toContain('Changed the PokéStop **Tea Room** (`pine-2`)');
+    expect(stored.rows.get(2)).toMatchObject({ name: 'Tea Room', address: null });
+    expect(said(answerOf(await use('remove', { stop: 'coffee corner' })))).toContain(
+      'Removed the PokéStop **Coffee Corner** (`pine-1`)',
+    );
+    expect(said(answerOf(await use('remove', { stop: 'pine-1' })))).toBe(NO_SUCH_STOP);
+    expect([...stored.rows.keys()]).toEqual([2]);
+    await ctx.placeFinder.built();
+    expect(ctx.placeFinder.find(1, WEST_CHANNEL, 'coffee')).toEqual([]);
+  });
+});
diff --git a/src/commands/stops/pokestop.ts b/src/commands/stops/pokestop.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..74b6e2ff06fa4191cb005e4c1707534aa38fd03b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/commands/stops/pokestop.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,420 @@
+import {
+  ButtonStyle,
+  ComponentType,
+  PermissionFlagsBits,
+  SlashCommandBuilder,
+  SlashCommandSubcommandBuilder,
+  type APIButtonComponentWithCustomId,
+  type SlashCommandStringOption,
+} from 'discord.js';
+import { ringContains } from '@pine/wayspot-core/region-membership';
+import type { LatLon } from '@pine/wayspot-core/lat-lon';
+import type { AppContext } from '../../app-context.js';
+import type { ComponentHandler, LocatedInteraction } from '../../discord/command.js';
+import { commandGroup, type SubcommandPart } from '../../discord/command-group.js';
+import { encodeCustomId } from '../../discord/custom-id.js';
+import { UserError } from '../../discord/errors.js';
+import { guildIdOf, requireBotManagement } from '../../discord/guards.js';
+import { answerApart, showInPlace } from '../../discord/late-reply.js';
+import type { V2Message } from '../../discord/party-gateway.js';
+import { STALE_COMPONENT } from '../../discord/router.js';
+import { tidyLine } from '../../domain/gyms/gym-text.js';
+import {
+  MAX_PINE_STOP_ADDRESS,
+  MAX_PINE_STOP_NAME,
+  type PineStop,
+  type PineStopChange,
+} from '../../domain/stops/pine-stop.js';
+import { pineStopKey } from '../../domain/stops/report.js';
+import { distanceText, GYM_COLOUR, regionsSentence } from '../../render/gym-view.js';
+import { count, plain, truncate } from '../../render/text.js';
+import { actionRow, textMessage } from '../../render/v2.js';
+import { EXPIRED, NOT_YOURS, PendingRequests } from '../../services/pending-requests.js';
+import { PINE_STOP_NEAR_METRES } from '../../services/pine-stops.js';
+import { beginningFirst, CHOICE_NAME, MAX_CHOICES, type Choice } from '../choices.js';
+import { LOCATION_OPTION, placeOrRefuse, pointLink } from '../gyms/shared.js';
+
+/** The custom-id kind of the question of `/pokestop add`: `pokestop:<token>:add|cancel`. */
+export const POKESTOP_KIND = 'pokestop';
+
+/** What `/pokestop add` keeps while it asks "Add anyway?". */
+interface PendingStop {
+  serverId: string;
+  name: string;
+  point: LatLon;
+  address: string | null;
+}
+
+/** The questions of `/pokestop add`, an hour (as long as staff might look elsewhere first). */
+const pendingStops = new PendingRequests<PendingStop>({ ttlMs: 60 * 60_000, max: 200 });
+
+/** Said of a place that lies in no region of the server. */
+export const STOP_NOT_HERE =
+  'That place lies in no region of this server: nobody here could report at a stop there.';
+
+/** Said of a `stop` that names no stop of Pine's own of this server. */
+export const NO_SUCH_STOP =
+  'I know no PokéStop of Pine’s own here by that name: pick one from the list that appears while ' +
+  'you type.';
+
+/** As many stops near a new one as the question names; the rest are counted. */
+const NEAR_SHOWN = 3;
+
+/** A stop of Pine's own as an answer names it: `**Coffee Corner** (pine-3)`. */
+function stopWithKey(stop: Pick<PineStop, 'id' | 'name'>): string {
+  return `**${plain(truncate(stop.name, MAX_PINE_STOP_NAME))}** (\`${pineStopKey(stop.id)}\`)`;
+}
+
+/** The regions of this server whose outlines hold a point. */
+async function regionsAt(
+  interaction: LocatedInteraction,
+  ctx: AppContext,
+  point: LatLon,
+): Promise<{ channelId: string }[]> {
+  const row = await ctx.guilds.idFor(guildIdOf(interaction));
+  return ctx.regions
+    .all()
+    .filter(
+      (region) =>
+        row !== undefined &&
+        region.guildId === row &&
+        region.bounds !== null &&
+        ringContains(region.bounds, point),
+    );
+}
+
+/** A name as staff typed it, tidied; refused when empty or too long. */
+function stopName(typed: string): string {
+  const name = tidyLine(typed);
+  if (name === '') throw new UserError('A PokéStop needs a name.');
+  if (name.length > MAX_PINE_STOP_NAME) {
+    throw new UserError(
+      `The name is too long: a PokéStop's name may have ${MAX_PINE_STOP_NAME} characters.`,
+    );
+  }
+  return name;
+}
+
+/** An address as staff typed it: `-` or `none` takes it away (null). */
+function stopAddress(typed: string): string | null {
+  const address = tidyLine(typed);
+  if (address === '' || address === '-' || address.toLowerCase() === 'none') return null;
+  if (address.length > MAX_PINE_STOP_ADDRESS) {
+    throw new UserError(
+      `The address is too long: it may have ${MAX_PINE_STOP_ADDRESS} characters.`,
+    );
+  }
+  return address;
+}
+
+/** A place staff typed, read as `/gym add` reads one, in a region of this server. */
+async function stopPlace(
+  interaction: LocatedInteraction,
+  ctx: AppContext,
+  typed: string,
+): Promise<{ point: LatLon; regions: { channelId: string }[] }> {
+  const { point } = placeOrRefuse(await ctx.gymAdmin.readLocation(typed));
+  const regions = await regionsAt(interaction, ctx, point);
+  if (regions.length === 0) throw new UserError(STOP_NOT_HERE);
+  return { point, regions };
+}
+
+function button(
+  token: string,
+  action: 'add' | 'cancel',
+  label: string,
+  style: ButtonStyle.Primary | ButtonStyle.Secondary,
+) {
+  const made: APIButtonComponentWithCustomId = {
+    type: ComponentType.Button,
+    custom_id: encodeCustomId({ kind: POKESTOP_KIND, id: token, action }),
+    label,
+    style,
+  };
+  return made;
+}
+
+/** What an added stop's answer says. */
+function addedMessage(stop: PineStop, regions: readonly { channelId: string }[]): V2Message {
+  return textMessage(GYM_COLOUR, [
+    `Added the PokéStop ${stopWithKey(stop)} at ${pointLink(stop)}. ${regionsSentence(regions)}`,
+    'Members find it in `/research`, `/wild near:` and `/meetup` from now on.',
+  ]);
+}
+
+/**
+ * `/pokestop add name: at: [address:]`: a sponsored stop (design 3). Within
+ * `PINE_STOP_NEAR_METRES` of a PokéStop (an imported one or one of Pine's own of this server) it
+ * asks "Add anyway?", as `/gym add` asks near a gym; otherwise it adds it at once.
+ */
+const addStop: SubcommandPart = {
+  data: new SlashCommandSubcommandBuilder()
+    .setName('add')
+    .setDescription('Add a PokéStop Wayfarer does not list (a sponsored one)')
+    .addStringOption((option) =>
+      option
+        .setName('name')
+        .setDescription('The name of the PokéStop, as in the game')
+        .setRequired(true)
+        .setMaxLength(MAX_PINE_STOP_NAME),
+    )
+    .addStringOption((option) =>
+      option.setName('at').setDescription(LOCATION_OPTION).setRequired(true).setMaxLength(1_000),
+    )
+    .addStringOption((option) =>
+      option
+        .setName('address')
+        .setDescription('Its street address, shown under its name')
+        .setMaxLength(MAX_PINE_STOP_ADDRESS),
+    ),
+  help: {
+    details:
+      'Adds a PokéStop that the Wayfarer export does not have (sponsored stops are missing there) ' +
+      'to this server. `at` is the link Pokémon GO shares for the stop, a maps link or ' +
+      'coordinates; it must lie in a region of this server. Members then find it wherever a ' +
+      `PokéStop is asked for. Within ${String(PINE_STOP_NEAR_METRES)} meters of another ` +
+      'PokéStop I ask before adding it: it may be listed already.',
+    examples: ['/pokestop add name:Coffee Corner at:40.4406, -79.9959 address:12 Market Street'],
+  },
+  // A short link is followed (`readLocation`), which may take a moment.
+  defer: 'ephemeral',
+  async execute(interaction, ctx) {
+    const name = stopName(interaction.options.getString('name', true));
+    const address = stopAddress(interaction.options.getString('address') ?? '');
+    const { point, regions } = await stopPlace(
+      interaction,
+      ctx,
+      interaction.options.getString('at', true),
+    );
+    const serverId = guildIdOf(interaction);
+    const near = ctx.pineStops.nearStops(point, serverId);
+    if (near.length === 0) {
+      const stop = await ctx.pineStops.add({
+        serverId,
+        name,
+        lat: point.lat,
+        lon: point.lon,
+        address,
+        createdBy: interaction.user.id,
+        createdAt: Date.now(),
+      });
+      await answerApart(interaction, addedMessage(stop, regions));
+      return;
+    }
+    const token = pendingStops.put(interaction.user.id, { serverId, name, point, address });
+    const listed = near
+      .slice(0, NEAR_SHOWN)
+      .map(
+        ({ wayspot, metres }) =>
+          `- **${plain(truncate(wayspot.title, 80))}**, ${distanceText(metres)} away`,
+      );
+    await answerApart(
+      interaction,
+      textMessage(
+        GYM_COLOUR,
+        [
+          `Add the PokéStop **${plain(name)}** at ${pointLink(point)}?`,
+          [
+            near.length === 1
+              ? `A PokéStop lies within ${String(PINE_STOP_NEAR_METRES)} meters of that place:`
+              : `${count(near.length, 'PokéStop')} lie within ${String(PINE_STOP_NEAR_METRES)} ` +
+                'meters of that place:',
+            ...listed,
+            ...(near.length > NEAR_SHOWN ? [`- …and ${near.length - NEAR_SHOWN} more`] : []),
+          ].join('\n'),
+        ],
+        [
+          actionRow([
+            button(token, 'add', 'Add anyway', ButtonStyle.Primary),
+            button(token, 'cancel', 'Cancel', ButtonStyle.Secondary),
+          ]),
+        ],
+      ),
+    );
+  },
+};
+
+/** The stop the `stop` option names, of this server. */
+function namedStop(interaction: LocatedInteraction, ctx: AppContext, value: string): PineStop {
+  const serverId = guildIdOf(interaction);
+  const typed = value.trim();
+  const byKey = ctx.pineStops.get(serverId, typed);
+  if (byKey) return byKey;
+  const byName = ctx.pineStops
+    .ofServer(serverId)
+    .filter((stop) => stop.name.toLowerCase() === typed.toLowerCase());
+  const [only] = byName;
+  if (only && byName.length === 1) return only;
+  throw new UserError(NO_SUCH_STOP);
+}
+
+/** The choices of the `stop` option: this server's stops of Pine's own that fit what was typed. */
+function stopChoices(interaction: LocatedInteraction, ctx: AppContext, typed: string): Choice[] {
+  if (!interaction.inGuild()) return [];
+  const text = typed.trim().toLowerCase();
+  return ctx.pineStops
+    .ofServer(guildIdOf(interaction))
+    .map((stop) => ({ stop, name: stop.name }))
+    .filter(({ name }) => text === '' || name.toLowerCase().includes(text))
+    .sort(beginningFirst(text))
+    .slice(0, MAX_CHOICES)
+    .map(({ stop }) => ({
+      name: truncate(
+        `${stop.name}${stop.address === null ? '' : ` · ${stop.address}`}`,
+        CHOICE_NAME,
+      ),
+      value: pineStopKey(stop.id),
+    }));
+}
+
+const stopOption = (option: SlashCommandStringOption) =>
+  option
+    .setName('stop')
+    .setDescription('A PokéStop of Pine’s own: pick from the list')
+    .setRequired(true)
+    .setMaxLength(MAX_PINE_STOP_NAME)
+    .setAutocomplete(true);
+
+/** `/pokestop edit stop: [name:] [at:] [address:]`. */
+const editStop: SubcommandPart = {
+  data: new SlashCommandSubcommandBuilder()
+    .setName('edit')
+    .setDescription('Change a PokéStop of Pine’s own')
+    .addStringOption(stopOption)
+    .addStringOption((option) =>
+      option.setName('name').setDescription('Its new name').setMaxLength(MAX_PINE_STOP_NAME),
+    )
+    .addStringOption((option) =>
+      option.setName('at').setDescription(LOCATION_OPTION).setMaxLength(1_000),
+    )
+    .addStringOption((option) =>
+      option
+        .setName('address')
+        .setDescription('Its new street address; - takes it away')
+        .setMaxLength(MAX_PINE_STOP_ADDRESS),
+    ),
+  help: {
+    details:
+      'Changes the name, the place or the address of a PokéStop added with `/pokestop add` ' +
+      '(`address:-` takes the address away). Reports made at it today keep it as it was.',
+    examples: ['/pokestop edit stop:Coffee Corner name:Corner Coffee'],
+  },
+  defer: 'ephemeral',
+  async execute(interaction, ctx) {
+    const stop = namedStop(interaction, ctx, interaction.options.getString('stop', true));
+    const change: PineStopChange = {};
+    const name = interaction.options.getString('name');
+    if (name !== null) change.name = stopName(name);
+    const address = interaction.options.getString('address');
+    if (address !== null) change.address = stopAddress(address);
+    const at = interaction.options.getString('at');
+    if (at !== null) {
+      const { point } = await stopPlace(interaction, ctx, at);
+      change.lat = point.lat;
+      change.lon = point.lon;
+    }
+    if (Object.keys(change).length === 0) {
+      throw new UserError('Say what to change: `name`, `at` or `address`.');
+    }
+    const changed = await ctx.pineStops.edit(
+      stop.id,
+      guildIdOf(interaction),
+      change,
+      interaction.user.id,
+      Date.now(),
+    );
+    if (!changed) throw new UserError(NO_SUCH_STOP);
+    await answerApart(
+      interaction,
+      textMessage(GYM_COLOUR, [
+        `Changed the PokéStop ${stopWithKey(changed)} at ${pointLink(changed)}` +
+          `${changed.address === null ? '' : `, ${plain(changed.address)}`}.`,
+      ]),
+    );
+  },
+  async autocomplete(interaction, ctx) {
+    await interaction.respond(stopChoices(interaction, ctx, interaction.options.getFocused()));
+  },
+};
+
+/** `/pokestop remove stop:`. */
+const removeStop: SubcommandPart = {
+  data: new SlashCommandSubcommandBuilder()
+    .setName('remove')
+    .setDescription('Remove a PokéStop of Pine’s own')
+    .addStringOption(stopOption),
+  help: {
+    details:
+      'Removes a PokéStop added with `/pokestop add` (one Wayfarer now lists, or one that is ' +
+      'gone). Reports made at it today stay until they end.',
+    examples: ['/pokestop remove stop:Coffee Corner'],
+  },
+  defer: 'ephemeral',
+  async execute(interaction, ctx) {
+    const stop = namedStop(interaction, ctx, interaction.options.getString('stop', true));
+    const removed = await ctx.pineStops.remove(
+      stop.id,
+      guildIdOf(interaction),
+      interaction.user.id,
+    );
+    if (!removed) throw new UserError(NO_SUCH_STOP);
+    await answerApart(
+      interaction,
+      textMessage(GYM_COLOUR, [
+        `Removed the PokéStop ${stopWithKey(removed)}. Reports made at it today stay until they end.`,
+      ]),
+    );
+  },
+  async autocomplete(interaction, ctx) {
+    await interaction.respond(stopChoices(interaction, ctx, interaction.options.getFocused()));
+  },
+};
+
+/**
+ * `/pokestop` (plan 8R-1; design 3, Matt's answer 8: not `/stop`, as trains have stops and DMs
+ * Stop buttons): the PokéStops of Pine's own, for staff, shaped like `/gym add`. Every answer is
+ * for the staff member alone.
+ */
+export const pokestop = commandGroup({
+  data: new SlashCommandBuilder()
+    .setName('pokestop')
+    .setDescription('Look after the PokéStops Wayfarer does not list')
+    .setDefaultMemberPermissions(PermissionFlagsBits.ManageGuild),
+  help: { category: 'admin' },
+  guards: [requireBotManagement],
+  parts: [addStop, editStop, removeStop],
+});
+
+/**
+ * The buttons of the question of `/pokestop add`: Add anyway adds the stop as asked (the near
+ * stops are not looked for again: staff saw them), Cancel says so; both in the question's place.
+ */
+export const pokestopControls: ComponentHandler = {
+  kind: POKESTOP_KIND,
+  guards: [requireBotManagement],
+  async button(interaction, id, ctx) {
+    if (id.action !== 'add' && id.action !== 'cancel') throw new UserError(STALE_COMPONENT);
+    const taken = pendingStops.take(id.id, interaction.user.id);
+    if (taken === 'expired') throw new UserError(EXPIRED);
+    if (taken === 'not-yours') throw new UserError(NOT_YOURS);
+    const request = taken.value;
+    if (id.action === 'cancel') {
+      await showInPlace(interaction, textMessage(GYM_COLOUR, ['Cancelled: nothing was added.']));
+      return;
+    }
+    await interaction.deferUpdate();
+    const stop = await ctx.pineStops.add({
+      serverId: request.serverId,
+      name: request.name,
+      lat: request.point.lat,
+      lon: request.point.lon,
+      address: request.address,
+      createdBy: interaction.user.id,
+      createdAt: Date.now(),
+    });
+    await showInPlace(
+      interaction,
+      addedMessage(stop, await regionsAt(interaction, ctx, request.point)),
+    );
+  },
+};

diff --git a/src/services/pine-stops.test.ts b/src/services/pine-stops.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..128367f2db5bb3cba2d1adb424d50e3b1d278de2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/services/pine-stops.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,107 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import { FAKE_GUILD_ID } from '../../test/support/fake-interactions.js';
+import { OTHER_GUILD_ID, WEST_CHANNEL } from '../../test/support/gyms.js';
+import { newPineStop, STAFF } from '../../test/support/pine-stop-cases.js';
+import { MemoryPineStops } from '../../test/support/pine-stops.js';
+import { gymsFixture, regionsFixture } from '../../test/support/providers.js';
+import { createTestLogger } from '../../test/support/test-logger.js';
+import { keptRow, wayspotId } from '../../test/support/wayspot-cases.js';
+import { wayspotsWith } from '../../test/support/wayspots.js';
+import { PineStopService } from './pine-stops.js';
+import { PlaceFinder, readPlaceValue } from './place-finder.js';
+
+/** A sponsored stop in West (server row 1), near a kept stop called Yellow Mural. */
+async function stopsWith(stored = new MemoryPineStops()) {
+  const { wayspots } = await wayspotsWith([
+    keptRow(1, { title: 'Yellow Mural', lat: 40.06, lon: -80.06 }),
+  ]);
+  const { log } = createTestLogger();
+  const stops = new PineStopService({
+    storage: stored,
+    wayspots,
+    guilds: {
+      idFor: (serverId) =>
+        Promise.resolve(
+          serverId === FAKE_GUILD_ID ? 1 : serverId === OTHER_GUILD_ID ? 2 : undefined,
+        ),
+    },
+    log,
+  });
+  const finder = new PlaceFinder({ gyms: gymsFixture(), wayspots, regions: regionsFixture(), log });
+  await stops.load();
+  await finder.built();
+  return { stored, stops, wayspots, finder };
+}
+
+const coffee = newPineStop({ serverId: FAKE_GUILD_ID, lat: 40.0601, lon: -80.0601 });
+
+describe('PineStopService', () => {
+  it('adds a stop that every stop search of its server finds, by value and as a pin’s name', async () => {
+    const { stops, finder, wayspots } = await stopsWith();
+    const generation = wayspots.generation;
+    const made = await stops.add(coffee);
+    expect(wayspots.generation).toBeGreaterThan(generation);
+    await finder.built();
+    const found = finder.find(1, WEST_CHANNEL, 'coffee corner', ['stop']);
+    expect(found.map((one) => [one.kind, one.id, one.title])).toEqual([
+      ['stop', `pine-${String(made.id)}`, 'Coffee Corner (sponsored)'],
+    ]);
+    expect(found[0]?.address).toBe('12 Market Street');
+    expect(readPlaceValue(`stop:pine-${String(made.id)}`)).toEqual({
+      kind: 'stop',
+      id: `pine-${String(made.id)}`,
+    });
+    expect(finder.chosen(1, `stop:pine-${String(made.id)}`)?.title).toBe(
+      'Coffee Corner (sponsored)',
+    );
+    expect(finder.pin(1, { lat: 40.0602, lon: -80.0601 }, null)?.near).toEqual({
+      kind: 'stop',
+      title: 'Coffee Corner (sponsored)',
+    });
+    // Another server finds none of it.
+    expect(finder.find(2, undefined, 'coffee corner')).toEqual([]);
+    expect(finder.chosen(2, `stop:pine-${String(made.id)}`)).toBeUndefined();
+  });
+
+  it('names the PokéStops a new stop of a server would stand beside: imported ones and its own', async () => {
+    const { stops } = await stopsWith();
+    await stops.add(newPineStop({ serverId: OTHER_GUILD_ID, lat: 40.06, lon: -80.0601 }));
+    const own = await stops.add(
+      newPineStop({ serverId: FAKE_GUILD_ID, lat: 40.06, lon: -80.0603 }),
+    );
+    const near = stops.nearStops({ lat: 40.06, lon: -80.0601 }, FAKE_GUILD_ID);
+    expect(near.map(({ wayspot }) => wayspot.id)).toEqual([wayspotId(1), `pine-${String(own.id)}`]);
+    expect(stops.nearStops({ lat: 40.07, lon: -80.07 }, FAKE_GUILD_ID)).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it('changes and removes a stop of its own server, and the search follows', async () => {
+    const { stops, finder } = await stopsWith();
+    const made = await stops.add(coffee);
+    expect(await stops.edit(made.id, OTHER_GUILD_ID, { name: 'Tea House' }, STAFF, 2)).toBe(
+      undefined,
+    );
+    await stops.edit(made.id, FAKE_GUILD_ID, { name: 'Tea House' }, STAFF, 2);
+    await finder.built();
+    expect(finder.find(1, WEST_CHANNEL, 'tea house').map((one) => one.title)).toEqual([
+      'Tea House',
+    ]);
+    expect(stops.get(FAKE_GUILD_ID, `pine-${String(made.id)}`)?.name).toBe('Tea House');
+    expect(stops.get(OTHER_GUILD_ID, made.id)).toBeUndefined();
+    expect(await stops.remove(made.id, FAKE_GUILD_ID, STAFF)).toMatchObject({ name: 'Tea House' });
+    await finder.built();
+    expect(finder.find(1, WEST_CHANNEL, 'tea house')).toEqual([]);
+    expect(stops.ofServer(FAKE_GUILD_ID)).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it('reads the stops kept at start', async () => {
+    const stored = new MemoryPineStops();
+    await stored.add(coffee);
+    const { stops, finder } = await stopsWith(stored);
+    expect(stops.ofServer(FAKE_GUILD_ID).map((stop) => stop.name)).toEqual([
+      'Coffee Corner (sponsored)',
+    ]);
+    expect(stops.ofGuildRow(1)).toHaveLength(1);
+    expect(stops.ofGuildRow(2)).toEqual([]);
+    expect(finder.find(1, WEST_CHANNEL, 'coffee', ['stop'])).toHaveLength(1);
+  });
+});
diff --git a/src/services/pine-stops.ts b/src/services/pine-stops.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..c7ed0eecf1b6e4403b78ff18f309ae0b8cb968c3
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/services/pine-stops.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,141 @@
+import type { LatLon } from '@pine/wayspot-core/lat-lon';
+import type { PineStopStorage } from '../db/repositories/pine-stop-repository.js';
+import type { NewPineStop, PineStop, PineStopChange } from '../domain/stops/pine-stop.js';
+import { pineStopIdOf } from '../domain/stops/report.js';
+import type { Logger } from '../log.js';
+import type { NearWayspot, PlacedPineStop, WayspotProvider } from './wayspot-directory.js';
+
+/**
+ * Within this many metres of a PokéStop, `/pokestop add` asks "Add anyway?" (design 3: as
+ * `/gym add` asks near a gym), and the Wayfarer import's preview names a stop of Pine's own
+ * near an imported one.
+ */
+export const PINE_STOP_NEAR_METRES = 30;
+
+export interface PineStopServiceOptions {
+  storage: PineStopStorage;
+  /** The directory that holds them beside the kept Wayspots (`setPineStops`) and finds stops near. */
+  wayspots: Pick<WayspotProvider, 'near'> & {
+    setPineStops(stops: readonly PlacedPineStop[]): void;
+  };
+  /** The row of a server in `Guild`, by its snowflake (`GuildRepository.idFor`). */
+  guilds: { idFor(serverId: string): Promise<number | undefined> };
+  log: Logger;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The stops of Pine's own (plan 8R-1; design 3, `/pokestop`): sponsored stops staff add by hand,
+ * per server, kept in `PineStop` and held in memory; after every change (and at start) they are
+ * given to `WayspotDirectory`, so that every stop search finds them (`PlaceFinder`), `/wild
+ * near:`, `/meetup` and the pins name them, and the region editor and the map build anew.
+ * Changes run one at a time.
+ */
+export class PineStopService {
+  private stops = new Map<number, PlacedPineStop>();
+  private queue: Promise<unknown> = Promise.resolve();
+
+  constructor(private readonly options: PineStopServiceOptions) {}
+
+  /** Reads every stop of Pine's own and gives them to the directory. */
+  load(): Promise<void> {
+    return this.oneAtATime(async () => {
+      const read = await this.options.storage.all();
+      const placed: PlacedPineStop[] = [];
+      for (const stop of read) placed.push(await this.placed(stop));
+      this.stops = new Map(placed.map((one) => [one.stop.id, one]));
+      this.publish();
+      this.options.log.info({ stops: placed.length }, 'stops of Pine’s own loaded');
+    });
+  }
+
+  /** The stops of a server, by name. */
+  ofServer(serverId: string): PineStop[] {
+    return [...this.stops.values()]
+      .filter(({ stop }) => stop.serverId === serverId)
+      .map(({ stop }) => stop)
+      .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name) || a.id - b.id);
+  }
+
+  /** The stops of a server by its row in `Guild` (the Wayfarer import knows the row). */
+  ofGuildRow(guildRow: number | undefined): PineStop[] {
+    if (guildRow === undefined) return [];
+    return [...this.stops.values()]
+      .filter((one) => one.guildRow === guildRow)
+      .map(({ stop }) => stop);
+  }
+
+  /** A stop of a server by its key (`pine-<id>`) or id; undefined for another server's. */
+  get(serverId: string, keyOrId: string | number): PineStop | undefined {
+    const id = typeof keyOrId === 'number' ? keyOrId : pineStopIdOf(keyOrId);
+    const found = id === undefined ? undefined : this.stops.get(id)?.stop;
+    return found?.serverId === serverId ? found : undefined;
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * The PokéStops within `PINE_STOP_NEAR_METRES` of a point that a new stop of this server would
+   * stand beside: the kept ones of the imports, and this server's own; nearest first.
+   */
+  nearStops(point: LatLon, serverId: string): NearWayspot[] {
+    return this.options.wayspots
+      .near(point, PINE_STOP_NEAR_METRES, ['stop'])
+      .filter(({ wayspot }) => wayspot.pineServer === undefined || wayspot.pineServer === serverId);
+  }
+
+  add(stop: NewPineStop): Promise<PineStop> {
+    return this.oneAtATime(async () => {
+      const made = await this.options.storage.add(stop);
+      this.stops.set(made.id, await this.placed(made));
+      this.publish();
+      this.options.log.info(
+        { stop: made.id, guild: made.serverId, by: made.createdBy },
+        'a stop of Pine’s own was added',
+      );
+      return made;
+    });
+  }
+
+  edit(
+    id: number,
+    serverId: string,
+    change: PineStopChange,
+    by: string,
+    at: number,
+  ): Promise<PineStop | undefined> {
+    return this.oneAtATime(async () => {
+      const changed = await this.options.storage.update(id, serverId, change, by, at);
+      if (!changed) return undefined;
+      this.stops.set(changed.id, await this.placed(changed));
+      this.publish();
+      this.options.log.info(
+        { stop: id, guild: serverId, by, fields: Object.keys(change) },
+        'a stop of Pine’s own was changed',
+      );
+      return changed;
+    });
+  }
+
+  remove(id: number, serverId: string, by: string): Promise<PineStop | undefined> {
+    return this.oneAtATime(async () => {
+      const removed = await this.options.storage.remove(id, serverId);
+      if (!removed) return undefined;
+      this.stops.delete(id);
+      this.publish();
+      this.options.log.info({ stop: id, guild: serverId, by }, 'a stop of Pine’s own was removed');
+      return removed;
+    });
+  }
+
+  private async placed(stop: PineStop): Promise<PlacedPineStop> {
+    return { stop, guildRow: await this.options.guilds.idFor(stop.serverId) };
+  }
+
+  private publish(): void {
+    this.options.wayspots.setPineStops([...this.stops.values()]);
+  }
+
+  private oneAtATime<T>(work: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
+    const result = this.queue.then(work);
+    this.queue = result.catch(() => undefined);
+    return result;
+  }
+}

-/** A choice's value read back; undefined for text that is none (what a member typed). */
+/**
+ * A choice's value read back; undefined for text that is none (what a member typed). The id is a
+ * gym's number, a Wayfarer id, or a stop of Pine's own (`pine-<id>`, plan 8R-1).
+ */
 export function readPlaceValue(text: string): { kind: PlaceKind; id: string } | undefined {
-  const match = /^(gym|stop|powerspot):([0-9a-f.]{1,40})$/u.exec(text);
+  const match = /^(gym|stop|powerspot):([0-9a-f.]{1,40}|pine-[1-9]\d{0,9})$/u.exec(text);
   if (!match || !KINDS.has(match[1]!)) return undefined;
   return { kind: match[1] as PlaceKind, id: match[2]! };
 }
````

### Task 3: 8R-1 task 3: the field research task list from Leek Duck

Prototype commit: `2d32aef8b9707a36054f1cdb70630e403492a979`

settings.research (always on, a default for every key: Leek Duck's page,
read every hour, out of date after 6, and the report throttle of 10 in 30
minutes). parseResearchPage reads the page in small scans: a task per
task-item with its category, text and key (the hash of its folded text),
each reward an encounter (its catalogue entry where the name and picture
agree, shiny, CP range), an item with its key and quantity, or Mega Energy
of a species; the breakthrough is left out, a text listed twice is one
task. Its fixture is the page of 2026-10-21 unchanged (58 tasks, 299
rewards, every encounter known to the game data).

ResearchTaskService reads the page with Pine's User-Agent and a byte cap
(readLimitedText), keeps the last good list in ResearchTask and takes it
at start without the network, reads when the list is older than the
refresh and every refresh after, keeps its list when a read lists fewer
than half the tasks (a warning; taken on a second read that agrees, or once
the list is out of date) or fails, and says once in the log that
the list is out of date. ctx.researchTasks; the test context has the
page's list.

````diff
+   * `url` is Leek Duck's research page (`RESEARCH_URL`), read every `refreshHours` (1 unless
+   * set); a list not read anew for `staleAfterHours` (6 unless set) is out of date, which the
+   * log says. `throttle` is how many reports a member may make in how many minutes (10 in 30
+   * unless set; one report at five stops counts once).
+   */
+  research: z
+    .strictObject({
+      url: z.url({ protocol: /^https?$/ }).default(RESEARCH_URL),
+      refreshHours: z.number().int().min(1).max(48).default(1),
+      staleAfterHours: z.number().int().min(1).max(168).default(6),
+      throttle: z
+        .strictObject({
+          uses: z.number().int().min(1).max(100).default(10),
+          minutes: z.number().int().min(1).max(1440).default(30),
+        })
+        .default(() => ({ uses: 10, minutes: 30 })),
+    })
+    .refine((research) => research.staleAfterHours >= 2 * research.refreshHours, {
+      error: 'staleAfterHours must cover at least two refreshes',
+      path: ['staleAfterHours'],
+    })
+    .default(() => ({
+      url: RESEARCH_URL,
+      refreshHours: 1,
+      staleAfterHours: 6,
+      throttle: { uses: 10, minutes: 30 },
+    })),
 });
 
 export type Settings = z.output<typeof settingsSchema>;
````
