+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import { catalogueFixture } from '../../../test/support/game-data.js';
+import { readResearchPage } from '../../../test/support/research.js';
+import { htmlText, parseResearchPage } from './leekduck.js';
+import { taskKeyOf } from './task.js';
+
+describe('parseResearchPage', () => {
+  const parsed = parseResearchPage(readResearchPage(), catalogueFixture());
+  const task = (text: string) => parsed.tasks.find((one) => one.key === taskKeyOf(text));
+
+  it('reads the 58 tasks of the page of 2026-10-21 in its 8 categories, and no breakthrough', () => {
+    expect(parsed.tasks).toHaveLength(58);
+    expect([...new Set(parsed.tasks.map((one) => one.category))]).toEqual([
+      'Catching',
+      'Throwing',
+      'Battling',
+      'Exploring',
+      'Training',
+      'Buddy & Friendship',
+      'Team GO Rocket',
+      'Sponsored',
+    ]);
+    expect(parsed.skipped).toBe(0);
+    expect(parsed.tasks.reduce((n, one) => n + one.rewards.length, 0)).toBe(299);
+  });
+
+  it('reads an encounter with its catalogue entry, shiny mark and CP range', () => {
+    expect(task('Catch 7 Pokémon')?.rewards).toEqual([
+      {
+        kind: 'encounter',
+        name: 'Magikarp',
+        key: 'magikarp',
+        dex: 129,
+        shiny: true,
+        cp: { min: 99, max: 117 },
+        image: 'https://cdn.leekduck.com/assets/img/pokemon_icons_crop/pm129.icon.png',
+      },
+      expect.objectContaining({ name: 'Stufful', dex: 759 }),
+      expect.objectContaining({ name: 'Wimpod', dex: 767 }),
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('reads items with their quantity and a key, and Mega Energy with its species', () => {
+    const dragon = task('Catch a Dragon-type Pokémon');
+    expect(dragon?.rewards.map((reward) => reward.name)).toEqual([
+      'Dratini',
+      'Bagon',
+      'Axew',
+      'Golden Razz Berry',
+      'Rare Candy',
+      'Stardust',
+      'Ultra Ball',
+    ]);
+    expect(dragon?.rewards[3]).toEqual({
+      kind: 'item',
+      item: 'golden-razz-berry',
+      name: 'Golden Razz Berry',
+      quantity: 2,
+      image: 'https://cdn.leekduck.com/assets/img/items/Golden%20Razz%20Berry.png',
+    });
+    expect(dragon?.rewards[5]).toMatchObject({ item: 'stardust', quantity: 1500 });
+    const energy = parsed.tasks
+      .flatMap((one) => one.rewards)
+      .find((reward) => reward.kind === 'energy' && reward.name === 'Sceptile Mega Energy');
+    expect(energy).toEqual({
+      kind: 'energy',
+      dex: 254,
+      name: 'Sceptile Mega Energy',
+      quantity: 10,
+      image: 'https://cdn.leekduck.com/assets/img/mega_energy/Sceptile%20Mega%20Energy.png',
+    });
+  });
+
+  it('reads a regional form as its form', () => {
+    const alolan = parsed.tasks
+      .flatMap((one) => one.rewards)
+      .find((reward) => reward.name === 'Alolan Exeggutor');
+    expect(alolan).toMatchObject({ key: 'exeggutor_alola', dex: 103 });
+  });
+
+  it('names the encounters the game data does not know, and reads them all the same', () => {
+    expect(parsed.unknown).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it('refuses a page without a task, and makes one task of a text listed twice', () => {
+    expect(() => parseResearchPage('<html>Not found</html>', catalogueFixture())).toThrow(
+      'The research page lists no task',
+    );
+    const twice =
+      '<div class="task-category"><h2>Catching Tasks</h2><ul class="task-list">' +
+      '<li class="task-item"><span class="task-text"><span>Catch 7 Pok&eacute;mon</span></span>' +
+      '<ul class="reward-list"><li class="reward" data-reward-type="item"><span class="reward-label">' +
+      'Rare Candy <span>×3</span></span></li></ul></li>' +
+      '<li class="task-item"><span class="task-text"><span>Catch 7 Pokémon</span></span>' +
+      '<ul class="reward-list"><li class="reward" data-reward-type="item"><span class="reward-label">' +
+      'Rare Candy <span>×3</span></span></li><li class="reward" data-reward-type="balloon"></li>' +
+      '</ul></li></ul></div>';
+    const read = parseResearchPage(twice, catalogueFixture());
+    expect(read.tasks).toEqual([
+      {
+        key: taskKeyOf('Catch 7 Pokémon'),
+        text: 'Catch 7 Pokémon',
+        category: 'Catching',
+        rewards: [
+          { kind: 'item', item: 'rare-candy', name: 'Rare Candy', quantity: 3, image: null },
+        ],
+      },
+    ]);
+    expect(read.skipped).toBe(1);
+  });
+
+  it('reads text as it shows: tags out, entities read, controls and gaps one space', () => {
+    expect(htmlText('<span>Buddy &amp; Friendship</span>  Tasks')).toBe('Buddy & Friendship Tasks');
+    expect(htmlText('Farfetch&#39;d &#x2014;​ ok')).toBe("Farfetch'd — ok");
+  });
+});
diff --git a/src/domain/research/leekduck.ts b/src/domain/research/leekduck.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..eb658a768fec171ee2911795029fe003db5508d6
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/domain/research/leekduck.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,229 @@
+import type { PokemonCatalogue } from '../pogo/catalogue.js';
+import { feedLookupOf } from '../pogo/feed-lookup.js';
+import { identifyBoss } from '../pogo/raid-boss-feed.js';
+import { itemKey, MAX_TASK_TEXT, taskKeyOf, type ResearchTask, type TaskReward } from './task.js';
+
+/*
+ * Leek Duck's research page (`https://leekduck.com/research/`; plan 8R-1, design 4.1, decision 5)
+ * read as the task list. The page is HTML of a stable shape: a `task-category` per heading
+ * (`<h2>Catching Tasks</h2>`), a `task-item` per task with its `task-text`, and a `reward` per
+ * reward with its `data-reward-type` (`encounter`, `item`, `resource` for Mega Energy). The
+ * research breakthrough after the tasks is no task. Read with a few small scans, never a regular
+ * expression over the whole page: what is not of that shape is skipped and counted.
+ */
+
+/** What the page gave: the tasks, and how many tasks and rewards could not be read. */
+export interface ParsedResearchPage {
+  tasks: ResearchTask[];
+  /** Tasks without a text, and rewards of a type or shape this version does not read. */
+  skipped: number;
+  /** The names of encounter rewards the game data does not know (shown by name, wanted by none). */
+  unknown: string[];
+}
+
+/** The longest name of a reward that is kept. */
+const MAX_REWARD_NAME = 100;
+
+const NAMED_ENTITIES: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = {
+  amp: '&',
+  lt: '<',
+  gt: '>',
+  quot: '"',
+  apos: "'",
+  nbsp: ' ',
+  eacute: 'é',
+  times: '×',
+  rsquo: '’',
+  lsquo: '‘',
+  ndash: '–',
+  mdash: '—',
+};
+
+/** HTML text as the words it shows: tags out, entities read, white space one space. */
+export function htmlText(html: string): string {
+  return html
+    .replace(/<[^<>]*>/g, ' ')
+    .replace(/&(#x[0-9a-f]{1,6}|#\d{1,7}|[a-z]{2,8});/gi, (all, name: string) => {
+      if (name.startsWith('#x') || name.startsWith('#X')) {
+        return safeCodePoint(Number.parseInt(name.slice(2), 16)) ?? all;
+      }
+      if (name.startsWith('#')) return safeCodePoint(Number(name.slice(1))) ?? all;
+      return NAMED_ENTITIES[name.toLowerCase()] ?? all;
+    })
+    .replace(/[\p{Cc}\p{Cf}]/gu, ' ')
+    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
+    .trim();
+}
+
+function safeCodePoint(code: number): string | undefined {
+  return Number.isInteger(code) && code > 0 && code <= 0x10ffff && (code < 0xd800 || code > 0xdfff)
+    ? String.fromCodePoint(code)
+    : undefined;
+}
+
+/** The parts of `html` that begin with `marker`, each up to the next (the first part, before any, left out). */
+function partsFrom(html: string, marker: string): string[] {
+  const parts: string[] = [];
+  let at = html.indexOf(marker);
+  while (at >= 0) {
+    const next = html.indexOf(marker, at + marker.length);
+    parts.push(html.slice(at, next < 0 ? undefined : next));
+    at = next;
+  }
+  return parts;
+}
+
+/** The inner HTML of the first element that opens with `open` (up to `close`), or undefined. */
+function between(html: string, open: string, close: string): string | undefined {
+  const start = html.indexOf(open);
+  if (start < 0) return undefined;
+  const from = start + open.length;
+  const end = html.indexOf(close, from);
+  return end < 0 ? undefined : html.slice(from, end);
+}
+
+/** The addresses of the pictures in a piece of HTML, in order. */
+function pictures(html: string): string[] {
+  const found: string[] = [];
+  for (const piece of partsFrom(html, '<img')) {
+    const src = between(piece, 'src="', '"');
+    if (src !== undefined) found.push(src);
+  }
+  return found;
+}
+
+/** Only https addresses of Leek Duck's CDN are kept as a reward's picture. */
+function pictureOf(src: string | undefined): string | null {
+  if (src === undefined) return null;
+  // The page names its item pictures with spaces (`items/Rare Candy.png`).
+  const address = htmlText(src).replace(/ /g, '%20');
+  return /^https:\/\/cdn\.leekduck\.com\/[^\s"<>]{1,240}$/.test(address) ? address : null;
+}
+
+/** `×10` read as 10; 1 where the page gives none. */
+function quantityOf(text: string): number {
+  const match = /×\s*([\d,]{1,9})/.exec(text);
+  const n = match?.[1] === undefined ? 1 : Number(match[1].replace(/,/g, ''));
+  return Number.isSafeInteger(n) && n > 0 ? n : 1;
+}
+
+/** The number a `Max CP` or `Min CP` part gives, if any. */
+function cpOf(html: string, marker: string): number | undefined {
+  const part = between(html, marker, '</span>');
+  const match = part === undefined ? null : /(\d{1,5})\s*$/.exec(htmlText(part));
+  return match?.[1] === undefined ? undefined : Number(match[1]);
+}
+
+/** The Pokédex number a picture's file names (`pm254.icon.png`). */
+function dexOfPicture(src: string | undefined): number | null {
+  const match = src === undefined ? null : /\/pm(\d{1,4})[.]/.exec(src);
+  return match?.[1] === undefined ? null : Number(match[1]);
+}
+
+interface Reading {
+  catalogue: PokemonCatalogue;
+  unknown: Set<string>;
+}
+
+/** One reward of the page; undefined for one of another type or that says no name. */
+function readReward(html: string, reading: Reading): TaskReward | undefined {
+  const type = between(html, 'data-reward-type="', '"');
+  const label = between(html, 'class="reward-label">', '</span></span>') ?? '';
+  const srcs = pictures(html);
+  if (type === 'encounter') {
+    const name = htmlText(label).slice(0, MAX_REWARD_NAME);
+    if (name === '') return undefined;
+    const image = srcs[0];
+    const ids = identifyBoss(name, image, feedLookupOf(reading.catalogue))?.resolved;
+    const key = ids && feedLookupOf(reading.catalogue).keyOf(ids.pokemonId, ids.form);
+    const entry = key === undefined ? undefined : reading.catalogue.byKey(key);
+    if (!entry) reading.unknown.add(name);
+    const max = cpOf(html, 'class="max-cp">');
+    const min = cpOf(html, 'class="min-cp">');
+    return {
+      kind: 'encounter',
+      name,
+      key: entry?.key ?? null,
+      dex: entry?.dex ?? null,
+      shiny: html.includes('class="shiny-badge"'),
+      cp: min !== undefined && max !== undefined ? { min, max } : null,
+      image: pictureOf(image),
+    };
+  }
+  if (type === 'item' || type === 'resource') {
+    // `Golden Razz Berry <span>×2</span>`: the name, then how many.
+    const cut = label.indexOf('<span');
+    const name = htmlText(cut < 0 ? label : label.slice(0, cut)).slice(0, MAX_REWARD_NAME);
+    if (name === '') return undefined;
+    const quantity = quantityOf(htmlText(label));
+    if (type === 'resource') {
+      return {
+        kind: 'energy',
+        dex: dexOfPicture(srcs[1]),
+        name,
+        quantity,
+        image: pictureOf(srcs[0]),
+      };
+    }
+    const item = itemKey(name);
+    if (item === '') return undefined;
+    return { kind: 'item', item, name, quantity, image: pictureOf(srcs[0]) };
+  }
+  return undefined;
+}
+
+/** What tells two rewards of a task apart: its kind and what it is. */
+function rewardKey(reward: TaskReward): string {
+  switch (reward.kind) {
+    case 'encounter':
+      return `e:${reward.key ?? reward.name}`;
+    case 'item':
+      return `i:${reward.item}:${String(reward.quantity)}`;
+    case 'energy':
+      return `m:${reward.name}:${String(reward.quantity)}`;
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+ * Reads Leek Duck's research page. Throws when it holds no task at all (another page, a page of
+ * another shape), so that a broken read never replaces a good list. A task listed twice (the
+ * same folded text) is one task with the rewards of both.
+ */
+export function parseResearchPage(html: string, catalogue: PokemonCatalogue): ParsedResearchPage {
+  const end = html.indexOf('research-breakthrough-section');
+  const page = end < 0 ? html : html.slice(0, end);
+  const reading: Reading = { catalogue, unknown: new Set() };
+  const byKey = new Map<string, ResearchTask>();
+  let skipped = 0;
+  for (const category of partsFrom(page, '<div class="task-category"')) {
+    const heading = htmlText(between(category, '<h2>', '</h2>') ?? '')
+      .replace(/\s+tasks$/i, '')
+      .slice(0, 60);
+    for (const item of partsFrom(category, '<li class="task-item"')) {
+      const text = htmlText(between(item, 'class="task-text">', '</span></span>') ?? '').slice(
+        0,
+        MAX_TASK_TEXT,
+      );
+      if (text === '') {
+        skipped += 1;
+        continue;
+      }
+      const rewards: TaskReward[] = [];
+      for (const piece of partsFrom(item, '<li class="reward"')) {
+        const reward = readReward(piece, reading);
+        if (reward) rewards.push(reward);
+        else skipped += 1;
+      }
+      const key = taskKeyOf(text);
+      const known = byKey.get(key);
+      if (known) {
+        const have = new Set(known.rewards.map(rewardKey));
+        known.rewards.push(...rewards.filter((reward) => !have.has(rewardKey(reward))));
+        continue;
+      }
+      byKey.set(key, { key, text, category: heading === '' ? 'Other' : heading, rewards });
+    }
+  }
+  if (byKey.size === 0) throw new Error('The research page lists no task');
+  return { tasks: [...byKey.values()], skipped, unknown: [...reading.unknown] };
+}
diff --git a/src/services/limited-json.ts b/src/services/limited-json.ts
index 596a48794cb152a11090c2c95beb48650286234d..a2417e04768cf5b1035585fb5bf5142ad7de0831 100644
--- a/src/services/limited-json.ts
+++ b/src/services/limited-json.ts
@@ -61,6 +61,24 @@ export async function readLimitedBytes(
   return { ok: true, bytes: Buffer.concat(pieces, length) };
 }
 
+/** The body of an answer as text, or why it was not read (see `LimitedJson`). */
+export type LimitedText =
+  { ok: true; text: string } | { ok: false; reason: 'too-large' | 'unreadable' };
+
+/** `readLimitedBytes`, then the bytes read as UTF-8 (a page, as Leek Duck's research page). */
+export async function readLimitedText(
+  response: LimitedResponse,
+  maxBytes: number,
+): Promise<LimitedText> {
+  const read = await readLimitedBytes(response, maxBytes);
+  if (!read.ok) return read;
+  try {
+    return { ok: true, text: new TextDecoder('utf-8', { fatal: true }).decode(read.bytes) };
+  } catch {
+    return { ok: false, reason: 'unreadable' };
+  }
+}
+
 /** `readLimitedBytes`, then the bytes parsed as JSON. */
 export async function readLimitedJson(
   response: LimitedResponse,
diff --git a/src/services/research-task-service.test.ts b/src/services/research-task-service.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..dff9e2fdd5b8333e3140669fab8a5f3d9c5b952a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/services/research-task-service.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,187 @@
+import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import { catalogueFixture } from '../../test/support/game-data.js';
+import { readResearchPage } from '../../test/support/research.js';
+import { listedTask } from '../../test/support/research-store-cases.js';
+import { MemoryResearchTasks } from '../../test/support/research-store.js';
+import { jsonResponse } from '../../test/support/responses.js';
+import { createTestLogger } from '../../test/support/test-logger.js';
+import {
+  MAX_RESEARCH_PAGE_BYTES,
+  PINE_USER_AGENT,
+  ResearchTaskService,
+  type FetchPage,
+} from './research-task-service.js';
+
+const URL = 'https://leekduck.example.test/research/';
+const HOUR = 3_600_000;
+const NOW = Date.UTC(2026, 9, 21, 22);
+
+/** A service over the kept list in memory, reading what `answer` gives, at `clock.now`. */
+function serviceWith(answer: () => ReturnType<FetchPage>, store = new MemoryResearchTasks()) {
+  const { log, entries } = createTestLogger();
+  const clock = { now: NOW };
+  const asked: { url: string; headers: Record<string, string> }[] = [];
+  const service = new ResearchTaskService({
+    url: URL,
+    refreshMs: HOUR,
+    staleAfterMs: 6 * HOUR,
+    store,
+    gameData: { catalogue: catalogueFixture() },
+    fetch: (url, init) => {
+      asked.push({ url, headers: init.headers });
+      return answer();
+    },
+    log,
+    now: () => clock.now,
+  });
+  const said = (msg: string) => entries.filter((entry) => entry.msg === msg).length;
+  return { service, store, clock, asked, said };
+}
+
+const page = (html = readResearchPage(), options: { status?: number } = {}) =>
+  Promise.resolve({
+    ...jsonResponse(null, { raw: html, ...options }),
+    ok: (options.status ?? 200) < 300,
+  });
+
+describe('ResearchTaskService', () => {
+  afterEach(() => {
+    vi.useRealTimers();
+  });
+
+  it('reads the page with Pine’s User-Agent and keeps the list in the database', async () => {
+    const { service, store, asked } = serviceWith(() => page());
+    expect(service.tasks()).toEqual([]);
+    expect(await service.refresh()).toEqual({ status: 'updated', tasks: 58 });
+    expect(asked).toEqual([
+      { url: URL, headers: { Accept: 'text/html', 'User-Agent': PINE_USER_AGENT } },
+    ]);
+    expect(service.tasks()).toHaveLength(58);
+    expect(service.readAt()).toBe(NOW);
+    const [first] = service.tasks();
+    expect(service.byKey(first!.key)).toEqual(first);
+    expect((await store.kept()).tasks).toHaveLength(58);
+  });
+
+  it('starts with the list of the last run, without the network', async () => {
+    const store = new MemoryResearchTasks();
+    await store.replace([listedTask('Make 2 Excellent Throws')], NOW - HOUR / 2);
+    const { service } = serviceWith(() => Promise.reject(new Error('no network')), store);
+    await service.load();
+    expect(service.tasks().map((task) => task.text)).toEqual(['Make 2 Excellent Throws']);
+    expect(service.readAt()).toBe(NOW - HOUR / 2);
+  });
+
+  it('keeps its list when the page lists fewer than half the tasks, and says so', async () => {
+    const store = new MemoryResearchTasks();
+    const { service, said } = serviceWith(() => page(), store);
+    await service.refresh();
+    const one =
+      '<div class="task-category"><h2>Catching Tasks</h2><li class="task-item">' +
+      '<span class="task-text"><span>Catch a Ditto</span></span></li></div>';
+    const shrunk = serviceWith(() => page(one), store);
+    await shrunk.service.load();
+    expect(await shrunk.service.refresh()).toEqual({ status: 'kept', tasks: 58, read: 1 });
+    expect(shrunk.service.tasks()).toHaveLength(58);
+    expect(
+      shrunk.said('the research page lists fewer than half the tasks it did; the list is kept'),
+    ).toBe(1);
+    expect(said('research tasks read')).toBe(1);
+  });
+
+  const SHRUNK =
+    '<div class="task-category"><h2>Catching Tasks</h2><li class="task-item">' +
+    '<span class="task-text"><span>Catch a Ditto</span></span></li></div>';
+  const OTHER =
+    '<div class="task-category"><h2>Catching Tasks</h2><li class="task-item">' +
+    '<span class="task-text"><span>Catch a Snorlax</span></span></li></div>';
+
+  it('takes a smaller list when the next read lists the same tasks (review A3)', async () => {
+    let html = readResearchPage();
+    const { service, clock, said } = serviceWith(() => page(html));
+    await service.refresh();
+    html = SHRUNK;
+    clock.now += HOUR;
+    expect(await service.refresh()).toMatchObject({ status: 'kept' });
+    // Another small list is no agreement: it waits for one more read.
+    html = OTHER;
+    clock.now += HOUR;
+    expect(await service.refresh()).toMatchObject({ status: 'kept' });
+    clock.now += HOUR;
+    expect(await service.refresh()).toEqual({ status: 'updated', tasks: 1 });
+    expect(service.tasks().map((task) => task.text)).toEqual(['Catch a Snorlax']);
+    expect(service.readAt()).toBe(clock.now);
+    expect(said('the research task list is out of date')).toBe(0);
+  });
+
+  it('takes a smaller list once the list in use is older than staleAfterHours', async () => {
+    let html = readResearchPage();
+    const { service, clock, said } = serviceWith(() => page(html));
+    await service.refresh();
+    html = SHRUNK;
+    clock.now += 6 * HOUR;
+    expect(await service.refresh()).toEqual({ status: 'updated', tasks: 1 });
+    expect(service.tasks().map((task) => task.text)).toEqual(['Catch a Ditto']);
+    // The list was read just now: it is not out of date.
+    expect(said('the research task list is out of date')).toBe(0);
+  });
+
+  it('keeps its list when the page cannot be read: a refusal, no tasks, too large', async () => {
+    let answer: () => ReturnType<FetchPage> = () => page();
+    const { service } = serviceWith(() => answer());
+    await service.refresh();
+    answer = () => page('', { status: 503 });
+    expect(await service.refresh()).toMatchObject({
+      status: 'failed',
+      reason: `${URL} answered 503`,
+    });
+    answer = () => page('<html>Maintenance</html>');
+    expect(await service.refresh()).toMatchObject({ status: 'failed' });
+    answer = () => page('x'.repeat(MAX_RESEARCH_PAGE_BYTES + 1));
+    expect(await service.refresh()).toMatchObject({
+      status: 'failed',
+      reason: `${URL}: the page is too-large`,
+    });
+    expect(service.tasks()).toHaveLength(58);
+  });
+
+  it('says once that the list is out of date, until a read succeeds again', async () => {
+    let fails = false;
+    const { service, clock, said } = serviceWith(() =>
+      fails ? Promise.reject(new Error('down')) : page(),
+    );
+    await service.refresh();
+    fails = true;
+    clock.now += 5 * HOUR;
+    await service.refresh();
+    expect(said('the research task list is out of date')).toBe(0);
+    clock.now += 2 * HOUR;
+    await service.refresh();
+    await service.refresh();
+    expect(said('the research task list is out of date')).toBe(1);
+    fails = false;
+    await service.refresh();
+    fails = true;
+    clock.now += 7 * HOUR;
+    await service.refresh();
+    expect(said('the research task list is out of date')).toBe(2);
+  });
+
+  it('reads at start only when its list is older than the refresh, then every refresh', async () => {
+    vi.useFakeTimers({ toFake: ['setTimeout', 'clearTimeout'] });
+    const store = new MemoryResearchTasks();
+    await store.replace([listedTask('Make 2 Excellent Throws')], NOW - HOUR / 4);
+    const { service, asked } = serviceWith(() => page(), store);
+    await service.load();
+    service.start();
+    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(HOUR / 2);
+    expect(asked).toHaveLength(0);
+    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(HOUR / 4);
+    await service.whenIdle();
+    expect(asked).toHaveLength(1);
+    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(HOUR);
+    await service.whenIdle();
+    expect(asked).toHaveLength(2);
+    service.stop();
+  });
+});
diff --git a/src/services/research-task-service.ts b/src/services/research-task-service.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..f647ccbddd756e811f9e747fa46c692ea35552de
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/services/research-task-service.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,256 @@
+import type { ResearchTaskStorage } from '../db/repositories/research-task-repository.js';
+import { parseResearchPage } from '../domain/research/leekduck.js';
+import type { ResearchTask } from '../domain/research/task.js';
+import type { Logger } from '../log.js';
+import { failureReason } from './failure-reason.js';
+import type { GameDataProvider } from './game-data-service.js';
+import { readLimitedText, type LimitedResponse } from './limited-json.js';
+
+/** How Pine names itself to the sites it reads. */
+export const PINE_USER_AGENT = 'Professor-Pine';
+
+/** The page was 220 KB on 2026-10-21; anything much larger is not the page. */
+export const MAX_RESEARCH_PAGE_BYTES = 3 * 1024 * 1024;
+
+const MINUTE_MS = 60_000;
+/** The longest delay `setTimeout` accepts. */
+const MAX_TIMER_MS = 2 ** 31 - 1;
+
+/** The part of `fetch` this service needs. */
+export type FetchPage = (
+  url: string,
+  init: { signal: AbortSignal; headers: Record<string, string> },
+) => Promise<LimitedResponse & { ok: boolean }>;
+
+export interface ResearchTaskOptions {
+  /** Leek Duck's research page (`settings.research.url`). */
+  url: string;
+  refreshMs: number;
+  /** A list not read anew for this long is out of date (logged once). */
+  staleAfterMs: number;
+  store: ResearchTaskStorage;
+  gameData: GameDataProvider;
+  fetch: FetchPage;
+  log: Logger;
+  /** How long one download may take. Default 30 seconds. */
+  timeoutMs?: number;
+  /** How long to wait after a failed attempt. Default 15 minutes, at most `refreshMs`. */
+  retryMs?: number;
+  now?: () => number;
+}
+
+/** What handlers need: the task list of now. */
+export interface ResearchTaskProvider {
+  /** The tasks of the last good read, in the page's order; empty while none was ever read. */
+  tasks(): readonly ResearchTask[];
+  /** A task by its key, if the list has it. */
+  byKey(key: string): ResearchTask | undefined;
+  /** When the list in use was read, epoch milliseconds; undefined while none was. */
+  readAt(): number | undefined;
+}
+
+export type ResearchRefresh =
+  | { status: 'updated'; tasks: number }
+  /** The page could not be read, or was not the page: the list in use is unchanged. */
+  | { status: 'failed'; reason: string }
+  /** The page listed fewer than half the tasks of the list in use: kept (design 4.1). */
+  | { status: 'kept'; tasks: number; read: number };
+
+/** Thrown inside a download that `stop` ended; not worth a warning. */
+class RefreshStopped extends Error {}
+
+/**
+ * The field research task list (plan 8R-1; design 4.1): Leek Duck's research page, read by
+ * Pine itself every `refreshMs` (`parseResearchPage`) with Pine's User-Agent and a byte cap, the
+ * last good list kept in the database (`ResearchTaskStorage`) so that a start without the
+ * network still offers it. A read that lists fewer than half the tasks of the list in use may be
+ * a page that changed shape: it is logged as a warning and the list stays, unless the read
+ * before it listed the very same tasks or the list in use is older than `staleAfterMs` (then
+ * the page did shrink, and the smaller list is taken: review A3). A list not read anew
+ * for `staleAfterMs` is said to be out of date in the log, once until a read succeeds again.
+ * The list offered in a period is whatever the page shows when read (design call 5: whether it
+ * shows an event's own tasks while the event runs is watched at staging).
+ */
+export class ResearchTaskService implements ResearchTaskProvider {
+  private current: readonly ResearchTask[] = [];
+  private keyed = new Map<string, ResearchTask>();
+  private read: number | undefined;
+  private readonly timeoutMs: number;
+  private readonly retryMs: number;
+  private readonly now: () => number;
+  private controller: AbortController | undefined;
+  private inFlight: Promise<ResearchRefresh> | undefined;
+  private timer: NodeJS.Timeout | undefined;
+  private stopped = true;
+  private staleTold = false;
+  /** The task keys of the last read refused as much smaller (`shrinkAgreed`); a read clears it. */
+  private shrink: string | undefined;
+
+  constructor(private readonly options: ResearchTaskOptions) {
+    this.timeoutMs = options.timeoutMs ?? 30_000;
+    this.retryMs = Math.min(options.retryMs ?? 15 * MINUTE_MS, options.refreshMs);
+    this.now = options.now ?? (() => Date.now());
+  }
+
+  tasks(): readonly ResearchTask[] {
+    return this.current;
+  }
+
+  byKey(key: string): ResearchTask | undefined {
+    return this.keyed.get(key);
+  }
+
+  readAt(): number | undefined {
+    return this.read;
+  }
+
+  /** Takes the list kept by the last run (no network). */
+  async load(): Promise<void> {
+    const kept = await this.options.store.kept();
+    this.use(kept.tasks, kept.readAt);
+    this.options.log.info({ tasks: kept.tasks.length }, 'research tasks loaded');
+  }
+
+  private use(tasks: readonly ResearchTask[], readAt: number | undefined): void {
+    this.current = tasks;
+    this.keyed = new Map(tasks.map((task) => [task.key, task]));
+    this.read = readAt;
+  }
+
+  /** Reads the page now. Never rejects; calls made while one runs share its result. */
+  refresh(): Promise<ResearchRefresh> {
+    this.inFlight ??= this.refreshOnce().finally(() => {
+      this.inFlight = undefined;
+    });
+    return this.inFlight;
+  }
+
+  /** Resolves once no read is in flight. Never rejects. */
+  async whenIdle(): Promise<void> {
+    while (this.inFlight) await this.inFlight;
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Reads the page when the list in use is older than `refreshMs` (or there is none), else when
+   * it is due, and again every `refreshMs`. Calling it again changes nothing.
+   */
+  start(): void {
+    if (!this.stopped) return;
+    this.stopped = false;
+    const age = this.read === undefined ? Infinity : this.now() - this.read;
+    this.schedule(Math.max(0, this.options.refreshMs - age));
+  }
+
+  /** Cancels the scheduled read and ends one in flight. */
+  stop(): void {
+    this.stopped = true;
+    this.controller?.abort();
+    if (this.timer) clearTimeout(this.timer);
+    this.timer = undefined;
+  }
+
+  private schedule(delayMs: number): void {
+    if (this.timer) clearTimeout(this.timer);
+    this.timer = setTimeout(
+      () => {
+        this.timer = undefined;
+        void this.refresh().then((result) => {
+          if (this.stopped) return;
+          this.schedule(result.status === 'failed' ? this.retryMs : this.options.refreshMs);
+        });
+      },
+      Math.min(delayMs, MAX_TIMER_MS),
+    );
+    this.timer.unref();
+  }
+
+  private async refreshOnce(): Promise<ResearchRefresh> {
+    const { log, store, gameData } = this.options;
+    let result: ResearchRefresh;
+    try {
+      const page = await this.download();
+      const parsed = parseResearchPage(page, gameData.catalogue);
+      const before = this.current.length;
+      const shrunk = parsed.tasks
+        .map((task) => task.key)
+        .sort()
+        .join(' ');
+      if (parsed.tasks.length * 2 < before && !this.shrinkAgreed(shrunk)) {
+        this.shrink = shrunk;
+        log.warn(
+          { read: parsed.tasks.length, kept: before },
+          'the research page lists fewer than half the tasks it did; the list is kept',
+        );
+        result = { status: 'kept', tasks: before, read: parsed.tasks.length };
+      } else {
+        const at = this.now();
+        await store.replace(parsed.tasks, at);
+        this.use(parsed.tasks, at);
+        this.shrink = undefined;
+        this.staleTold = false;
+        if (parsed.unknown.length > 0) {
+          log.info({ rewards: parsed.unknown }, 'research rewards the game data does not know');
+        }
+        if (parsed.skipped > 0) {
+          log.warn({ skipped: parsed.skipped }, 'parts of the research page could not be read');
+        }
+        log.info({ tasks: parsed.tasks.length }, 'research tasks read');
+        result = { status: 'updated', tasks: parsed.tasks.length };
+      }
+    } catch (err) {
+      if (err instanceof RefreshStopped) return { status: 'failed', reason: 'stopped' };
+      log.warn({ err }, 'could not read the research page');
+      result = { status: 'failed', reason: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) };
+    }
+    this.tellIfStale();
+    return result;
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Whether a much smaller list is taken after all (review A3): the read before it listed the
+   * very same tasks (the page did shrink, it is no broken read), or the list in use is out of
+   * date anyway (older than `staleAfterMs`): a real shrink is never refused for good.
+   */
+  private shrinkAgreed(shrunk: string): boolean {
+    if (this.shrink === shrunk) return true;
+    return this.read !== undefined && this.now() - this.read >= this.options.staleAfterMs;
+  }
+
+  /** Says once in the log that the list is out of date, until a read succeeds again. */
+  private tellIfStale(): void {
+    if (this.staleTold) return;
+    const read = this.read;
+    if (read !== undefined && this.now() - read < this.options.staleAfterMs) return;
+    this.staleTold = true;
+    this.options.log.warn(
+      { readAt: read === undefined ? null : new Date(read).toISOString() },
+      'the research task list is out of date',
+    );
+  }
+
+  private async download(): Promise<string> {
+    const { url } = this.options;
+    const timeout = AbortSignal.timeout(this.timeoutMs);
+    const controller = new AbortController();
+    this.controller = controller;
+    try {
+      const response = await this.options.fetch(url, {
+        signal: AbortSignal.any([timeout, controller.signal]),
+        headers: { Accept: 'text/html', 'User-Agent': PINE_USER_AGENT },
+      });
+      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`${url} answered ${String(response.status)}`);
+      const body = await readLimitedText(response, MAX_RESEARCH_PAGE_BYTES);
+      if (!body.ok) throw new Error(`${url}: the page is ${body.reason}`);
+      return body.text;
+    } catch (err) {
+      if (controller.signal.aborted) throw new RefreshStopped('stopped', { cause: err });
+      if (timeout.aborted) {
+        throw new Error(`${url}: timed out after ${String(this.timeoutMs)} ms`, { cause: err });
+      }
+      if (err instanceof Error && err.message.startsWith(url)) throw err;
+      throw new Error(`${url}: ${failureReason(err)}`, { cause: err });
+    } finally {
+      if (this.controller === controller) this.controller = undefined;
+    }
+  }
+}

+<script>
+  const spriteSheets = [
+    'https://cdn.leekduck.com/assets/img/icons/icons-nav.svg?v5',
+    'https://cdn.leekduck.com/assets/img/icons/icons-pgo.svg?v7',
+    'https://cdn.leekduck.com/assets/img/icons/icons-socials.svg',
+  ];
+  function loadSpriteSheet(url) {
+    return fetch(url)
+      .then(response => response.text())
+      .then(svg => {
+        document.getElementById('sprite-container').innerHTML += svg;
+      });
+  }
+  Promise.all(spriteSheets.map(loadSpriteSheet))
+    .then(() => {
+      console.log('All sprite sheets loaded!');
+    })
+    .catch(error => {
+      console.error('Error loading sprite sheets:', error);
+    });
+</script>

+<div class="faq"><h2 id="faq">FAQ</h2><h3 id="what-is-research-in-pokmon-go">What is Research in Pokémon GO?</h3><p>Research is a feature in Pokémon GO that gives Trainers the opportunity to help Professor Willow with his Pokémon Research. Completing a Research Task will unlock rewards. The more challenging a task, the greater the reward will be.</p><p>There are two types of Research you can contribute to: <strong>Field Research</strong> and <strong>Special Research</strong>.</p><hr /><h3 id="what-is-field-research">What is <strong>Field Research</strong>?</h3><p>Field Research tasks are assigned/collected by spinning PokéStops. Trainers can only receive and complete one task from each PokéStop each day. Tasks are the same for all trainers on a given day so you can share PokéStop locations for a desirable task with others in your community.</p><p>The task will consist of an objective and a reward for completing it. Rewards range from Items to Pokémon encounters. If the task awards items, it will disclose what item and quantity on the task itself. If it’s an encounter, it won’t. Instead you can refer to the handy graphic on this page.</p><p>The first Field Research task you complete for a day will reward you with a Stamp towards unlocking a <strong>Research Breakthrough</strong>.</p><hr /><h3 id="how-do-i-unlock-a-research-breakthrough">How do I unlock a <strong>Research Breakthrough</strong>?</h3><p>You can unlock a <strong>Research Breakthrough</strong> by collect 7 Stamps. Again, Stamps are obtained from your first completed Field Research task for the day. Unlike the ‘First PokéStop of the Day’ or ‘First Catch of the Day’ streaks, you do not need to collect Stamps on consecutive days. You won’t ever lose stamps you earned because you missed a day.</p><p>Upon reaching 7 Stamps, you can open the box and earn a handful of helpful Rewards. Rewards will consist of a Pokémon encounter, XP, Stardust and will include one of the following items: Rare Candy, Pinap Berries, Ultra Balls, or Poké Balls.</p><hr /><h3 id="what-is-special-research">What is <strong>Special Research</strong>?</h3><p>Special Research is like Field Research but they can be thought of as part of the game’s Story. Like Field Research they consist of tasks that you work through to earn Rewards. However in Special Research completing a set of task will earn you additional rewards. Completing all sets of tasks in the series will earn you a more valuable reward. eg. A Mythical Pokémon encounter.</p><p>While, Trainers cannot repeat Special Research tasks, Professor Willow will occasionally seek assistance with new tasks. Special Research can also be assigned at Special Events like GO Fest in Chicago or during in-game Events like Pokémon GO Halloween 2018.</p><hr /><h3 id="what-are-the-cp-numbers-under-the-pokmon-in-the-graphic">What are the CP numbers under the Pokémon in the graphic?</h3><p>That is the Perfect CP value or the number a Pokémon will have on encounter from Field Research when it’s IV values are maxed out. It is helpful to know at a glance if an encounter has high IVs.</p><hr /><h3 id="what-is-the-sparkle-next-to-some-pokmon-in-the-graphic">What is the Sparkle next to some Pokémon in the graphic?</h3><p>The sparkle indicates that there is a chance of encountering that Pokémon in their Shiny form. The chance of encountering a Shiny from a Field Research task is 1 in 450. However they could possibly be higher for certain encounters (eg. Absol).</p></div><section class="author-box"><img loading="lazy" src="/assets/img/leekduck.jpg?v2" alt="Leek Duck" class="author-img"><div class="author-desc"><h2>Leek Duck</h2><p>Hey, I'm LeekDuck. I create Pokémon GO graphics, resources and report Pokémon GO news. You can find them on X, Facebook, Instagram, Threads, and Bluesky. +import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import path from 'node:path';
+import { parseResearchPage } from '../../src/domain/research/leekduck.js';
+import type { ResearchTask } from '../../src/domain/research/task.js';
+import type { ResearchTaskProvider } from '../../src/services/research-task-service.js';
+import { catalogueFixture } from './game-data.js';
+
+const fixtures = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, '../fixtures');
+
+/**
+ * Leek Duck's research page (`https://leekduck.com/research/`) as Pine's User-Agent got it on
+ * 2026-10-21 at 21:40, unchanged: 58 tasks in 8 categories with 299 rewards (encounters, items
+ * and Mega Energy), and the research breakthrough after them.
+ */
+export function readResearchPage(): string {
+  return readFileSync(path.join(fixtures, 'leekduck-research.html'), 'utf8');
+}
+
+let parsed: readonly ResearchTask[] | undefined;
+
+/** The tasks of the page of 2026-10-21, read once and shared (read-only). */
+export function researchTasksOfPage(): readonly ResearchTask[] {
+  parsed ??= Object.freeze(parseResearchPage(readResearchPage(), catalogueFixture()).tasks);
+  return parsed;
+}
+
+/**
+ * A task list as handlers read it (`ResearchTaskProvider`): the tasks of the page of 2026-10-21
+ * unless given, read at `readAt`.
+ */
+export function researchTasksFixture(
+  given?: readonly ResearchTask[],
+  readAt = Date.UTC(2026, 9, 21, 21, 40),
+): ResearchTaskProvider {
+  // Read when first asked: most contexts never ask.
+  let byKey: Map<string, ResearchTask> | undefined;
+  const tasks = (): readonly ResearchTask[] => given ?? researchTasksOfPage();
+  return {
+    tasks,
+    byKey: (key) => (byKey ??= new Map(tasks().map((task) => [task.key, task]))).get(key),
+    readAt: () => readAt,
+  };
+}
+
+/** A task of the page of 2026-10-21 by its text; throws for one it does not list. */
+export function pageTask(text: string): ResearchTask {
+  const found = researchTasksOfPage().find((task) => task.text === text);
+  if (!found) throw new Error(`the page lists no task "${text}"`);
+  return found;
+}

### Task 4: 8R-1 task 4: research periods from the events feed

Prototype commit: `00844c2a8abbbcdcd756c66cd8ea450e086b0327`

The events feed's extraData: parseResearchEventFeed keeps the events whose
extraData.generic.hasFieldResearchTasks is true, with an id and local
hours (the in-person city editions in UTC left out). RaidEventService keeps
those of each read in ResearchEvent as last seen, takes the kept ones at
start, forgets them a month after their end, and reads events.json once
more when events.min.json has lost the flags; what fails there leaves the
raid events of the read standing. ctx.raidEvents.researchEvents().

The periods are a pure module (src/domain/time/research-periods.ts): an
event is a window (it starts and ends on one local day), daily (a big event
over several days whose hours end before midnight: each day a window of
those hours) or multi-day (any other, one crossing midnight too: a rotation
at its start and end and a period per local day between, Matt 2026-10-22).
periodAt gives the period on at a moment, its key (day:<date>,
event:<id>, event:<id>:<date>), its end and, under a window, the period
whose reports wait and when they come back (an intra-day event inside a
multi-day one leaves the multi-day period waiting); nextPeriodChange gives
the next midnight or boundary. Tested on the recorded events (Into the
Wild, Pawniard Community Day), a made-up global GO Fest, an event across
midnight, the edge minutes and the days the clocks change.

The events fixture gains the feed's two research events of 2026-10-21,
unchanged.

+  async removeNotSeen(seen: readonly string[], now: number): Promise<number> {

+import { INTO_THE_WILD, PAWNIARD_DAY } from '../../../test/support/research-store-cases.js';
+import { feedHasResearchFlags, parseResearchEventFeed } from './research-events.js';
+
+const ZONE = 'America/New_York';
+
+describe('parseResearchEventFeed', () => {
+  it('reads the events with field research of their own from the recorded feed, in local time', () => {
+    expect(parseResearchEventFeed(readMaxEventFeed(), ZONE)).toEqual([INTO_THE_WILD, PAWNIARD_DAY]);
+  });
+
+  it('says whether the feed has the research flags at all (events.min.json may lose them)', () => {
+    expect(feedHasResearchFlags(readMaxEventFeed())).toBe(true);
+    expect(
+      feedHasResearchFlags([
+        { eventID: 'a', eventType: 'event', name: 'A', start: null, end: null },
+      ]),
+    ).toBe(false);
+  });
+
+  it('leaves out an event without hours, without an id, of a city edition, or that ends first', () => {
+    const flagged = { extraData: { generic: { hasFieldResearchTasks: true } } };
+    const feed = [
+      {
+        eventID: 'no-hours',
+        eventType: 'event',
+        name: 'No hours',
+        start: null,
+        end: null,
+        ...flagged,
+      },
+      {
+        eventType: 'event',
+        name: 'No id',
+        start: '2026-11-01T10:00:00.000',
+        end: '2026-11-01T12:00:00.000',
+        ...flagged,
+      },
+      {
+        eventID: 'city',
+        eventType: 'pokemon-go-fest',
+        name: 'City',
+        start: '2026-11-01T10:00:00.000Z',
+        end: '2026-11-02T10:00:00.000Z',
+        ...flagged,
+      },
+      {
+        eventID: 'backwards',
+        eventType: 'event',
+        name: 'Backwards',
+        start: '2026-11-01T12:00:00.000',
+        end: '2026-11-01T10:00:00.000',
+        ...flagged,
+      },
+      {
+        eventID: 'plain',
+        eventType: 'event',
+        name: 'Without research',
+        start: '2026-11-01T10:00:00.000',
+        end: '2026-11-01T12:00:00.000',
+      },
+    ];
+    expect(parseResearchEventFeed(feed, ZONE)).toEqual([]);
+    expect(() => parseResearchEventFeed({ not: 'a list' }, ZONE)).toThrow();
+  });
+});
diff --git a/src/domain/time/research-events.ts b/src/domain/time/research-events.ts
index afc715a594c8349cdf1cab453552334b79ccad4a..5f60e53ddf699b49894fc4bf5d97f6df8ee66103 100644
--- a/src/domain/time/research-events.ts
+++ b/src/domain/time/research-events.ts
@@ -1,3 +1,7 @@
+import { DateTime } from 'luxon';
+import { z } from 'zod';
+import { eventName } from './raid-events.js';
+
 /**
  * An event of ScrapedDuck's events feed with field research of its own (plan 8R-1; design 4.2,
  * 9.2: `extraData.generic.hasFieldResearchTasks`), as it is kept (`ResearchEvent`): the feed's
@@ -12,3 +16,63 @@ export interface ResearchEvent {
   start: number;
   end: number;
 }
+
+/** A research event longer than this is none, whatever the feed says (a season is no event). */
+const MAX_RESEARCH_EVENT_MS = 31 * 24 * 60 * 60_000;
+
+/** A time with a zone of its own (`Z`, `+09:00`): an in-person edition's, in another city. */
+const ZONED_TIME = /(Z|[+-]\d{2}:?\d{2})$/i;
+
+const researchItem = z.object({
+  eventID: z.string().min(1).max(200),
+  eventType: z.string().min(1).max(40),
+  name: eventName,
+  start: z.string().max(40).nullable().optional(),
+  end: z.string().max(40).nullable().optional(),
+  extraData: z
+    .object({
+      generic: z.object({ hasFieldResearchTasks: z.literal(true) }).loose(),
+    })
+    .loose(),
+});
+
+/**
+ * Whether the feed says of its events whether they have field research at all: some item has
+ * `extraData.generic.hasFieldResearchTasks`. `events.min.json` had it on 2026-10-21; a feed that
+ * lost it is read again as `events.json` (design 9.2).
+ */
+export function feedHasResearchFlags(json: unknown): boolean {
+  if (!Array.isArray(json)) return false;
+  return (json as unknown[]).some((item) => {
+    const generic = (item as { extraData?: { generic?: unknown } } | null)?.extraData?.generic;
+    return typeof generic === 'object' && generic !== null && 'hasFieldResearchTasks' in generic;
+  });
+}
+
+/**
+ * The events of the feed with field research of their own (design 4.2): those whose
+ * `extraData.generic.hasFieldResearchTasks` is true, with an id and hours. The feed gives local
+ * wall-clock times, read in `zone`; an in-person city edition (times in UTC, another city) is left
+ * out, as the big events' are. One that ends before it starts, or lasts more than a month, is
+ * left out. In order of their start.
+ *
+ * Throws when the document is not a list of events at all, so that the caller keeps what it had.
+ */
+export function parseResearchEventFeed(json: unknown, zone: string): ResearchEvent[] {
+  if (!Array.isArray(json)) throw new Error('The events feed is not a list of events');
+  const events: ResearchEvent[] = [];
+  for (const value of json as unknown[]) {
+    const parsed = researchItem.safeParse(value);
+    if (!parsed.success) continue;
+    const { eventID: id, eventType, name, start: from, end: to } = parsed.data;
+    if (typeof from !== 'string' || typeof to !== 'string') continue;
+    if (ZONED_TIME.test(from) || ZONED_TIME.test(to)) continue;
+    const start = DateTime.fromISO(from, { zone });
+    const end = DateTime.fromISO(to, { zone });
+    if (!start.isValid || !end.isValid) continue;
+    const length = end.toMillis() - start.toMillis();
+    if (length <= 0 || length > MAX_RESEARCH_EVENT_MS) continue;
+    events.push({ id, name, eventType, start: start.toMillis(), end: end.toMillis() });
+  }
+  return events.sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start || a.id.localeCompare(b.id));
+}
diff --git a/src/domain/time/research-periods.test.ts b/src/domain/time/research-periods.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..969106e1c7b6739fe58ae93d5fac1ee09619bc94
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/domain/time/research-periods.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,216 @@
+import { DateTime } from 'luxon';
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import { INTO_THE_WILD, PAWNIARD_DAY } from '../../../test/support/research-store-cases.js';
+import type { ResearchEvent } from './research-events.js';
+import { eventShape, nextPeriodChange, periodAt } from './research-periods.js';
+
+const ZONE = 'America/New_York';
+/** A moment of New York's clock. */
+const at = (local: string): number => DateTime.fromISO(local, { zone: ZONE }).toMillis();
+const EVENTS = [INTO_THE_WILD, PAWNIARD_DAY];
+
+/** A global GO Fest with field research: 10:00 to 18:00 on two days (one start, one end). */
+const FEST: ResearchEvent = {
+  id: 'pokemon-go-fest-2027-global',
+  name: 'Pokémon GO Fest 2027: Global',
+  eventType: 'pokemon-go-fest',
+  start: at('2027-06-26T10:00'),
+  end: at('2027-06-27T18:00'),
+};
+
+/** An event crossing midnight, 22:00 to 02:00. */
+const NIGHT: ResearchEvent = {
+  id: 'night-owl-2026',
+  name: 'Night Owl',
+  eventType: 'event',
+  start: at('2026-12-04T22:00'),
+  end: at('2026-12-05T02:00'),
+};
+
+describe('eventShape', () => {
+  it('tells an intra-day event, a big event with daily hours and a rotation apart', () => {
+    expect(eventShape(PAWNIARD_DAY, ZONE)).toBe('window');
+    expect(eventShape(INTO_THE_WILD, ZONE)).toBe('rotation');
+    expect(eventShape(FEST, ZONE)).toBe('daily');
+    // Crossing midnight is a rotation (Matt's answer 6), a big event too.
+    expect(eventShape(NIGHT, ZONE)).toBe('rotation');
+    expect(eventShape({ ...NIGHT, eventType: 'pokemon-go-fest' }, ZONE)).toBe('rotation');
+  });
+});
+
+describe('periodAt', () => {
+  it('is the day without a research event, ending at local midnight', () => {
+    expect(periodAt(EVENTS, at('2026-10-21T10:00'), ZONE)).toEqual({
+      key: 'day:2026-10-21',
+      kind: 'day',
+      start: at('2026-10-21T00:00'),
+      end: at('2026-10-22T00:00'),
+    });
+  });
+
+  it('ends the day early at a multi-day event’s start, and starts a new day at its end', () => {
+    expect(periodAt(EVENTS, at('2026-11-09T09:59'), ZONE)).toMatchObject({
+      key: 'day:2026-11-09',
+      end: INTO_THE_WILD.start,
+    });
+    expect(periodAt(EVENTS, at('2026-11-09T10:00'), ZONE)).toEqual({
+      key: 'event:into-the-wild-2026:2026-11-09',
+      kind: 'event',
+      start: INTO_THE_WILD.start,
+      end: at('2026-11-10T00:00'),
+      event: { id: INTO_THE_WILD.id, name: 'Into the Wild' },
+    });
+    expect(periodAt(EVENTS, at('2026-11-13T19:59'), ZONE).end).toBe(INTO_THE_WILD.end);
+    expect(periodAt(EVENTS, at('2026-11-13T20:00'), ZONE)).toEqual({
+      key: 'day:2026-11-13',
+      kind: 'day',
+      start: INTO_THE_WILD.end,
+      end: at('2026-11-14T00:00'),
+    });
+  });
+
+  it('rolls a multi-day event’s tasks over at each local midnight inside it (Matt, 2026-10-22)', () => {
+    expect(periodAt(EVENTS, at('2026-11-10T23:59'), ZONE)).toMatchObject({
+      key: 'event:into-the-wild-2026:2026-11-10',
+      start: at('2026-11-10T00:00'),
+      end: at('2026-11-11T00:00'),
+    });
+    expect(periodAt(EVENTS, at('2026-11-11T00:00'), ZONE)).toEqual({
+      key: 'event:into-the-wild-2026:2026-11-11',
+      kind: 'event',
+      start: at('2026-11-11T00:00'),
+      end: at('2026-11-12T00:00'),
+      event: { id: INTO_THE_WILD.id, name: 'Into the Wild' },
+    });
+    expect(periodAt(EVENTS, at('2026-11-13T19:59'), ZONE)).toMatchObject({
+      key: 'event:into-the-wild-2026:2026-11-13',
+      start: at('2026-11-13T00:00'),
+    });
+    expect(nextPeriodChange(EVENTS, at('2026-11-10T20:00'), ZONE)).toBe(at('2026-11-11T00:00'));
+  });
+
+  it('rolls over at midnight on the day the clocks change inside a multi-day event', () => {
+    const fall: ResearchEvent = {
+      ...INTO_THE_WILD,
+      id: 'fall-2026',
+      start: at('2026-10-31T10:00'),
+      end: at('2026-11-02T20:00'),
+    };
+    expect(periodAt([fall], at('2026-11-01T12:00'), ZONE)).toMatchObject({
+      key: 'event:fall-2026:2026-11-01',
+      start: at('2026-11-01T00:00'),
+      end: at('2026-11-02T00:00'),
+    });
+  });
+
+  it('keeps the seconds of a big event’s daily hours (review A6)', () => {
+    const tour: ResearchEvent = {
+      id: 'pokemon-go-tour-alola-global-2027',
+      name: 'Pokémon GO Tour: Alola - Global 2027',
+      eventType: 'pokemon-go-tour',
+      start: at('2027-02-27T00:00'),
+      end: at('2027-02-28T23:59:59'),
+    };
+    expect(periodAt([tour], at('2027-02-27T23:59:30'), ZONE)).toMatchObject({
+      key: 'event:pokemon-go-tour-alola-global-2027:2027-02-27',
+      end: at('2027-02-27T23:59:59'),
+    });
+  });
+
+  it('is an intra-day event’s window, with the day’s reports waiting until it ends', () => {
+    expect(periodAt(EVENTS, at('2026-11-21T13:59'), ZONE)).toMatchObject({
+      key: 'day:2026-11-21',
+      end: at('2026-11-22T00:00'),
+    });
+    expect(periodAt(EVENTS, at('2026-11-21T14:00'), ZONE)).toEqual({
+      key: 'event:november-communityday2026',
+      kind: 'window',
+      start: PAWNIARD_DAY.start,
+      end: PAWNIARD_DAY.end,
+      event: { id: PAWNIARD_DAY.id, name: 'Pawniard Community Day' },
+      waiting: { key: 'day:2026-11-21', at: PAWNIARD_DAY.end },
+    });
+    expect(periodAt(EVENTS, at('2026-11-21T17:00'), ZONE).key).toBe('day:2026-11-21');
+  });
+
+  it('gives a big event’s each day its hours, and the day’s research before and after', () => {
+    expect(periodAt([FEST], at('2027-06-26T09:59'), ZONE).key).toBe('day:2027-06-26');
+    expect(periodAt([FEST], at('2027-06-26T12:00'), ZONE)).toMatchObject({
+      key: 'event:pokemon-go-fest-2027-global:2027-06-26',
+      kind: 'window',
+      start: at('2027-06-26T10:00'),
+      end: at('2027-06-26T18:00'),
+      waiting: { key: 'day:2027-06-26', at: at('2027-06-26T18:00') },
+    });
+    expect(periodAt([FEST], at('2027-06-26T20:00'), ZONE).key).toBe('day:2027-06-26');
+    expect(periodAt([FEST], at('2027-06-27T10:30'), ZONE).key).toBe(
+      'event:pokemon-go-fest-2027-global:2027-06-27',
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('brings a multi-day period’s reports back after an intra-day event inside it', () => {
+    const inside: ResearchEvent = {
+      ...PAWNIARD_DAY,
+      id: 'inside',
+      start: at('2026-11-10T14:00'),
+      end: at('2026-11-10T17:00'),
+    };
+    expect(periodAt([INTO_THE_WILD, inside], at('2026-11-10T15:00'), ZONE)).toMatchObject({
+      key: 'event:inside',
+      waiting: { key: 'event:into-the-wild-2026:2026-11-10', at: at('2026-11-10T17:00') },
+    });
+  });
+
+  it('waits for nothing when the period below ends with the window', () => {
+    const late: ResearchEvent = {
+      ...PAWNIARD_DAY,
+      id: 'late',
+      start: at('2026-11-21T21:00'),
+      end: at('2026-11-22T00:00'),
+    };
+    expect(periodAt([late], at('2026-11-21T22:00'), ZONE)).toMatchObject({
+      key: 'event:late',
+      kind: 'window',
+      waiting: undefined,
+    });
+  });
+
+  it('takes an event crossing midnight as a rotation, rolled over at midnight', () => {
+    expect(periodAt([NIGHT], at('2026-12-04T23:00'), ZONE)).toMatchObject({
+      key: 'event:night-owl-2026:2026-12-04',
+      start: NIGHT.start,
+      end: at('2026-12-05T00:00'),
+    });
+    expect(periodAt([NIGHT], at('2026-12-05T01:59'), ZONE)).toMatchObject({
+      key: 'event:night-owl-2026:2026-12-05',
+      start: at('2026-12-05T00:00'),
+      end: NIGHT.end,
+    });
+    expect(periodAt([NIGHT], at('2026-12-05T02:00'), ZONE)).toMatchObject({
+      key: 'day:2026-12-05',
+      start: NIGHT.end,
+    });
+  });
+
+  it('ends a day at midnight on the days the clocks change', () => {
+    // 2026-11-01 has 25 hours in New York, 2027-03-14 has 23.
+    expect(periodAt([], at('2026-11-01T12:00'), ZONE)).toMatchObject({
+      end: at('2026-11-02T00:00'),
+    });
+    expect(at('2026-11-02T00:00') - at('2026-11-01T00:00')).toBe(25 * 3_600_000);
+    expect(periodAt([], at('2027-03-14T12:00'), ZONE)).toMatchObject({
+      end: at('2027-03-15T00:00'),
+    });
+    expect(at('2027-03-15T00:00') - at('2027-03-14T00:00')).toBe(23 * 3_600_000);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('nextPeriodChange', () => {
+  it('is the next midnight, or an event’s start or end before it', () => {
+    expect(nextPeriodChange(EVENTS, at('2026-10-21T10:00'), ZONE)).toBe(at('2026-10-22T00:00'));
+    expect(nextPeriodChange(EVENTS, at('2026-11-21T09:00'), ZONE)).toBe(PAWNIARD_DAY.start);
+    expect(nextPeriodChange(EVENTS, at('2026-11-21T15:00'), ZONE)).toBe(PAWNIARD_DAY.end);
+    expect(nextPeriodChange(EVENTS, at('2026-11-13T19:00'), ZONE)).toBe(INTO_THE_WILD.end);
+    expect(nextPeriodChange([FEST], at('2027-06-27T09:00'), ZONE)).toBe(at('2027-06-27T10:00'));
+  });
+});
diff --git a/src/domain/time/research-periods.ts b/src/domain/time/research-periods.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..5ec90e20c5f508e8821bf352369600f0b6e1541f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/domain/time/research-periods.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,206 @@
+import { DateTime } from 'luxon';
+import { BIG_EVENT_TYPES } from './max-events.js';
+import type { ResearchEvent } from './research-events.js';
+
+/*
+ * Field research periods (plan 8R-1; design 4.2, 9.2, Matt's answer 6). A PokéStop's task holds
+ * for a period: the day (to local midnight); a multi-day event with research of its own, whose
+ * start and end are rotations (what was reported before is gone for good) and inside which the
+ * tasks roll over at each local midnight, as on any day (Matt, 2026-10-22); an intra-day event's
+ * window, during which the day's reports wait and after which they come back unchanged. Pure:
+ * the events are the stored ones, the zone `settings.timezone`.
+ */
+
+/**
+ * How an event's research works: `window`, an intra-day event (it starts and ends on one local
+ * day: its tasks for its hours, the period below it before and after); `daily`, a big event
+ * (`BIG_EVENT_TYPES`) over several days whose hours end before midnight, each day of it a window
+ * of those hours (GO Fest Global: 10:00 to 18:00 on two days, Matt's recollection of the game);
+ * `rotation`, any other (a multi-day event, one crossing midnight): its start and end rotate the
+ * tasks, and so does each local midnight inside it (a period per day of it).
+ */
+export type EventShape = 'window' | 'daily' | 'rotation';
+
+/** A period: its key (what a report keeps), what it is, and when it starts and ends. */
+export interface ResearchPeriod {
+  /**
+   * `day:<yyyy-mm-dd>`; `event:<eventID>` for an intra-day event's window;
+   * `event:<eventID>:<yyyy-mm-dd>` for a day of a rotation or of a big event's hours.
+   */
+  key: string;
+  /** `day`, `event` (a day of a rotation), or `window` (an intra-day event's, a big event's day). */
+  kind: 'day' | 'event' | 'window';
+  start: number;
+  /** The first moment after it: when its reports end. */
+  end: number;
+  /** The event of an `event` or `window` period. */
+  event?: { id: string; name: string };
+  /**
+   * Of a window: the period whose reports wait under it, and when they come back (the window's
+   * end); undefined when that period ends with the window, or before.
+   */
+  waiting?: { key: string; at: number } | undefined;
+}
+
+/** A window of hours an event's research holds, as a period. */
+interface Window {
+  key: string;
+  start: number;
+  end: number;
+  event: ResearchEvent;
+}
+
+const BIG: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(BIG_EVENT_TYPES);
+
+/** Minutes since local midnight. */
+function minuteOfDay(time: DateTime): number {
+  return time.hour * 60 + time.minute;
+}
+
+export function eventShape(event: ResearchEvent, zone: string): EventShape {
+  const start = DateTime.fromMillis(event.start, { zone });
+  const last = DateTime.fromMillis(event.end - 1, { zone });
+  if (start.toISODate() === last.toISODate()) return 'window';
+  const end = DateTime.fromMillis(event.end, { zone });
+  // Hours that end before midnight: the end's time of day comes after the start's.
+  if (BIG.has(event.eventType) && minuteOfDay(end) > minuteOfDay(start)) return 'daily';
+  return 'rotation';
+}
+
+/** The windows of the events: an intra-day event's hours, each day of a big event's hours. */
+function windowsOf(events: readonly ResearchEvent[], zone: string): Window[] {
+  const windows: Window[] = [];
+  for (const event of events) {
+    const shape = eventShape(event, zone);
+    if (shape === 'window') {
+      windows.push({ key: `event:${event.id}`, start: event.start, end: event.end, event });
+    } else if (shape === 'daily') {
+      const first = DateTime.fromMillis(event.start, { zone });
+      const last = DateTime.fromMillis(event.end, { zone });
+      for (
+        let day = first.startOf('day');
+        day <= last.startOf('day');
+        day = day.plus({ days: 1 })
+      ) {
+        // To the millisecond (review A6: a Tour's 00:00:00 to 23:59:59).
+        const start = day
+          .set({
+            hour: first.hour,
+            minute: first.minute,
+            second: first.second,
+            millisecond: first.millisecond,
+          })
+          .toMillis();
+        const end = day
+          .set({
+            hour: last.hour,
+            minute: last.minute,
+            second: last.second,
+            millisecond: last.millisecond,
+          })
+          .toMillis();
+        const from = Math.max(start, event.start);
+        const to = Math.min(end, event.end);
+        if (from < to) {
+          windows.push({
+            key: `event:${event.id}:${day.toISODate() ?? ''}`,
+            start: from,
+            end: to,
+            event,
+          });
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }
+  return windows;
+}
+
+/** Of what holds `time`, the one that began last (ties by key). */
+function latest<T extends { start: number; end: number; key: string }>(
+  found: readonly T[],
+  time: number,
+): T | undefined {
+  return found
+    .filter((one) => one.start <= time && time < one.end)
+    .sort((a, b) => b.start - a.start || a.key.localeCompare(b.key))[0];
+}
+
+/** The period at `time` without the windows: the day, or a rotation's. */
+function basePeriod(events: readonly ResearchEvent[], time: number, zone: string): ResearchPeriod {
+  const rotations = events
+    .filter((event) => eventShape(event, zone) === 'rotation')
+    .map((event) => ({ key: `event:${event.id}`, start: event.start, end: event.end, event }));
+  const rotation = latest(rotations, time);
+  const local = DateTime.fromMillis(time, { zone });
+  const midnight = local.startOf('day').toMillis();
+  const nextMidnight = local.startOf('day').plus({ days: 1 }).toMillis();
+  if (rotation) {
+    // Inside the event the tasks roll over at each local midnight, as on any day (Matt,
+    // 2026-10-22): a period per day of it, from its start or midnight to midnight or its end.
+    // Another rotation that starts meanwhile rotates the tasks again.
+    const next = rotations
+      .filter((other) => other !== rotation && other.start > time && other.start < rotation.end)
+      .reduce((soonest, other) => Math.min(soonest, other.start), rotation.end);
+    return {
+      key: `${rotation.key}:${local.toISODate() ?? ''}`,
+      kind: 'event',
+      start: Math.max(rotation.start, midnight),
+      end: Math.min(next, nextMidnight),
+      event: { id: rotation.event.id, name: rotation.event.name },
+    };
+  }
+  // The day begins at midnight, or where a rotation that ended today left off; it ends at the
+  // next midnight, or where a rotation begins before it.
+  const start = rotations
+    .filter((one) => one.end > midnight && one.end <= time)
+    .reduce((last, one) => Math.max(last, one.end), midnight);
+  const end = rotations
+    .filter((one) => one.start > time && one.start < nextMidnight)
+    .reduce((soonest, one) => Math.min(soonest, one.start), nextMidnight);
+  return { key: `day:${local.toISODate() ?? ''}`, kind: 'day', start, end };
+}
+
+/**
+ * The research period on at `time` (design 4.2): a window of an intra-day event (or of a big
+ * event's day) when one holds it, with the period below waiting; else a multi-day event's
+ * rotation; else the day. An intra-day event inside a multi-day one leaves the multi-day
+ * period's reports waiting.
+ */
+export function periodAt(
+  events: readonly ResearchEvent[],
+  time: number,
+  zone: string,
+): ResearchPeriod {
+  const base = basePeriod(events, time, zone);
+  const window = latest(windowsOf(events, zone), time);
+  if (!window) return base;
+  return {
+    key: window.key,
+    kind: 'window',
+    start: window.start,
+    end: window.end,
+    event: { id: window.event.id, name: window.event.name },
+    waiting: base.end > window.end ? { key: base.key, at: window.end } : undefined,
+  };
+}
+
+/**
+ * When the period may next change after `time`: the next local midnight, or the start or end of
+ * an event's window or rotation before it. The pinned post is drawn anew then.
+ */
+export function nextPeriodChange(
+  events: readonly ResearchEvent[],
+  time: number,
+  zone: string,
+): number {
+  const nextMidnight = DateTime.fromMillis(time, { zone }).startOf('day').plus({ days: 1 });
+  const boundaries = [
+    ...windowsOf(events, zone).flatMap((window) => [window.start, window.end]),
+    ...events
+      .filter((event) => eventShape(event, zone) === 'rotation')
+      .flatMap((event) => [event.start, event.end]),
+  ];
+  return boundaries
+    .filter((boundary) => boundary > time)
+    .reduce((soonest, boundary) => Math.min(soonest, boundary), nextMidnight.toMillis());
+}

+  removeNotSeen(seen: readonly string[], now: number): Promise<number> {
+    this.fail('removeNotSeen');
+    const listed = new Set(seen);
+    let gone = 0;
+    for (const [id, event] of this.rows) {
+      if (event.start > now && !listed.has(id)) {
+        this.rows.delete(id);
+        gone += 1;
+      }
+    }
+    return Promise.resolve(gone);
+  }
 }

### Task 5: 8R-1 task 5: the stop report service and /research

Prototype commit: `4469c75403bfba19e4ce4ee6a27f9a4da573e5a0`

StopReportService keeps reports at stops in the research period on when
they are made (periodAt of the stored events), each in the place of the
stop's report of the period whoever made it; a report of the same task at
the same stop again is no news. Listeners hear of every change (the pinned
posts, next) and of the reports that are news (the DMs). Taking back is the
reporter's or staff's; a replaced report does not come back; the hourly
upkeep forgets what ended.

/research report task: stop: [stop2:] ... [stop5:] [reward:] (a subcommand:
Discord takes no options beside subcommands, and /research remove is the
other one): the task from the period's list, found by its text or its
rewards' names, or typed in full (100 characters, shown through
plainNoLinks) with a reward of the list's items, Mega Energy or a Pokemon;
the stops from the stop search (the member's region first), a maps link or
coordinates naming the stop within 50 meters. Guards as /wild's refuse
before anything counts: no region, no stops known ("No PokéStops are known
here yet..."), a task gone from the list, no stop. The private answer names
each stop and what it replaced, where it shows and until when, offers "Same
task at more stops…" (the 25 nearest within 2 km without this task,
counted in /research report's window) and Take back. The limit is
settings.research.throttle; a control's throttle function now gets the
context to read it. /research remove stop: takes back the report at a stop.

+import type { AppContext } from '../../app-context.js';

+} from '../../domain/research/task.js';

+import { plain, truncate } from '../../render/text.js';
