+import { namedPlace, orList, type PlaceKindsOnly } from '../place-option.js';
+
+/*
+ * What `/research report` reads (plan 8R-1; design 4.3, 9.8): the task (a choice of the period's
+ * list, or text typed in full), up to five stops, and for a typed task its reward.
+ */
+
+/** The name `/research report` is used and counted under (the router's key of a subcommand). */
+export const RESEARCH_REPORT = 'research report';
+
+/** Where `/research` works, said wherever it does not. */
+export const RESEARCH_FROM_A_REGION =
+  'Report field research from the channel of a region, its forum or a post there.';
+
+/** Said where the server's regions hold no PokéStop at all (Matt's answer 7). */
+export const NO_STOPS_HERE =
+  'No PokéStops are known here yet; staff can `/gym import` or `/pokestop add`.';
+
+/** Said of a choice of the task list that is gone from it since it was offered (design 9.8). */
+export const TASK_LIST_CHANGED = 'The task list just changed: pick the task again.';
+
+/** Said of a place of another kind than a PokéStop. */
+export const NOT_A_STOP =
+  'Field research is at PokéStops: pick a PokéStop from the list that appears while you type.';
+
+/** Said of a pin without a PokéStop within 50 meters. */
+export const NO_STOP_AT_PIN =
+  'I know no PokéStop within 50 meters of that pin: pick one from the list that appears while ' +
+  'you type.';
+
+/** The options that name a stop, the first required. */
+export const STOP_OPTIONS = ['stop', 'stop2', 'stop3', 'stop4', 'stop5'] as const;
+
+/** Only PokéStops. */
+const STOPS_ONLY: PlaceKindsOnly = { kinds: ['stop'], refusal: NOT_A_STOP };
+
+/** `/research report`'s limit, of the settings (design 4.3: 10 reports in 30 minutes unless set). */
+export function researchThrottle(settings: Pick<Settings, 'research'>): Throttle {
+  const { uses, minutes } = settings.research.throttle;
+  return { uses, perSeconds: minutes * 60 };
+}
+
+/**
+ * The window `/research report` counts in, for the controls that count there too ("Same task at
+ * more stops…"): its throttle is a function of the settings, so its window is the varied one.
+ */
+export function researchWindow(settings: Pick<Settings, 'research'>): string {
+  return variedThrottleKey(RESEARCH_REPORT, researchThrottle(settings));
+}
+
+/** A known stop as a report keeps it. */
+export function reportedStop(place: KnownPlace | PlaceChoice): ReportedStop {
+  const point = 'point' in place ? place.point : { lat: place.lat, lon: place.lon };
+  return {
+    key: place.id,
+    name: place.title,
+    address: place.address === null || place.address === '' ? null : place.address,
+    image: place.image === '' ? null : place.image,
+    lat: point.lat,
+    lon: point.lon,
+  };
+}
+
+/**
+ * The stop an option names: a choice of the stops (`stop:<id>`), typed text that names one
+ * beyond doubt, or a maps link or coordinates, which is the nearest PokéStop within 50 meters
+ * (`PlaceFinder.nearestStop`). Refused otherwise, as `/wild near:` refuses. Resolved once per
+ * interaction (`namedPlace`): the guard's answer is the command's.
+ */
+export async function namedStop(
+  interaction: LocatedInteraction,
+  ctx: AppContext,
+  value: string,
+): Promise<ReportedStop> {
+  const place = await namedPlace(
+    interaction,
+    ctx,
+    value,
+    'or paste a link to it from a maps app',
+    STOPS_ONLY,
+  );
+  if (place === undefined) throw new UserError(NOT_A_STOP);
+  if (place.kind !== 'pin') return reportedStop(place);
+  const row = await ctx.guilds.idFor(guildIdOf(interaction));
+  const near = row === undefined ? undefined : ctx.placeFinder.nearestStop(row, place);
+  if (!near) throw new UserError(NO_STOP_AT_PIN);
+  return reportedStop(near);
+}
+
+/** The stops the options of a use name, each once, in the order of the options. */
+export async function namedStops(
+  interaction: LocatedInteraction & {
+    options: { getString(name: string, required?: boolean): string | null };
+  },
+  ctx: AppContext,
+): Promise<ReportedStop[]> {
+  const stops: ReportedStop[] = [];
+  for (const option of STOP_OPTIONS) {
+    const value = interaction.options.getString(option, option === 'stop');
+    if (value === null || value.trim() === '') continue;
+    const stop = await namedStop(interaction, ctx, value);
+    if (!stops.some((one) => one.key === stop.key)) stops.push(stop);
+  }
+  return stops;
+}
+
+/** Whether every typed word is in a text, folded as the search folds it. */
+function hasWords(text: string, words: readonly string[]): boolean {
+  const own = searchTokens(text);
+  return words.every((word) => own.some((one) => one.startsWith(word)));
+}
+
+/** A task as a choice: `Make 2 Excellent Throws · Dratini, Bagon, Axew +4`, its key the value. */
+export function taskChoice(task: ResearchTask): Choice {
+  const rewards = rewardsInShort(task.rewards);
+  const suffix = rewards === '' ? '' : ` · ${rewards}`;
+  const room = CHOICE_NAME - Math.min(suffix.length, CHOICE_NAME - 30);
+  return { name: truncate(`${truncate(task.text, room)}${suffix}`, CHOICE_NAME), value: task.key };
+}
+
+/**
+ * The choices of the `task` option (design 4.3): the period's tasks whose text has every typed
+ * word (as the beginning of a word), then those that have them among their rewards' names
+ * (`dratini` finds "Make 2 Excellent Throws · Dratini"), each in the list's order.
+ */
+export function taskChoices(ctx: Pick<AppContext, 'researchTasks'>, typed: string): Choice[] {
+  const words = searchTokens(typed);
+  const tasks = ctx.researchTasks.tasks();
+  const byText = tasks.filter((task) => hasWords(task.text, words));
+  const byReward = tasks.filter(
+    (task) =>
+      !byText.includes(task) &&
+      hasWords(task.rewards.map((reward) => reward.name).join(' '), words),
+  );
+  return [...byText, ...byReward].slice(0, MAX_CHOICES).map(taskChoice);
+}
+
+/** The items and the Mega Energy of the task list, by key: what `reward:` and `/want` offer. */
+export function listedRewards(ctx: Pick<AppContext, 'researchTasks'>): {
+  items: Map<string, string>;
+  energies: Map<number, string>;
+} {
+  const items = new Map<string, string>();
+  const energies = new Map<number, string>();
+  for (const task of ctx.researchTasks.tasks()) {
+    for (const reward of task.rewards) {
+      if (reward.kind === 'item') items.set(reward.item, reward.name);
+      if (reward.kind === 'energy' && reward.dex !== null) energies.set(reward.dex, reward.name);
+    }
+  }
+  return { items, energies };
+}
+
+/** A reward's value as a choice carries it: `pokemon:<key>`, `item:<key>`, `energy:<dex>`. */
+export type RewardValue = `pokemon:${string}` | `item:${string}` | `energy:${number}`;
+
+/**
+ * The choices of `reward:` (for a task typed in full): the items and Mega Energy of today's list
+ * that fit what was typed, then the Pokémon the search finds.
+ */
+export function rewardChoices(
+  ctx: Pick<AppContext, 'researchTasks' | 'pokemon'>,
+  typed: string,
+): Choice[] {
+  const words = searchTokens(typed);
+  if (words.length === 0) return [];
+  const { items, energies } = listedRewards(ctx);
+  const choices: Choice[] = [];
+  for (const [key, name] of items) {
+    if (hasWords(name, words)) choices.push({ name, value: `item:${key}` });
+  }
+  for (const [dex, name] of energies) {
+    if (hasWords(name, words)) choices.push({ name, value: `energy:${String(dex)}` });
+  }
+  for (const entry of ctx.pokemon.search(typed, { limit: MAX_CHOICES })) {
+    choices.push({ name: truncate(entry.name, CHOICE_NAME), value: `pokemon:${entry.key}` });
+  }
+  return choices.slice(0, MAX_CHOICES);
+}
+
+/**
+ * The reward `reward:` names: a choice (`RewardValue`), or text that names one in full (an
+ * item of today's list, `<species> Mega Energy` of one, or a Pokémon `ctx.pokemon.exact` knows).
+ * A typed reward's quantity is not said (0).
+ */
+export function readReward(
+  ctx: Pick<AppContext, 'researchTasks' | 'pokemon' | 'gameData'>,
+  value: string,
+): TaskReward {
+  const text = value.trim();
+  const { catalogue } = ctx.gameData;
+  const { items, energies } = listedRewards(ctx);
+  const picked = /^(pokemon|item|energy):(.+)$/.exec(text);
+  if (picked?.[1] === 'pokemon') {
+    const entry = catalogue.byKey(picked[2] ?? '');
+    if (entry) return encounterOf(entry);
+  } else if (picked?.[1] === 'item' && isItemKey(picked[2] ?? '')) {
+    const name = items.get(picked[2] ?? '');
+    if (name !== undefined) {
+      return { kind: 'item', item: picked[2] ?? '', name, quantity: 0, image: null };
+    }
+  } else if (picked?.[1] === 'energy') {
+    const dex = Number(picked[2]);
+    const name = energies.get(dex);
+    if (name !== undefined) return { kind: 'energy', dex, name, quantity: 0, image: null };
+  }
+  const folded = foldTaskText(text);
+  for (const [key, name] of items) {
+    if (foldTaskText(name) === folded)
+      return { kind: 'item', item: key, name, quantity: 0, image: null };
+  }
+  for (const [dex, name] of energies) {
+    if (foldTaskText(name) === folded)
+      return { kind: 'energy', dex, name, quantity: 0, image: null };
+  }
+  const entry = ctx.pokemon.exact(text);
+  if (entry) return encounterOf(entry);
+  const suggested = rewardChoices(ctx, text)
+    .slice(0, 5)
+    .map((choice) => plain(choice.name));
+  throw new UserError(
+    `I do not know "${plain(truncate(text, 80))}" as a reward. ` +
+      (suggested.length === 0 ? '' : `Did you mean ${orList(suggested)}? `) +
+      'Pick one from the list that appears while you type.',
+  );
+}
+
+function encounterOf(entry: { key: string; dex: number; name: string }): TaskReward {
+  return {
+    kind: 'encounter',
+    name: entry.name,
+    key: entry.key,
+    dex: entry.dex,
+    shiny: false,
+    cp: null,
+    image: null,
+  };
+}
+
+/**
+ * The task `task:` names (design 4.3, 9.8): a choice of the list (its key; one no longer on the
+ * list is `TASK_LIST_CHANGED`), or typed text, which is the list's task of the same folded text,
+ * else a task typed in full (at most `MAX_TYPED_TASK` characters), whose `reward` is the only
+ * reward that makes wants fire. A reward given with a task of the list says nothing more: the
+ * list knows its rewards.
+ */
+export function readTask(
+  ctx: Pick<AppContext, 'researchTasks' | 'pokemon' | 'gameData'>,
+  value: string,
+  reward: string | null,
+): ResearchSubject {
+  const text = tidyLine(value);
+  if (isTaskKey(text)) {
+    const task = ctx.researchTasks.byKey(text);
+    if (!task) throw new UserError(TASK_LIST_CHANGED);
+    return listed(task);
+  }
+  if (text === '')
+    throw new UserError('Say which task: pick one from the list that appears while you type.');
+  const key = taskKeyOf(text);
+  const known = ctx.researchTasks.byKey(key);
+  if (known) return listed(known);
+  if (text.length > MAX_TYPED_TASK) {
+    throw new UserError(
+      `A task you type may have ${String(MAX_TYPED_TASK)} characters: pick it from the list ` +
+        'that appears while you type, or shorten it.',
+    );
+  }
+  const rewards = reward === null || reward.trim() === '' ? [] : [readReward(ctx, reward)];
+  return {
+    subjectKey: typedSubject(key),
+    research: { text, category: null, rewards, typed: true },
+  };
+}
+
+function listed(task: ResearchTask): ResearchSubject {
+  return {
+    subjectKey: task.key,
+    research: { text: task.text, category: task.category, rewards: task.rewards, typed: false },
+  };
+}
diff --git a/src/commands/research/research.test.ts b/src/commands/research/research.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..efcfb7d9302e78b929706e0a644f2b7cd031ad53
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/commands/research/research.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,317 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import { answerOf, buttonId, buttonsOf, said } from '../../../test/support/gym-commands.js';
+import {
+  fakeAutocomplete,
+  fakeButton,
+  fakeChatInput,
+  fakeSelect,
+  asV2,
+  FAKE_GUILD_ID,
+  type FakeInteraction,
+  type FakeOptions,
+} from '../../../test/support/fake-interactions.js';
+import { UNBOUNDED_CHANNEL, WEST_CHANNEL } from '../../../test/support/gyms.js';
+import { selectsOf } from '../../../test/support/messages.js';
+import { pageTask } from '../../../test/support/research.js';
+import { MemoryStopReports } from '../../../test/support/stop-reports.js';
+import { createTestContext } from '../../../test/support/test-context.js';
+import { keptRow, wayspotId } from '../../../test/support/wayspot-cases.js';
+import { wayspotsWith } from '../../../test/support/wayspots.js';
+import type { WayspotRow } from '../../domain/wayspots/kept.js';
+import { InteractionRouter } from '../../discord/router.js';
+import { Throttles } from '../../discord/throttle.js';
+import { StopReportService } from '../../services/stop-reports.js';
+import {
+  NO_STOP_AT_PIN,
+  NO_STOPS_HERE,
+  NOT_A_STOP,
+  RESEARCH_FROM_A_REGION,
+  TASK_LIST_CHANGED,
+} from './research-input.js';
+import { Rehearsal } from '../../services/rehearsal.js';
+import {
+  NOT_YOUR_REPORT,
+  REPORT_CHANGED,
+  REPORT_ENDED,
+  research,
+  researchControls,
+} from './research.js';
+
+const ASH = '200000000000000061';
+const MISTY = '200000000000000062';
+const DRAGON = pageTask('Catch a Dragon-type Pokémon');
+
+/** Stops in West: two side by side, one a kilometer north, one beyond 2 km; a power spot. */
+const STOPS: WayspotRow[] = [
+  keptRow(1, { title: 'Yellow Mural', lat: 40.06, lon: -80.06, address: null }),
+  keptRow(2, { title: 'Paititi Inti', lat: 40.061, lon: -80.06, address: null }),
+  keptRow(3, { title: 'Little Bench', lat: 40.07, lon: -80.06, address: null }),
+  keptRow(4, { title: 'Far Stop', lat: 40.09, lon: -80.06, address: null }),
+  keptRow(5, { title: 'Library Garden', kind: 'powerspot', lat: 40.0502, lon: -80.0502 }),
+];
+
+async function setup(rows: readonly WayspotRow[] = STOPS) {
+  const { wayspots } = await wayspotsWith(rows);
+  const store = new MemoryStopReports();
+  const { ctx } = createTestContext({ wayspots });
+  Object.assign(ctx, {
+    stopReports: new StopReportService({
+      store,
+      events: ctx.raidEvents,
+      zone: ctx.config.settings.timezone,
+      log: ctx.log,
+    }),
+  });
+  await ctx.placeFinder.built();
+  const throttles = new Throttles();
+  const router = new InteractionRouter(ctx, [research], [researchControls], { throttles });
+  const as = (userId: string): FakeOptions => ({
+    userId,
+    displayName: userId === ASH ? 'Ash' : 'Misty',
+    channelId: WEST_CHANNEL,
+    guildId: FAKE_GUILD_ID,
+  });
+  const handled = async (interaction: FakeInteraction) => {
+    await router.handle(interaction as never);
+    return interaction;
+  };
+  return {
+    ctx,
+    store,
+    throttles,
+    report: (options: Record<string, string>, extra: FakeOptions = {}) =>
+      handled(
+        fakeChatInput({
+          commandName: 'research',
+          subcommand: 'report',
+          options,
+          ...as(ASH),
+          ...extra,
+        }),
+      ),
+    remove: (stop: string, extra: FakeOptions = {}) =>
+      handled(
+        fakeChatInput({
+          commandName: 'research',
+          subcommand: 'remove',
+          options: { stop },
+          ...as(ASH),
+          ...extra,
+        }),
+      ),
+    press: (customId: string, extra: FakeOptions = {}) =>
+      handled(
+        fakeButton({ customId, v2Message: true, ephemeralMessage: true, ...as(ASH), ...extra }),
+      ),
+    pick: (customId: string, values: string[], extra: FakeOptions = {}) =>
+      handled(
+        fakeSelect({
+          customId,
+          values,
+          v2Message: true,
+          ephemeralMessage: true,
+          ...as(ASH),
+          ...extra,
+        }),
+      ),
+    typing: (focusedName: string, focused: string) =>
+      handled(
+        fakeAutocomplete({
+          commandName: 'research',
+          subcommand: 'report',
+          focusedName,
+          focused,
+          ...as(ASH),
+        }),
+      ),
+    as,
+  };
+}
+
+const stop = (n: number): string => `stop:${wayspotId(n)}`;
+
+describe('/research report', () => {
+  it('reports a task at the stops named, privately, with more stops to offer and Take back', async () => {
+    const made = await setup();
+    const answer = answerOf(
+      await made.report({ task: DRAGON.key, stop: stop(1), stop2: 'paititi inti' }),
+    );
+    expect(said(answer)).toContain('### Field research reported');
+    expect(said(answer)).toContain(
+      '**Catch a Dragon-type Pokémon** · one of Dratini, Bagon, Axew +4',
+    );
+    expect(said(answer)).toContain('- **Yellow Mural**\n- **Paititi Inti**');
+    expect(said(answer)).toContain(
+      `-# In the pinned post "Today at the stops" of <#${WEST_CHANNEL}>, until midnight.`,
+    );
+    // Within 2 km and without the task: Little Bench, not Far Stop nor the power spot.
+    const [menu] = selectsOf(asV2(answer));
+    expect(menu?.placeholder).toBe('Same task at more stops…');
+    expect(menu?.options.map((option) => option.label)).toEqual(['Little Bench']);
+    expect(buttonsOf(answer).map(([label]) => label)).toEqual(['Take back (2 stops)']);
+    const kept = [...made.store.rows.values()];
+    expect(kept.map((one) => [one.stop.name, one.subjectKey, one.reporter])).toEqual([
+      ['Yellow Mural', DRAGON.key, { id: ASH, name: 'Ash' }],
+      ['Paititi Inti', DRAGON.key, { id: ASH, name: 'Ash' }],
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('says what a report replaced', async () => {
+    const made = await setup();
+    await made.report({ task: pageTask('Catch 7 Pokémon').key, stop: stop(1) });
+    const answer = answerOf(await made.report({ task: DRAGON.key, stop: stop(1) }, made.as(MISTY)));
+    expect(said(answer)).toContain('- **Yellow Mural** (was: Catch 7 Pokémon)');
+    expect(made.store.rows.size).toBe(1);
+  });
+
+  it('takes a task typed in full, with its reward, and its text as typed', async () => {
+    const made = await setup();
+    const answer = answerOf(
+      await made.report({
+        task: 'Win 3 raids in the rain http://x.test',
+        stop: stop(1),
+        reward: 'rare candy',
+      }),
+    );
+    expect(said(answer)).toContain('**Win 3 raids in the rain http:\u200B//x.test** · Rare Candy');
+    expect([...made.store.rows.values()][0]?.research).toEqual({
+      text: 'Win 3 raids in the rain http://x.test',
+      category: null,
+      rewards: [{ kind: 'item', item: 'rare-candy', name: 'Rare Candy', quantity: 0, image: null }],
+      typed: true,
+    });
+  });
+
+  it('refuses before counting: no region, no stops, a task gone from the list, no stop', async () => {
+    const made = await setup();
+    const refused = async (options: Record<string, string>, extra: FakeOptions = {}) =>
+      said(answerOf(await made.report(options, extra)));
+    expect(
+      await refused({ task: DRAGON.key, stop: stop(1) }, { channelId: UNBOUNDED_CHANNEL }),
+    ).toBe(RESEARCH_FROM_A_REGION);
+    expect(await refused({ task: '0123456789abcdef', stop: stop(1) })).toBe(TASK_LIST_CHANGED);
+    expect(await refused({ task: DRAGON.key, stop: `powerspot:${wayspotId(5)}` })).toBe(NOT_A_STOP);
+    expect(await refused({ task: DRAGON.key, stop: '40.03, -80.09' })).toBe(NO_STOP_AT_PIN);
+    expect(made.store.rows.size).toBe(0);
+    // Nothing counted: the limit is all there.
+    for (let n = 0; n < 10; n++) await made.report({ task: DRAGON.key, stop: stop(1) });
+    expect(said(answerOf(await made.report({ task: DRAGON.key, stop: stop(1) })))).toMatch(
+      /^You can use \/research report again in/,
+    );
+
+    const empty = await setup([]);
+    expect(said(answerOf(await empty.report({ task: DRAGON.key, stop: 'mural' })))).toBe(
+      NO_STOPS_HERE,
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('names the stop nearest to a pin, within 50 meters', async () => {
+    const made = await setup();
+    await made.report({ task: DRAGON.key, stop: '40.0601, -80.0601' });
+    expect([...made.store.rows.values()].map((one) => one.stop.name)).toEqual(['Yellow Mural']);
+  });
+
+  it('offers the period’s tasks by their text and by their rewards’ names', async () => {
+    const made = await setup();
+    const choices = (await made.typing('task', 'dratini')).respond.mock.calls[0]?.[0] as {
+      name: string;
+      value: string;
+    }[];
+    expect(choices).toContainEqual({
+      name: 'Catch a Dragon-type Pokémon · Dratini, Bagon, Axew +4',
+      value: DRAGON.key,
+    });
+    const stops = (await made.typing('stop2', 'mural')).respond.mock.calls[0]?.[0];
+    expect(stops?.map((one) => one.value)).toEqual([stop(1)]);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('the controls of /research report’s answer', () => {
+  it('reports the same task at more stops, counted in /research report’s window', async () => {
+    const made = await setup();
+    made.ctx.config.settings.research.throttle.uses = 2;
+    const answer = answerOf(await made.report({ task: DRAGON.key, stop: stop(1) }));
+    const [menu] = selectsOf(asV2(answer));
+    const picked = await made.pick(menu?.customId ?? '', [wayspotId(3)]);
+    expect(said(answerOf(picked))).toContain('### Also reported');
+    expect(said(answerOf(picked))).toContain('- **Little Bench**');
+    expect([...made.store.rows.values()].map((one) => one.stop.name)).toEqual([
+      'Yellow Mural',
+      'Little Bench',
+    ]);
+    // Two uses of two: the menu again is refused in the command's words.
+    const again = await made.pick(menu?.customId ?? '', [wayspotId(2)]);
+    expect(said(answerOf(again))).toMatch(/^You can use \/research report again in/);
+    made.ctx.config.settings.research.throttle.uses = 10;
+  });
+
+  it('acts on nothing of a report replaced since, and gives the menu’s use back (A1, B11)', async () => {
+    const made = await setup();
+    made.ctx.config.settings.research.throttle.uses = 2;
+    const first = answerOf(await made.report({ task: DRAGON.key, stop: stop(1) }));
+    await made.report({ task: pageTask('Catch 7 Pokémon').key, stop: stop(1) }, made.as(MISTY));
+    const [menu] = selectsOf(asV2(first));
+    expect(said(answerOf(await made.pick(menu?.customId ?? '', [wayspotId(3)])))).toBe(
+      REPORT_ENDED,
+    );
+    const taken = answerOf(await made.press(buttonId(first, 'Take back')));
+    expect(said(taken)).toBe(
+      'There was nothing left to take back: the report has ended, was taken back, or was replaced by a newer one.',
+    );
+    // Misty's report stands, and Ash's second use is still there: the menu's was given back.
+    expect([...made.store.rows.values()].map((one) => one.reporter.name)).toEqual(['Misty']);
+    expect(said(answerOf(await made.report({ task: DRAGON.key, stop: stop(2) })))).toContain(
+      '### Field research reported',
+    );
+    made.ctx.config.settings.research.throttle.uses = 10;
+  });
+
+  it('takes back every stop of the answer', async () => {
+    const made = await setup();
+    const answer = answerOf(await made.report({ task: DRAGON.key, stop: stop(1), stop2: stop(2) }));
+    const taken = answerOf(await made.press(buttonId(answer, 'Take back (2 stops)')));
+    expect(said(taken)).toBe(
+      'Took back **Catch a Dragon-type Pokémon** at **Yellow Mural**, **Paititi Inti**.',
+    );
+    expect(made.store.rows.size).toBe(0);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('/research remove', () => {
+  it('takes back one’s own report at a stop, another’s only as staff', async () => {
+    const made = await setup();
+    await made.report({ task: DRAGON.key, stop: stop(1) });
+    expect(said(answerOf(await made.remove(stop(1), made.as(MISTY))))).toBe(NOT_YOUR_REPORT);
+    expect(made.store.rows.size).toBe(1);
+    expect(
+      answerOf(await made.remove(stop(1), { ...made.as(MISTY), roleNames: ['Moderator'] })).content,
+    ).toBe('Took back **Catch a Dragon-type Pokémon** at **Yellow Mural**.');
+    expect(made.store.rows.size).toBe(0);
+    expect(said(answerOf(await made.remove(stop(1))))).toBe(
+      'No field research is reported at that PokéStop now.',
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('takes back nothing of a report replaced while it read the stop (A1)', async () => {
+    const made = await setup();
+    await made.report({ task: DRAGON.key, stop: stop(1) });
+    const read = await made.ctx.stopReports.at(FAKE_GUILD_ID, wayspotId(1));
+    // Misty replaces it between the read and the taking back.
+    await made.report({ task: pageTask('Catch 7 Pokémon').key, stop: stop(1) }, made.as(MISTY));
+    made.ctx.stopReports.at = () => Promise.resolve(read);
+    expect(said(answerOf(await made.remove(stop(1))))).toBe(REPORT_CHANGED);
+    expect([...made.store.rows.values()].map((one) => one.reporter.name)).toEqual(['Misty']);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('/research in rehearsal mode', () => {
+  it('names no pinned post in its answer: rehearsal mode makes none (B10)', async () => {
+    const made = await setup();
+    Object.assign(made.ctx, {
+      rehearsal: new Rehearsal({ allowlist: [ASH], regions: ['west'], staffRoles: [] }),
+    });
+    const answer = answerOf(await made.report({ task: DRAGON.key, stop: stop(1) }));
+    expect(said(answer)).not.toContain('pinned post');
+    expect(said(answer)).toContain('-# It stands until midnight.');
+  });
+});

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..1da7c7131e9e33186608a9c9bc4dccf97122e6b7
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/commands/research/research.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,410 @@
+import {
+  MessageFlags,
+  SlashCommandBuilder,
+  SlashCommandSubcommandBuilder,
+  type AutocompleteInteraction,
+  type SlashCommandStringOption,
+} from 'discord.js';
+import type { AppContext } from '../../app-context.js';
+import type { ComponentHandler, Guard, LocatedInteraction } from '../../discord/command.js';
+import { commandGroup, type SubcommandPart } from '../../discord/command-group.js';
+import { UserError } from '../../discord/errors.js';
+import { guildIdOf, isStaff, regionChannelOf, requireGuild } from '../../discord/guards.js';
+import { answer, answerApart, showInPlace, v2Answer } from '../../discord/late-reply.js';
+import { memberInfo } from '../../discord/member-info.js';
+import { STALE_COMPONENT } from '../../discord/router.js';
+import { MEMBER_WRITE_THROTTLE } from '../../discord/throttle.js';
+import { wayspotAddressLine } from '../../domain/geo/wayfarer-address.js';
+import type { Reporter, ReportedStop, StopReport } from '../../domain/stops/report.js';
+import { streetOf } from '../../domain/search/wayspot-index.js';
+import {
+  RESEARCH_ACTIONS,
+  RESEARCH_COLOUR,
+  RESEARCH_KIND,
+  researchAnswer,
+  stopLine,
+  taskText,
+  periodEndWords,
+  type MoreStop,
+} from '../../render/research.js';
+import { cutWhole } from '../../domain/geo/place.js';
+import { textMessage } from '../../render/v2.js';
+import type { ResearchOutcome, ResearchSubject } from '../../services/stop-reports.js';
+import { MAX_PLACE_TEXT, nearChoices } from '../place-option.js';
+import {
+  namedStop,
+  namedStops,
+  NO_STOPS_HERE,
+  readTask,
+  RESEARCH_FROM_A_REGION,
+  researchThrottle,
+  researchWindow,
+  rewardChoices,
+  STOP_OPTIONS,
+  taskChoices,
+} from './research-input.js';
+
+/** "Same task at more stops…" offers the stops within this many meters of the first one. */
+export const MORE_STOPS_METRES = 2_000;
+
+/** How many stops it offers: a menu's 25. */
+const MORE_STOPS = 25;
+
+/** Said of a report whose period has ended, or that is gone, under "Same task at more stops…". */
+export const REPORT_ENDED =
+  'That report has ended or was taken back: report the task again with `/research report`.';
+
+/** Said where no field research is reported at a stop now. */
+export const NOTHING_AT_STOP = 'No field research is reported at that PokéStop now.';
+
+/**
+ * Said where the report `/research remove` read at a stop was replaced or taken back before it
+ * was taken back (review A1): nothing is taken back.
+ */
+export const REPORT_CHANGED =
+  'The report at that PokéStop changed meanwhile: nothing was taken back. Look again.';
+
+/** Said to a member who would take back another's report. */
+export const NOT_YOUR_REPORT = 'Only the member who reported it, or staff, can take that back.';
+
+/** The reporter of a use, by name as shown (cut to what is kept). */
+function reporterOf(interaction: LocatedInteraction): Reporter {
+  return {
+    id: interaction.user.id,
+    name: cutWhole(memberInfo(interaction).name ?? interaction.user.username, 100),
+  };
+}
+
+/** The channels of this server's regions a stop lies in. */
+async function postChannels(
+  interaction: LocatedInteraction,
+  ctx: AppContext,
+  stops: readonly ReportedStop[],
+): Promise<string[]> {
+  const row = await ctx.guilds.idFor(guildIdOf(interaction));
+  const ours = new Set(
+    ctx.regions
+      .all()
+      .filter((region) => row !== undefined && region.guildId === row)
+      .map((region) => region.channelId),
+  );
+  return [
+    ...new Set(
+      stops.flatMap((stop) => ctx.wayspots.regionsOf(stop.key).filter((id) => ours.has(id))),
+    ),
+  ];
+}
+
+/**
+ * The stops "Same task at more stops…" offers (design 4.3): the server's PokéStops within
+ * `MORE_STOPS_METRES` of the first stop, nearest first, without a report of this subject in the
+ * period, 25 at most.
+ */
+async function moreStops(
+  interaction: LocatedInteraction,
+  ctx: AppContext,
+  first: ReportedStop,
+  subjectKey: string,
+  periodKey: string,
+): Promise<MoreStop[]> {
+  const row = await ctx.guilds.idFor(guildIdOf(interaction));
+  const ours = new Set(
+    ctx.regions
+      .all()
+      .filter((region) => row !== undefined && region.guildId === row)
+      .map((region) => region.channelId),
+  );
+  const reported = new Set(
+    (await ctx.stopReports.standing(guildIdOf(interaction)))
+      .filter((report) => report.periodKey === periodKey && report.subjectKey === subjectKey)
+      .map((report) => report.stop.key),
+  );
+  return ctx.wayspots
+    .near(first, MORE_STOPS_METRES, ['stop'])
+    .filter(
+      ({ wayspot }) =>
+        wayspot.title.trim() !== '' &&
+        !reported.has(wayspot.id) &&
+        ctx.wayspots.regionsOf(wayspot.id).some((id) => ours.has(id)),
+    )
+    .slice(0, MORE_STOPS)
+    .map(({ wayspot, metres }) => ({
+      key: wayspot.id,
+      name: wayspot.title,
+      metres,
+      where: streetOf(wayspot.address),
+    }));
+}
+
+/** The answer of a report: the view of `researchAnswer` worked out for this use. */
+async function answerOf(
+  interaction: LocatedInteraction,
+  ctx: AppContext,
+  outcome: ResearchOutcome,
+  subject: ResearchSubject,
+  also = false,
+) {
+  const stops = outcome.saved.map(({ report }) => report.stop);
+  const [first] = stops;
+  const now = Date.now();
+  return researchAnswer({
+    saved: outcome.saved,
+    channels: await postChannels(interaction, ctx, stops),
+    until: periodEndWords(outcome.period.end, now, ctx.config.settings.timezone),
+    // Rehearsal mode makes no pinned post (B10).
+    posts: ctx.rehearsal === undefined,
+    more:
+      first === undefined
+        ? []
+        : await moreStops(interaction, ctx, first, subject.subjectKey, outcome.period.key),
+    also,
+  });
+}
+
+/** Refuses what can be known before anything is reported, so that it does not count. */
+const requireResearchReport: Guard = async (interaction, ctx) => {
+  if (regionChannelOf(interaction, ctx) === undefined) throw new UserError(RESEARCH_FROM_A_REGION);
+  const row = await ctx.guilds.idFor(guildIdOf(interaction));
+  if (row === undefined || !ctx.placeFinder.hasStops(row)) throw new UserError(NO_STOPS_HERE);
+  if (interaction.isChatInputCommand()) {
+    readTask(
+      ctx,
+      interaction.options.getString('task', true),
+      interaction.options.getString('reward'),
+    );
+    await namedStops(interaction, ctx);
+  }
+};
+
+const stopOption = (name: string, required: boolean) => (option: SlashCommandStringOption) =>
+  option
+    .setName(name)
+    .setDescription(
+      required
+        ? 'The PokéStop: pick from the list, or paste a maps link'
+        : 'Another PokéStop with the same task',
+    )
+    .setRequired(required)
+    .setMaxLength(MAX_PLACE_TEXT)
+    .setAutocomplete(true);
+
+/** The choices of the options of `/research`. */
+async function researchChoices(interaction: AutocompleteInteraction, ctx: AppContext) {
+  const focused = interaction.options.getFocused(true);
+  if (focused.name === 'task') return taskChoices(ctx, focused.value);
+  if (focused.name === 'reward') return rewardChoices(ctx, focused.value);
+  return nearChoices(interaction, ctx, focused.value, ['stop']);
+}
+
+/**
+ * `/research report task: stop: [stop2:] … [stop5:] [reward:]` (plan 8R-1; design 4.3): a task
+ * at up to five PokéStops, each in the place of the stop's report of the period. No message of
+ * its own: the pinned post of the region shows it, and who wants a reward is told by DM.
+ */
+const reportResearch: SubcommandPart = {
+  data: (() => {
+    const builder = new SlashCommandSubcommandBuilder()
+      .setName('report')
+      .setDescription('Report the field research task of PokéStops')
+      .addStringOption((option) =>
+        option
+          .setName('task')
+          .setDescription('The task: pick from the list (or type it in full if it is missing)')
+          .setRequired(true)
+          .setMaxLength(100)
+          .setAutocomplete(true),
+      )
+      .addStringOption(stopOption('stop', true));
+    for (const name of STOP_OPTIONS.slice(1)) builder.addStringOption(stopOption(name, false));
+    return builder.addStringOption((option) =>
+      option
+        .setName('reward')
+        .setDescription('For a task you typed: its reward (a Pokémon, an item or Mega Energy)')
+        .setMaxLength(100)
+        .setAutocomplete(true),
+    );
+  })(),
+  help: {
+    details: (settings) =>
+      'Reports the field research task of up to five PokéStops at once. Pick the task from the ' +
+      'list that appears while you type (it finds tasks by their rewards too: `dratini`), and ' +
+      'the stops from theirs (your region’s first), or paste a maps link to a stop. A report ' +
+      'replaces the one a stop had today. Nothing is posted: the pinned post "Today at the ' +
+      'stops" of the region shows every task of the day, and members who want a reward get a ' +
+      'direct message. A task missing from the list can be typed in full, with its `reward`. ' +
+      'Your answer offers the same task at more stops nearby and takes the report back. You ' +
+      `can make ${String(settings.research.throttle.uses)} reports in ` +
+      `${String(settings.research.throttle.minutes)} minutes.`,
+    examples: [
+      '/research report task:Make 2 Excellent Throws stop:Yellow Mural stop2:Paititi Inti',
+      '/research report task:Catch 3 Pokémon in the rain stop:Fountain Square reward:Rare Candy',
+    ],
+  },
+  guards: [requireResearchReport],
+  defer: 'late',
+  throttle: (_interaction, ctx) => researchThrottle(ctx.config.settings),
+  async execute(interaction, ctx) {
+    const subject = readTask(
+      ctx,
+      interaction.options.getString('task', true),
+      interaction.options.getString('reward'),
+    );
+    const stops = await namedStops(interaction, ctx);
+    const outcome = await ctx.stopReports.reportResearch({
+      serverId: guildIdOf(interaction),
+      stops,
+      subject,
+      reporter: reporterOf(interaction),
+    });
+    await answer(interaction, v2Answer(await answerOf(interaction, ctx, outcome, subject)));
+  },
+  autocomplete: async (interaction, ctx) => {
+    await interaction.respond(await researchChoices(interaction, ctx));
+  },
+};
+
+/** `/research remove stop:`: takes back the report at a stop; one's own, or any for staff. */
+const removeResearch: SubcommandPart = {
+  data: new SlashCommandSubcommandBuilder()
+    .setName('remove')
+    .setDescription('Take back the field research reported at a PokéStop')
+    .addStringOption(stopOption('stop', true)),
+  help: {
+    details:
+      'Takes back the task reported at a PokéStop today: your own report, or any for staff. ' +
+      'The report it replaced does not come back.',
+    examples: ['/research remove stop:Yellow Mural'],
+  },
+  guards: [requireGuild],
+  defer: 'late',
+  throttle: MEMBER_WRITE_THROTTLE,
+  async execute(interaction, ctx) {
+    const stop = await namedStop(interaction, ctx, interaction.options.getString('stop', true));
+    const serverId = guildIdOf(interaction);
+    const report = await ctx.stopReports.at(serverId, stop.key);
+    if (!report) throw new UserError(NOTHING_AT_STOP);
+    // By its id, which never changes what it is (a replacement is a report of its own): one
+    // replaced since it was read is gone, and nothing is taken back.
+    const { removed, notYours } = await ctx.stopReports.takeBack(
+      serverId,
+      [report.id],
+      interaction.user.id,
+      isStaff(interaction, ctx),
+    );
+    const [gone] = removed;
+    if (!gone) throw new UserError(notYours.length > 0 ? NOT_YOUR_REPORT : REPORT_CHANGED);
+    await answer(interaction, {
+      content: `Took back **${taskText(gone.research)}** at ${stopLine(gone.stop)}.`,
+    });
+  },
+  autocomplete: async (interaction, ctx) => {
+    await interaction.respond(await researchChoices(interaction, ctx));
+  },
+};
+
+/** `/research` (plan 8R-1): field research at PokéStops, offered on every server (Matt's answer 7). */
+export const research = commandGroup({
+  data: new SlashCommandBuilder()
+    .setName('research')
+    .setDescription('Report the field research tasks of PokéStops'),
+  help: { category: 'notifications' },
+  parts: [reportResearch, removeResearch],
+});
+
+/** The stops a menu picked, as reports keep them; one gone or of another server left out. */
+async function pickedStops(
+  interaction: LocatedInteraction,
+  ctx: AppContext,
+  keys: readonly string[],
+): Promise<ReportedStop[]> {
+  const row = await ctx.guilds.idFor(guildIdOf(interaction));
+  const ours = new Set(
+    ctx.regions
+      .all()
+      .filter((region) => row !== undefined && region.guildId === row)
+      .map((region) => region.channelId),
+  );
+  return keys.flatMap((key): ReportedStop[] => {
+    const wayspot = ctx.wayspots.byId(key);
+    if (
+      wayspot?.kind !== 'stop' ||
+      wayspot.title.trim() === '' ||
+      !ctx.wayspots.regionsOf(key).some((id) => ours.has(id))
+    ) {
+      return [];
+    }
+    const address = wayspotAddressLine(wayspot.address);
+    return [
+      {
+        key,
+        name: wayspot.title,
+        address: address === '' ? null : address,
+        image: wayspot.image,
+        lat: wayspot.lat,
+        lon: wayspot.lon,
+      },
+    ];
+  });
+}
+
+/**
+ * The controls of `/research report`'s answer (kind `research`): "Same task at more stops…"
+ * (`research:<report id>:more`, a menu of stop keys: the task of that report at the stops picked,
+ * a report counted in `/research report`'s window, answered apart) and "Take back"
+ * (`research:<id>:back[:<id>…]`: those reports, the presser's own or any for staff, answered in
+ * the answer's place). Nothing is kept in memory: a report is read again by its id.
+ */
+export const researchControls: ComponentHandler = {
+  kind: RESEARCH_KIND,
+  guards: [requireGuild],
+  throttle: (_interaction, id, ctx) =>
+    id.action === RESEARCH_ACTIONS.more
+      ? { ...researchThrottle(ctx.config.settings), as: researchWindow(ctx.config.settings) }
+      : MEMBER_WRITE_THROTTLE,
+  async select(interaction, id, ctx) {
+    if (id.action !== RESEARCH_ACTIONS.more || !/^\d{1,10}$/.test(id.id)) {
+      throw new UserError(STALE_COMPONENT);
+    }
+    await interaction.deferReply({ flags: MessageFlags.Ephemeral });
+    const serverId = guildIdOf(interaction);
+    const base: StopReport | undefined = await ctx.stopReports.get(serverId, Number(id.id));
+    // Nothing reported: the use counted in `/research report`'s window is given back (B11).
+    if (!base || base.periodKey !== ctx.stopReports.period().key) {
+      throw new UserError(REPORT_ENDED, { givesBack: true });
+    }
+    const stops = await pickedStops(interaction, ctx, interaction.values);
+    if (stops.length === 0) throw new UserError(REPORT_ENDED, { givesBack: true });
+    const subject: ResearchSubject = { subjectKey: base.subjectKey, research: base.research };
+    const outcome = await ctx.stopReports.reportResearch({
+      serverId,
+      stops,
+      subject,
+      reporter: reporterOf(interaction),
+    });
+    await answerApart(interaction, await answerOf(interaction, ctx, outcome, subject, true));
+  },
+  async button(interaction, id, ctx) {
+    const ids = [id.id, ...id.args];
+    if (id.action !== RESEARCH_ACTIONS.back || !ids.every((one) => /^\d{1,10}$/.test(one))) {
+      throw new UserError(STALE_COMPONENT);
+    }
+    const { removed, notYours } = await ctx.stopReports.takeBack(
+      guildIdOf(interaction),
+      ids.map(Number),
+      interaction.user.id,
+      isStaff(interaction, ctx),
+    );
+    if (removed.length === 0 && notYours.length > 0) throw new UserError(NOT_YOUR_REPORT);
+    const [first] = removed;
+    await showInPlace(
+      interaction,
+      textMessage(RESEARCH_COLOUR, [
+        first === undefined
+          ? 'There was nothing left to take back: the report has ended, was taken back, or was ' +
+            'replaced by a newer one.'
+          : `Took back **${taskText(first.research)}** at ` +
+            `${removed.map((report) => stopLine(report.stop)).join(', ')}.`,
+      ]),
+    );
+  },
+};

diff --git a/src/render/research.test.ts b/src/render/research.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..3d7eac5882bb7e5b58f15de58eb8c6a934a57fa3
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/render/research.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+import { DateTime } from 'luxon';
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import { periodEndWords } from './research.js';
+
+const ZONE = 'America/New_York';
+const at = (local: string): number => DateTime.fromISO(local, { zone: ZONE }).toMillis();
+const seconds = (time: number): string => String(Math.floor(time / 1_000));
+
+describe('periodEndWords', () => {
+  it('says midnight for the next one, the time today, and the day and time later (B7)', () => {
+    const now = at('2026-11-12T15:00');
+    expect(periodEndWords(at('2026-11-13T00:00'), now, ZONE)).toBe('until midnight');
+    expect(periodEndWords(at('2026-11-12T20:00'), now, ZONE)).toBe(
+      `until <t:${seconds(at('2026-11-12T20:00'))}:t>`,
+    );
+    expect(periodEndWords(at('2026-11-13T20:00'), now, ZONE)).toBe(
+      `until <t:${seconds(at('2026-11-13T20:00'))}:f>`,
+    );
+  });
+});
diff --git a/src/render/research.ts b/src/render/research.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..d2d48cd031d48c598637007ec087133a319af3be
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/render/research.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,168 @@
+import {
+  ButtonStyle,
+  ComponentType,
+  type APIButtonComponentWithCustomId,
+  type APIComponentInContainer,
+  type APIStringSelectComponent,
+} from 'discord.js';
+import { DateTime } from 'luxon';
+import { encodeCustomId, encodeCustomIdIfFits } from '../discord/custom-id.js';
+import type { V2Message } from '../discord/party-gateway.js';
+import { rewardsInShort, type TaskReward } from '../domain/research/task.js';
+import type { ReportedStop, ResearchDetail, StopReport } from '../domain/stops/report.js';
+import type { ResearchPeriod } from '../domain/time/research-periods.js';
+import { cutText } from './party-post.js';
+import { clockOrDay, count, plain, plainNoLinks, truncate } from './text.js';
+import { actionRow, container, menuRow, textDisplay } from './v2.js';
+
+/** The colour of what is about field research. */
+export const RESEARCH_COLOUR = 0x9b59b6;
+
+/** The custom-id kind of the controls of `/research report`'s answer. */
+export const RESEARCH_KIND = 'research';
+
+/** The actions: "Same task at more stops…" (a menu) and "Take back" (a button). */
+export const RESEARCH_ACTIONS = { more: 'more', back: 'back' } as const;
+
+/** A task's text as shown: a typed one through `plainNoLinks` (Matt's answer 5), cut first. */
+export function taskText(research: Pick<ResearchDetail, 'text' | 'typed'>, room = 120): string {
+  const cut = truncate(research.text, room);
+  return research.typed ? plainNoLinks(cut) : plain(cut);
+}
+
+/** What a task may give, in short: `one of Dratini, Bagon, Axew +4`, `Rare Candy ×3`. */
+export function rewardWords(rewards: readonly TaskReward[]): string {
+  if (rewards.length === 0) return '';
+  const short = plain(rewardsInShort(rewards));
+  return rewards.length === 1 ? short : `one of ${short}`;
+}
+
+/** A stop as a line names it: `**Yellow Mural** · Market Street`. */
+export function stopLine(stop: Pick<ReportedStop, 'name' | 'address'>): string {
+  const name = `**${plain(truncate(stop.name, 80))}**`;
+  return stop.address === null ? name : `${name} · ${plainNoLinks(truncate(stop.address, 80))}`;
+}
+
+/** When a period's reports end, as a sentence ends: `until midnight`, `until <t:…:t>`. */
+export function untilWords(
+  period: Pick<ResearchPeriod, 'kind' | 'end'>,
+  endsShown: string,
+): string {
+  return period.kind === 'day' ? 'until midnight' : `until ${endsShown}`;
+}
+
+/**
+ * When a period's reports end, as a sentence ends: `until midnight` for the next local midnight,
+ * else the time, with its day when it is not today (`clockOrDay`; review B7): a multi-day
+ * event's last day ends at its hour, a day under a coming event at the event's start.
+ */
+export function periodEndWords(end: number, now: number, zone: string): string {
+  const midnight = DateTime.fromMillis(now, { zone }).startOf('day').plus({ days: 1 });
+  return end === midnight.toMillis() ? 'until midnight' : `until ${clockOrDay(end, now, zone)}`;
+}
+
+/** A stop "Same task at more stops…" offers: its key, name, and how far from the first stop. */
+export interface MoreStop {
+  key: string;
+  name: string;
+  metres: number;
+  where: string | undefined;
+}
+
+/** What the answer of a research report shows. */
+export interface ResearchAnswerView {
+  /** The reports made, one per stop, in the order given; with the report each replaced. */
+  saved: readonly { report: StopReport; replaced: StopReport | undefined }[];
+  /** The region channels whose pinned posts show them. */
+  channels: readonly string[];
+  /** When they end, as shown (`untilWords`). */
+  until: string;
+  /** The stops near the first that have no report of this task in the period (25 at most). */
+  more: readonly MoreStop[];
+  /** `also`: the answer of "Same task at more stops…", which says "Also reported". */
+  also?: boolean;
+  /** Whether pinned posts are made (not in rehearsal mode: then none is named). */
+  posts?: boolean;
+}
+
+/** A distance as a choice's description shows it. */
+function distance(metres: number): string {
+  return metres < 1_000 ? `${String(Math.round(metres))} m` : `${(metres / 1_000).toFixed(1)} km`;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The answer of a research report (plan 8R-1; design 4.3), for the reporter alone: the task and
+ * its rewards, each stop (with the task it replaced: "was: Catch 7 Pokémon"; "again" for the
+ * same task), where it shows and until when, "Same task at more stops…" (a menu of the stops
+ * near the first one without this task, up to five at once) and "Take back" (every report of
+ * the answer whose id fits the custom id; the rest by `/research remove`).
+ */
+export function researchAnswer(view: ResearchAnswerView): V2Message {
+  const [first] = view.saved;
+  if (!first) throw new Error('a research answer needs a report');
+  const { research } = first.report;
+  const rewards = rewardWords(research.rewards);
+  const head = [
+    `### ${view.also === true ? 'Also reported' : 'Field research reported'}`,
+    `**${taskText(research)}**${rewards === '' ? '' : ` · ${rewards}`}`,
+  ].join('\n');
+  const lines = view.saved.map(({ report, replaced }) => {
+    const before =
+      replaced === undefined
+        ? ''
+        : replaced.subjectKey === report.subjectKey
+          ? ' (again)'
+          : ` (was: ${taskText(replaced.research, 60)})`;
+    return `- ${stopLine(report.stop)}${before}`;
+  });
+  const where =
+    view.posts === false
+      ? `It stands ${view.until}.`
+      : view.channels.length === 0
+        ? `It lies in no region now, so no post shows it; it stands ${view.until}.`
+        : `In the pinned post "Today at the stops" of ${view.channels.map((id) => `<#${id}>`).join(', ')}, ${view.until}.`;
+  const parts: APIComponentInContainer[] = [
+    textDisplay(cutText(`${head}\n${lines.join('\n')}`, 3_000)),
+    textDisplay(`-# ${where}`),
+  ];
+  if (view.more.length > 0) {
+    const menu: APIStringSelectComponent = {
+      type: ComponentType.StringSelect,
+      custom_id: encodeCustomId({
+        kind: RESEARCH_KIND,
+        id: String(first.report.id),
+        action: RESEARCH_ACTIONS.more,
+      }),
+      placeholder: 'Same task at more stops…',
+      min_values: 1,
+      max_values: Math.min(5, view.more.length),
+      options: view.more.slice(0, 25).map((stop) => ({
+        label: truncate(stop.name, 100),
+        value: stop.key,
+        description: truncate(
+          `${distance(stop.metres)} away${stop.where === undefined ? '' : ` · ${stop.where}`}`,
+          100,
+        ),
+      })),
+    };
+    parts.push(menuRow(menu));
+  }
+  const ids = view.saved.map(({ report }) => String(report.id));
+  let back: string | undefined;
+  let taken = ids.length;
+  for (; taken > 0; taken--) {
+    const [id = '', ...args] = ids.slice(0, taken);
+    back = encodeCustomIdIfFits({ kind: RESEARCH_KIND, id, action: RESEARCH_ACTIONS.back, args });
+    if (back !== undefined) break;
+  }
+  if (back !== undefined) {
+    const button: APIButtonComponentWithCustomId = {
+      type: ComponentType.Button,
+      style: ButtonStyle.Danger,
+      custom_id: back,
+      label: taken === 1 ? 'Take back' : `Take back (${count(taken, 'stop')})`,
+    };
+    parts.push(actionRow([button]));
+  }
+  return { v2: true, components: [container(RESEARCH_COLOUR, parts)] };
+}

diff --git a/src/services/stop-reports.test.ts b/src/services/stop-reports.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..5db284bb9caacee31a944e99fe38ca49e533f38b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/services/stop-reports.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,170 @@
+import { DateTime } from 'luxon';
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import { PAWNIARD_DAY } from '../../test/support/research-store-cases.js';
+import {
+  DRATINI,
+  OTHER_REPORTER,
+  REPORT_SERVER,
+  REPORTER,
+  reportedStop,
+} from '../../test/support/stop-report-cases.js';
+import { MemoryStopReports } from '../../test/support/stop-reports.js';
+import { createTestLogger } from '../../test/support/test-logger.js';
+import { taskKeyOf } from '../domain/research/task.js';
+import type { ResearchEvent } from '../domain/time/research-events.js';
+import { StopReportService, type ResearchNews, type ResearchSubject } from './stop-reports.js';
+
+const ZONE = 'America/New_York';
+const at = (local: string): number => DateTime.fromISO(local, { zone: ZONE }).toMillis();
+
+const subject = (text: string): ResearchSubject => ({
+  subjectKey: taskKeyOf(text),
+  research: { text, category: 'Throwing', rewards: [DRATINI], typed: false },
+});
+const THROWS = subject('Make 2 Excellent Throws');
+const CATCHES = subject('Catch 7 Pokémon');
+
+function serviceWith(events: ResearchEvent[] = [], start = at('2026-11-21T10:00')) {
+  const store = new MemoryStopReports();
+  const clock = { now: start };
+  const service = new StopReportService({
+    store,
+    events: { researchEvents: () => events },
+    zone: ZONE,
+    log: createTestLogger().log,
+    now: () => clock.now,
+  });
+  const changed: string[] = [];
+  const news: ResearchNews[] = [];
+  service.listen({
+    changed: (serverId) => changed.push(serverId),
+    reported: (one) => news.push(one),
+  });
+  return { store, clock, service, changed, news };
+}
+
+describe('StopReportService', () => {
+  it('reports a task at several stops in the day’s period, until midnight', async () => {
+    const { service, changed, news } = serviceWith();
+    const outcome = await service.reportResearch({
+      serverId: REPORT_SERVER,
+      stops: [reportedStop(1), reportedStop(2)],
+      subject: THROWS,
+      reporter: REPORTER,
+    });
+    expect(outcome.period.key).toBe('day:2026-11-21');
+    expect(outcome.saved.map(({ report }) => [report.stop.key, report.endsAt])).toEqual([
+      [reportedStop(1).key, at('2026-11-22T00:00')],
+      [reportedStop(2).key, at('2026-11-22T00:00')],
+    ]);
+    expect(changed).toEqual([REPORT_SERVER]);
+    expect(news.map((one) => one.reports.length)).toEqual([2]);
+    expect(await service.standing(REPORT_SERVER)).toHaveLength(2);
+  });
+
+  it('replaces a stop’s report whoever made it, news only for another task', async () => {
+    const { service, news } = serviceWith();
+    await service.reportResearch({
+      serverId: REPORT_SERVER,
+      stops: [reportedStop(1)],
+      subject: THROWS,
+      reporter: REPORTER,
+    });
+    const again = await service.reportResearch({
+      serverId: REPORT_SERVER,
+      stops: [reportedStop(1), reportedStop(2)],
+      subject: THROWS,
+      reporter: OTHER_REPORTER,
+    });
+    // The same task again at stop 1 is no news; stop 2 is.
+    expect(news.map((one) => one.reports.map((report) => report.stop.key))).toEqual([
+      [reportedStop(1).key],
+      [reportedStop(2).key],
+    ]);
+    expect(again.saved[0]?.replaced?.subjectKey).toBe(THROWS.subjectKey);
+    const other = await service.reportResearch({
+      serverId: REPORT_SERVER,
+      stops: [reportedStop(1)],
+      subject: CATCHES,
+      reporter: REPORTER,
+    });
+    expect(other.saved[0]?.replaced?.research.text).toBe('Make 2 Excellent Throws');
+    expect(news).toHaveLength(3);
+  });
+
+  it('reports in an intra-day event’s window, the day’s report waiting until it ends', async () => {
+    const { service, clock } = serviceWith([PAWNIARD_DAY]);
+    await service.reportResearch({
+      serverId: REPORT_SERVER,
+      stops: [reportedStop(1), reportedStop(2)],
+      subject: THROWS,
+      reporter: REPORTER,
+    });
+    clock.now = at('2026-11-21T15:00');
+    const during = await service.reportResearch({
+      serverId: REPORT_SERVER,
+      stops: [reportedStop(1)],
+      subject: CATCHES,
+      reporter: REPORTER,
+    });
+    // Another period: nothing replaced, both stand.
+    expect(during.period.key).toBe('event:november-communityday2026');
+    expect(during.saved[0]?.replaced).toBeUndefined();
+    expect(during.saved[0]?.report.endsAt).toBe(PAWNIARD_DAY.end);
+    expect((await service.at(REPORT_SERVER, reportedStop(1).key))?.research.text).toBe(
+      'Catch 7 Pokémon',
+    );
+    // A stop with only the day's report: that one, waiting under the window.
+    expect((await service.at(REPORT_SERVER, reportedStop(2).key))?.research.text).toBe(
+      'Make 2 Excellent Throws',
+    );
+    // The window has ended: the day's reports are back, unchanged.
+    clock.now = at('2026-11-21T17:00');
+    expect((await service.at(REPORT_SERVER, reportedStop(1).key))?.research.text).toBe(
+      'Make 2 Excellent Throws',
+    );
+    expect(await service.standing(REPORT_SERVER)).toHaveLength(2);
+  });
+
+  it('takes back a member’s own reports, any for staff, and none of another server', async () => {
+    const { service, changed } = serviceWith();
+    const { saved } = await service.reportResearch({
+      serverId: REPORT_SERVER,
+      stops: [reportedStop(1), reportedStop(2)],
+      subject: THROWS,
+      reporter: REPORTER,
+    });
+    const [one, two] = saved.map(({ report }) => report.id);
+    expect(await service.takeBack(REPORT_SERVER, [one!], OTHER_REPORTER.id, false)).toMatchObject({
+      removed: [],
+      notYours: [{ id: one }],
+    });
+    expect(await service.takeBack('100000000000000009', [one!], REPORTER.id, false)).toEqual({
+      removed: [],
+      notYours: [],
+    });
+    expect(
+      (await service.takeBack(REPORT_SERVER, [one!], REPORTER.id, false)).removed.map((r) => r.id),
+    ).toEqual([one]);
+    expect(
+      (await service.takeBack(REPORT_SERVER, [two!], OTHER_REPORTER.id, true)).removed.map(
+        (r) => r.id,
+      ),
+    ).toEqual([two]);
+    expect(changed).toEqual([REPORT_SERVER, REPORT_SERVER, REPORT_SERVER]);
+  });
+
+  it('forgets the reports that ended', async () => {
+    const { service, clock, store } = serviceWith();
+    await service.reportResearch({
+      serverId: REPORT_SERVER,
+      stops: [reportedStop(1)],
+      subject: THROWS,
+      reporter: REPORTER,
+    });
+    clock.now = at('2026-11-22T00:00');
+    expect(await service.standing(REPORT_SERVER)).toEqual([]);
+    expect(await service.sweep()).toBe(1);
+    expect(store.rows.size).toBe(0);
+  });
+});
diff --git a/src/services/stop-reports.ts b/src/services/stop-reports.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..862450e700ff68b8f6b42f461cc92dfd0bdebeb4
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/services/stop-reports.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,219 @@
+import type {
+  SavedStopReport,
+  StopReportStorage,
+} from '../db/repositories/stop-report-repository.js';
+import type { Reporter, ReportedStop, ResearchDetail, StopReport } from '../domain/stops/report.js';
+import { periodAt, type ResearchPeriod } from '../domain/time/research-periods.js';
+import type { Logger } from '../log.js';
+import type { ResearchEventProvider } from './raid-event-service.js';
+
+/** What a research report is of: its subject (a task's key, `typed:<key>`) and what it says. */
+export interface ResearchSubject {
+  subjectKey: string;
+  research: ResearchDetail;
+}
+
+/** A report saved at one stop: it, and the report there it replaced. */
+export type SavedAtStop = SavedStopReport;
+
+/** What came of a research report at one or more stops. */
+export interface ResearchOutcome {
+  period: ResearchPeriod;
+  /** One per stop, in the order given. */
+  saved: SavedAtStop[];
+}
+
+/**
+ * Reports at stops that are news to members who want what they reward (plan 8R-1; design 7):
+ * those whose stop had no report of the same subject in the period before (a report of the same
+ * task again is no news), with the period and who reported.
+ */
+export interface ResearchNews {
+  serverId: string;
+  reports: StopReport[];
+  reporter: Reporter;
+  period: ResearchPeriod;
+}
+
+/** Who hears of reports as they come and go. */
+export interface StopReportListener {
+  /** Reports were made, taken back or ended in a server: its pinned posts are drawn anew. */
+  changed?(serverId: string): void;
+  /** Research reports that are news (`ResearchNews`). */
+  reported?(news: ResearchNews): void;
+}
+
+/** What came of taking reports back. */
+export interface TakenBack {
+  removed: StopReport[];
+  /** Another member's, which only staff may take back. */
+  notYours: StopReport[];
+}
+
+export interface StopReportServiceOptions {
+  store: StopReportStorage;
+  /** The events with field research (`researchEvents`), whose periods a report belongs to. */
+  events: ResearchEventProvider;
+  /** `settings.timezone`. */
+  zone: string;
+  log: Logger;
+  now?: () => number;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Reports at stops (plan 8R-1; design 1–4): field research by task at one to five stops, each
+ * in the place of the stop's report of the period, whoever made it (`StopReportStorage.save`).
+ * A report belongs to the research period that was on when it was made (`periodAt` of the
+ * stored events: design 9.2) and ends with it. Listeners hear of every change (the pinned posts)
+ * and of the reports that are news (the notifier). Taking back is the reporter's, or staff's.
+ * The hourly upkeep forgets what has ended (`sweep`).
+ */
+export class StopReportService {
+  private readonly now: () => number;
+  private readonly listeners: StopReportListener[] = [];
+
+  constructor(private readonly options: StopReportServiceOptions) {
+    this.now = options.now ?? (() => Date.now());
+  }
+
+  /** Adds a listener; it must not throw (what it throws is logged). */
+  listen(listener: StopReportListener): void {
+    this.listeners.push(listener);
+  }
+
+  /** The research period on now (or at `at`). */
+  period(at = this.now()): ResearchPeriod {
+    return periodAt(this.options.events.researchEvents(), at, this.options.zone);
+  }
+
+  /** The reports of a server that have not ended, oldest first. */
+  standing(serverId: string): Promise<StopReport[]> {
+    return this.options.store.standing(serverId, this.now());
+  }
+
+  /** A report by its id, of a server, if it has not ended. */
+  async get(serverId: string, id: number): Promise<StopReport | undefined> {
+    const report = await this.options.store.byId(id);
+    return report?.serverId === serverId && report.endsAt > this.now() ? report : undefined;
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * The report a member means at a stop: of the period on now, else of the one waiting under it
+   * (an intra-day event's window); undefined when the stop has neither.
+   */
+  async at(serverId: string, stopKey: string): Promise<StopReport | undefined> {
+    const period = this.period();
+    const here = (await this.standing(serverId)).filter((report) => report.stop.key === stopKey);
+    return (
+      here.find((report) => report.periodKey === period.key) ??
+      here.find((report) => report.periodKey === period.waiting?.key)
+    );
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Reports a task at these stops (one to five, each once) in the period on now: each in the
+   * place of the stop's report of the period. Throws what storing throws; a stop stored before
+   * the failure stays reported (each is a transaction of its own).
+   */
+  async reportResearch(input: {
+    serverId: string;
+    stops: readonly ReportedStop[];
+    subject: ResearchSubject;
+    reporter: Reporter;
+  }): Promise<ResearchOutcome> {
+    const madeAt = this.now();
+    const period = this.period(madeAt);
+    const saved: SavedAtStop[] = [];
+    try {
+      for (const stop of input.stops) {
+        saved.push(
+          await this.options.store.save({
+            serverId: input.serverId,
+            kind: 'research',
+            stop,
+            periodKey: period.key,
+            endsAt: period.end,
+            subjectKey: input.subject.subjectKey,
+            research: input.subject.research,
+            reporter: input.reporter,
+            madeAt,
+          }),
+        );
+      }
+    } finally {
+      if (saved.length > 0) this.tell((listener) => listener.changed?.(input.serverId));
+    }
+    // A stop that had this very task reported in the period is no news (design 7).
+    const news = saved
+      .filter(({ replaced }) => replaced?.subjectKey !== input.subject.subjectKey)
+      .map(({ report }) => report);
+    if (news.length > 0) {
+      this.tell((listener) =>
+        listener.reported?.({
+          serverId: input.serverId,
+          reports: news,
+          reporter: input.reporter,
+          period,
+        }),
+      );
+    }
+    this.options.log.info(
+      {
+        guild: input.serverId,
+        by: input.reporter.id,
+        stops: saved.length,
+        replaced: saved.filter(({ replaced }) => replaced !== undefined).length,
+        period: period.key,
+      },
+      'field research reported',
+    );
+    return { period, saved };
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Takes back reports of a server by their ids: those of `by`, or every one for `staff`; one
+   * gone or ended already is passed over. A replaced report does not come back (design 9.13).
+   */
+  async takeBack(
+    serverId: string,
+    ids: readonly number[],
+    by: string,
+    staff: boolean,
+  ): Promise<TakenBack> {
+    const removed: StopReport[] = [];
+    const notYours: StopReport[] = [];
+    for (const id of ids) {
+      const report = await this.get(serverId, id);
+      if (!report) continue;
+      if (!staff && report.reporter.id !== by) {
+        notYours.push(report);
+        continue;
+      }
+      const gone = await this.options.store.remove(id, serverId);
+      if (gone) removed.push(gone);
+    }
+    if (removed.length > 0) {
+      this.tell((listener) => listener.changed?.(serverId));
+      this.options.log.info(
+        { guild: serverId, by, staff, reports: removed.map((report) => report.id) },
+        'stop reports taken back',
+      );
+    }
+    return { removed, notYours };
+  }
+
+  /** Forgets the reports that have ended; gives how many (the hourly upkeep, and at start). */
+  sweep(): Promise<number> {
+    return this.options.store.removeEnded(this.now());
+  }
+
+  private tell(call: (listener: StopReportListener) => void): void {
+    for (const listener of this.listeners) {
+      try {
+        call(listener);
+      } catch (err) {
+        this.options.log.error({ err }, 'a listener of the stop reports failed');
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}

### Task 6: 8R-1 task 6: the pinned post "Today at the stops"

Prototype commit: `7775346f0419442992160a3558f54fced2d4b5ee`

StopPostService keeps one post per region channel and day: made at the
first report of the day whose stop lies in the region's outline, pinned
(Discord's notice of the pin deleted where the bot may), drawn anew a few
seconds after the reports change (coalesced), spilling into a second and a
third message and then counting the tasks left, unpinned and deleted once
its day has ended. One queue per channel does all of it, the turn of the
day included; the reads come before any call to Discord. A timer at the
next period change (midnight or an event's boundary, by Luxon in the zone)
draws the posts anew and deletes those of a day that ended; start does the
same for what a restart left (the posts kept in StopPost). Under an
intra-day event the post shows the event's tasks and when the day's
research comes back with how many stops. Plain text where the bot may not
post embeds; none in rehearsal mode.

The renderer groups research by task (most stops first): the task, its
rewards in short with the first reward's picture beside it, each stop with
its address line and reporter (memberByName), fifteen stops a task.

PartyGateway.pinMessage / unpinMessage (pinned, not-allowed, full, gone;
the fake gateway with noPinning, pinLimit and pinnedIn), guarded in
rehearsal mode. Pin Messages is an optional need of a region channel,
which cutover-check reports.

+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import { textOf } from '../../test/support/messages.js';
+import { expectV2Sendable } from '../../test/support/post-limits.js';
+import { pageTask } from '../../test/support/research.js';
+import { reportedStop } from '../../test/support/stop-report-cases.js';
+import { stopPostMessages, stopPostText, type PostTask } from './stop-post.js';
+
+const DRAGON = pageTask('Catch a Dragon-type Pokémon');
+
+/** The dragon task at `n` stops, each by a reporter of its own. */
+function atStops(n: number): PostTask {
+  return {
+    research: {
+      text: DRAGON.text,
+      category: DRAGON.category,
+      rewards: DRAGON.rewards,
+      typed: false,
+    },
+    stops: Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => ({
+      stop: reportedStop(i + 1, { name: `Stop ${'x'.repeat(60)} ${String(i + 1)}` }),
+      reporter: { id: `20000000000000${String(1000 + i)}`, name: `Member ${String(i)}` },
+    })),
+  };
+}
+
+describe('the post "Today at the stops"', () => {
+  it('names fifteen stops of a task and counts the rest, within Discord’s limits', () => {
+    const [message, ...more] = stopPostMessages({
+      day: 'Saturday, November 21',
+      tasks: [atStops(40)],
+    });
+    expect(more).toEqual([]);
+    if (!message) throw new Error('no message');
+    expectV2Sendable(message);
+    const text = textOf(message);
+    expect(text).toContain('Stop xxxxxxxxxx');
+    expect(text).toContain('- …and 25 more stops');
+    expect(text).not.toContain(' 16** ·');
+  });
+
+  it('says so when nothing is reported, and names the task beside its picture', () => {
+    const [empty] = stopPostMessages({ day: 'Saturday, November 21', tasks: [] });
+    expect(textOf(empty)).toContain('Nothing reported right now.');
+    const [one] = stopPostMessages({ day: 'Saturday, November 21', tasks: [atStops(1)] });
+    expect(JSON.stringify(one)).toContain(
+      'https://cdn.leekduck.com/assets/img/pokemon_icons_crop/pm147.icon.png',
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('is classic text of at most 2,000 characters a message, three at most', () => {
+    const many = Array.from({ length: 30 }, () => atStops(10));
+    const messages = stopPostText({ day: 'Saturday, November 21', tasks: many });
+    expect(messages).toHaveLength(3);
+    for (const message of messages) expect(message.content?.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(2_000);
+    expect(messages[2]?.content).toMatch(/…and \d+ more tasks$/);
+  });
+
+  it('names whole stop lines only, counting those that do not fit (B6)', () => {
+    // Long names and addresses with marks that escaping lengthens, long reporters' names.
+    const task: PostTask = {
+      ...atStops(0),
+      stops: Array.from({ length: 15 }, (_, i) => ({
+        stop: reportedStop(i + 1, {
+          name: `The_Old *Mural* of the ${'Long_'.repeat(13)}Street ${String(i + 1)}`,
+          address: `${String(1000 + i)} ${'Market_Street '.repeat(5)}Pittsburgh`,
+        }),
+        reporter: {
+          id: `20000000000000${String(1000 + i)}`,
+          name: `Trainer_${'Name_'.repeat(18)}${String(i)}`,
+        },
+      })),
+    };
+    const lines = (text: string) => text.split('\n').filter((line) => line.startsWith('- '));
+    const view = { day: 'Saturday, November 21', tasks: [task] };
+    const [v2] = stopPostMessages(view);
+    const [classic] = stopPostText(view);
+    for (const text of [textOf(v2), classic?.content ?? '']) {
+      const stops = lines(text).filter((line) => !line.startsWith('- …and'));
+      const more = /^- …and (\d+) more stops?$/.exec(lines(text).at(-1) ?? '');
+      // Every line named is whole: it ends with its reporter's name in bold.
+      for (const line of stops) expect(line).toMatch(/ · \*\*Trainer\\_.*\*\*$/);
+      expect(stops.length + Number(more?.[1] ?? 0)).toBe(15);
+    }
+    // The classic text has room for fewer than all fifteen.
+    expect(lines(classic?.content ?? '').at(-1)).toMatch(/^- …and \d+ more stops?$/);
+  });
+});

+import type { APIComponentInContainer } from 'discord.js';
+import type { ClassicMessage, V2Message } from '../discord/party-gateway.js';
+import type { TaskReward } from '../domain/research/task.js';
+import type { Reporter, ReportedStop, ResearchDetail } from '../domain/stops/report.js';
+import { cutText, TEXT_BUDGET } from './party-post.js';
+import { RESEARCH_COLOUR, rewardWords, stopLine, taskText } from './research.js';
+import { count, memberByName, plain, timestamp } from './text.js';
+import { container, countComponents, section, separator, textDisplay, thumbnail } from './v2.js';
+
+/*
+ * The pinned "Today at the stops" post of a region channel (plan 8R-1; design 6, 9.5, 9.7):
+ * research grouped by task, each with its rewards and its stops, in components-v2 messages of
+ * Discord's limits (40 components, `TEXT_BUDGET` of text), spilling into a second and a third,
+ * then "…and N more tasks". Plan 8R-2 adds the hideouts after the research.
+ */
+
+/** At most this many messages make one post (design 9.7). */
+export const MAX_POST_MESSAGES = 3;
+
+/** Discord's limits of a message: 40 components; classic text 2,000 characters. */
+const MAX_COMPONENTS = 40;
+const CLASSIC_TEXT = 2_000;
+
+/** How many stops of one task a post names; the rest are counted. */
+const STOPS_SHOWN = 15;
+
+/** A task of the post with the stops it was reported at. */
+export interface PostTask {
+  research: ResearchDetail;
+  stops: { stop: ReportedStop; reporter: Reporter }[];
+}
+
+/** What the post shows. */
+export interface StopPostView {
+  /** `Tuesday, October 21`: the local day. */
+  day: string;
+  /** The tasks of the period on now, most stops first. */
+  tasks: PostTask[];
+  /** The event of the period on now, when it is one's (its name). */
+  event?: string | undefined;
+  /** Under an intra-day event: how many stops' research waits, and until when. */
+  waiting?: { stops: number; at: number } | undefined;
+  /**
+   * When the period on now ends (an event's), as its line ends it: `until midnight`, `until
+   * <time>`, with the day when it is not today (`periodEndWords`; review B7).
+   */
+  until?: string | undefined;
+}
+
+/** The picture beside a task: its first reward's that has one. */
+function pictureOf(rewards: readonly TaskReward[]): string | undefined {
+  return rewards.find((reward) => reward.image !== null)?.image ?? undefined;
+}
+
+/** The line that counts the stops a task's text does not name. */
+function moreStops(left: number): string {
+  return `- …and ${count(left, 'more stop')}`;
+}
+
+/**
+ * A task as text of at most `room` characters: its line, then a line per stop with who reported
+ * it, as many whole lines as fit (`STOPS_SHOWN` at most; each line is made of parts cut before
+ * they are escaped, design 9.7, and never cut itself: review B6), then the rest counted.
+ */
+function taskBody(task: PostTask, room: number): string {
+  const rewards = rewardWords(task.research.rewards);
+  const head = `**${taskText(task.research)}**${rewards === '' ? '' : ` · ${rewards}`}`;
+  const lines: string[] = [];
+  let used = head.length;
+  for (const [index, { stop, reporter }] of task.stops.slice(0, STOPS_SHOWN).entries()) {
+    const line = `- ${stopLine(stop)} · ${memberByName(reporter)}`;
+    const left = task.stops.length - index - 1;
+    const tail = left > 0 ? 1 + moreStops(left).length : 0;
+    if (used + 1 + line.length + tail > room) break;
+    lines.push(line);
+    used += 1 + line.length;
+  }
+  const more = task.stops.length - lines.length;
+  return [head, ...lines, ...(more > 0 ? [moreStops(more)] : [])].join('\n');
+}
+
+/** The head of the post: its title, the day, an event's line and the waiting line. */
+function headText(view: StopPostView, part: number): string {
+  if (part > 0) return `-# Today at the stops, continued (${String(part + 1)})`;
+  const lines = [`## Today at the stops`, `-# ${plain(view.day)} · field research`];
+  if (view.event !== undefined) {
+    lines.push(
+      `**${plain(view.event)}**: its tasks${view.until === undefined ? '' : ` ${view.until}`}.`,
+    );
+  }
+  if (view.waiting !== undefined) {
+    lines.push(
+      `The day’s research comes back at ${timestamp(view.waiting.at, 't')} ` +
+        `(${count(view.waiting.stops, 'stop')}).`,
+    );
+  }
+  if (view.tasks.length === 0) {
+    lines.push('Nothing reported right now. `/research report` tells the region what a stop has.');
+  }
+  return lines.join('\n');
+}
+
+/** A task as components: its text with its picture beside it, or the text alone. */
+function taskParts(task: PostTask, room: number): APIComponentInContainer[] {
+  // `cutText` only as a backstop: the body fits `room` by whole lines.
+  const body = cutText(taskBody(task, room), room);
+  const picture = pictureOf(task.research.rewards);
+  return [picture === undefined ? textDisplay(body) : section(body, thumbnail(picture))];
+}
+
+/**
+ * The post as components-v2 messages (design 6, 9.7): research first (8R-2's hideouts after),
+ * the tasks in as many messages as they need of `MAX_POST_MESSAGES`, each a container of the
+ * research colour within Discord's limits; a task too long for a message is cut (text cut before
+ * it is escaped: each line is made of escaped parts, cut whole by `cutText` as a backstop); what
+ * does not fit the last message is counted there: "…and 4 more tasks".
+ */
+export function stopPostMessages(view: StopPostView): V2Message[] {
+  const messages: APIComponentInContainer[][] = [];
+  let parts: APIComponentInContainer[] = [textDisplay(headText(view, 0))];
+  let shown = 0;
+  for (const task of view.tasks) {
+    const own = taskParts(task, TEXT_BUDGET - TAIL_ROOM - 200);
+    const joined = [...parts, separator(), ...own];
+    if (fits(joined)) {
+      parts = joined;
+      shown += 1;
+      continue;
+    }
+    if (messages.length + 1 >= MAX_POST_MESSAGES) break;
+    messages.push(parts);
+    parts = [textDisplay(headText(view, messages.length)), ...own];
+    shown += 1;
+  }
+  const left = view.tasks.length - shown;
+  if (left > 0) parts.push(textDisplay(`…and ${count(left, 'more task')}`));
+  messages.push(parts);
+  return messages.map((one) => ({ v2: true, components: [container(RESEARCH_COLOUR, one)] }));
+}
+
+/** Room kept in every message for the line "…and N more tasks" and its component. */
+const TAIL_ROOM = 60;
+
+/** The text of components, as Discord counts it against a message's 4,000 characters. */
+function textOf(parts: readonly object[]): number {
+  return parts.reduce((sum: number, part) => {
+    const nested = part as { content?: unknown; components?: object[] };
+    const own = typeof nested.content === 'string' ? nested.content.length : 0;
+    return sum + own + textOf(nested.components ?? []);
+  }, 0);
+}
+
+/** Whether components fit one message with the room of the tail line kept. */
+function fits(parts: readonly APIComponentInContainer[]): boolean {
+  return (
+    textOf(parts) <= TEXT_BUDGET - TAIL_ROOM &&
+    countComponents([container(0, [...parts])]) <= MAX_COMPONENTS - 1
+  );
+}
+
+/**
+ * The post as plain text, where the bot may not post embeds (as `spawnTextMessage`): the same
+ * lines in messages of Discord's 2,000 characters, `MAX_POST_MESSAGES` at most.
+ */
+export function stopPostText(view: StopPostView): ClassicMessage[] {
+  const blocks = [
+    headText(view, 0),
+    ...view.tasks.map((task) => cutText(taskBody(task, 1_800), 1_800)),
+  ];
+  const messages: string[] = [];
+  let current = '';
+  let shown = -1;
+  for (const block of blocks) {
+    const joined = current === '' ? block : `${current}\n\n${block}`;
+    if (joined.length <= CLASSIC_TEXT - 60) {
+      current = joined;
+      shown += 1;
+      continue;
+    }
+    if (messages.length + 1 >= MAX_POST_MESSAGES) break;
+    messages.push(current);
+    current = block;
+    shown += 1;
+  }
+  const left = view.tasks.length - shown;
+  if (left > 0) current = `${current}\n…and ${count(left, 'more task')}`;
+  messages.push(current);
+  return messages.map((content) => ({ content }));
+}
