diff --git a/src/services/stop-posts.test.ts b/src/services/stop-posts.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..1a63a4eb038956d99ebb2bd0d6a4bbf533e6c93f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/services/stop-posts.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,304 @@
+import { DateTime } from 'luxon';
+import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import { FakePartyGateway } from '../../test/support/fake-gateway.js';
+import { FAKE_GUILD_ID } from '../../test/support/fake-interactions.js';
+import { EAST_CHANNEL, testRegions, WEST_CHANNEL } from '../../test/support/gyms.js';
+import { textOf } from '../../test/support/messages.js';
+import { expectV2Sendable } from '../../test/support/post-limits.js';
+import { pageTask, researchTasksOfPage } from '../../test/support/research.js';
+import { INTO_THE_WILD, PAWNIARD_DAY } from '../../test/support/research-store-cases.js';
+import { MemoryStopPosts } from '../../test/support/research-store.js';
+import { reportedStop } from '../../test/support/stop-report-cases.js';
+import { MemoryStopReports } from '../../test/support/stop-reports.js';
+import { createTestLogger } from '../../test/support/test-logger.js';
+import type { ResearchTask } from '../domain/research/task.js';
+import type { ResearchEvent } from '../domain/time/research-events.js';
+import { StopPostService } from './stop-posts.js';
+import { StopReportService } from './stop-reports.js';
+
+const ZONE = 'America/New_York';
+const at = (local: string): number => DateTime.fromISO(local, { zone: ZONE }).toMillis();
+const ASH = { id: '200000000000000061', name: 'Ash' };
+
+/** Stops in West (`reportedStop` lies at 40.44: moved into West here) and one in East. */
+const west = (n: number) => reportedStop(n, { lat: 40.05 + n / 1_000, lon: -80.05 });
+const east = reportedStop(90, { lat: 40.05, lon: -79.95 });
+
+function postsWith(initial: ResearchEvent[] = []) {
+  const clock = { now: at('2026-11-21T10:00') };
+  const { log, entries } = createTestLogger();
+  const gateway = new FakePartyGateway();
+  const storage = new MemoryStopPosts();
+  // The research events, as `RaidEventService` gives them and tells of their changes.
+  let events = initial;
+  const listeners: (() => void)[] = [];
+  const provider = {
+    researchEvents: () => events,
+    onResearchChange: (listener: () => void) => {
+      listeners.push(listener);
+    },
+  };
+  const setEvents = (changed: ResearchEvent[]) => {
+    events = changed;
+    for (const listener of listeners) listener();
+  };
+  const reports = new StopReportService({
+    store: new MemoryStopReports(),
+    events: provider,
+    zone: ZONE,
+    log,
+    now: () => clock.now,
+  });
+  const make = () =>
+    new StopPostService({
+      storage,
+      reports,
+      events: provider,
+      regions: { all: () => testRegions() },
+      guilds: { idFor: (id) => Promise.resolve(id === FAKE_GUILD_ID ? 1 : undefined) },
+      gateway,
+      zone: ZONE,
+      log,
+      now: () => clock.now,
+      delayMs: 0,
+    });
+  const posts = make();
+  const report = (task: ResearchTask, stops = [west(1)]) =>
+    reports.reportResearch({
+      serverId: FAKE_GUILD_ID,
+      stops,
+      subject: {
+        subjectKey: task.key,
+        research: { text: task.text, category: task.category, rewards: task.rewards, typed: false },
+      },
+      reporter: ASH,
+    });
+  const said = (channelId = WEST_CHANNEL) =>
+    gateway
+      .messagesIn(channelId)
+      .map(({ message }) => (message.v2 ? textOf(message) : (message.content ?? '')));
+  return { clock, gateway, storage, reports, posts, make, report, said, entries, setEvents };
+}
+
+describe('StopPostService', () => {
+  let made: ReturnType<typeof postsWith> | undefined;
+  afterEach(async () => {
+    vi.useRealTimers();
+    await made?.posts.close();
+    made = undefined;
+  });
+
+  it('makes the post at the first report of the day in a region, pins it, and edits it after', async () => {
+    made = postsWith();
+    await made.posts.flush();
+    expect(made.gateway.messagesIn(WEST_CHANNEL)).toEqual([]);
+    await made.report(pageTask('Catch a Dragon-type Pokémon'));
+    await made.posts.flush();
+    const [first] = made.gateway.messagesIn(WEST_CHANNEL);
+    expect(made.said()[0]).toContain('## Today at the stops');
+    expect(made.said()[0]).toContain('Saturday, November 21');
+    expect(made.said()[0]).toContain(
+      '**Catch a Dragon-type Pokémon** · one of Dratini, Bagon, Axew +4\n- **Yellow Mural 1** · Market Street · **Ash**',
+    );
+    expect(made.gateway.pinnedIn(WEST_CHANNEL)).toEqual([first?.id]);
+    expect(made.gateway.pinNotices).toBe(1);
+    // East has no report: no post.
+    expect(made.gateway.messagesIn(EAST_CHANNEL)).toEqual([]);
+
+    await made.report(pageTask('Catch 7 Pokémon'), [west(2)]);
+    await made.posts.flush();
+    expect(made.gateway.messagesIn(WEST_CHANNEL).map((one) => one.id)).toEqual([first?.id]);
+    expect(made.gateway.messagesIn(WEST_CHANNEL)[0]?.edits).toBe(1);
+    expect(made.said()[0]).toContain('**Catch 7 Pokémon**');
+    expect([...made.storage.rows.values()]).toEqual([
+      expect.objectContaining({
+        channelId: WEST_CHANNEL,
+        day: '2026-11-21',
+        serverId: FAKE_GUILD_ID,
+        messageIds: [first?.id],
+      }),
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('shows a stop in the post of each region it lies in, and only there', async () => {
+    made = postsWith();
+    await made.report(pageTask('Catch a Dragon-type Pokémon'), [east]);
+    await made.posts.flush();
+    expect(made.said(WEST_CHANNEL)).toEqual([]);
+    expect(made.said(EAST_CHANNEL)[0]).toContain('Yellow Mural 90');
+  });
+
+  it('spills into a second and a third message, pinned too, then counts what is left', async () => {
+    made = postsWith();
+    const tasks = researchTasksOfPage();
+    for (const [n, task] of tasks.entries()) await made.report(task, [west(n % 40)]);
+    await made.posts.flush();
+    const messages = made.gateway.messagesIn(WEST_CHANNEL);
+    expect(messages).toHaveLength(3);
+    for (const { message } of messages) {
+      if (!message.v2) throw new Error('the post is components v2 here');
+      expectV2Sendable(message);
+    }
+    expect(made.gateway.pinnedIn(WEST_CHANNEL)).toEqual(messages.map((one) => one.id));
+    expect(made.said()[2]).toMatch(/…and \d+ more tasks$/);
+    expect(made.said()[1]).toMatch(/^-# Today at the stops, continued \(2\)/);
+  });
+
+  it('is plain text where the bot may not post embeds', async () => {
+    made = postsWith();
+    made.gateway.noEmbeds.add(WEST_CHANNEL);
+    await made.report(pageTask('Catch a Dragon-type Pokémon'));
+    await made.posts.flush();
+    const [message] = made.gateway.messagesIn(WEST_CHANNEL);
+    expect(message?.message.v2).not.toBe(true);
+    expect(made.said()[0]).toContain('**Catch a Dragon-type Pokémon**');
+  });
+
+  it('stands unpinned where the bot may not pin, said once in the log', async () => {
+    made = postsWith();
+    made.gateway.noPinning.add(WEST_CHANNEL);
+    await made.report(pageTask('Catch a Dragon-type Pokémon'));
+    await made.posts.flush();
+    made.gateway.noPinning.delete(WEST_CHANNEL);
+    made.gateway.pinLimit = 0;
+    for (let n = 0; n < 30; n++) await made.report(researchTasksOfPage()[n]!, [west(n)]);
+    await made.posts.flush();
+    expect(made.gateway.messagesIn(WEST_CHANNEL).length).toBeGreaterThan(1);
+    expect(made.gateway.pinnedIn(WEST_CHANNEL)).toEqual([]);
+    expect(
+      made.entries.filter((entry) =>
+        String(entry.msg).includes('the post of the stops stands unpinned'),
+      ),
+    ).toHaveLength(1);
+  });
+
+  it('under an intra-day event, shows its tasks and says when the day’s research comes back', async () => {
+    made = postsWith([PAWNIARD_DAY]);
+    await made.report(pageTask('Catch 7 Pokémon'), [west(1), west(2)]);
+    made.clock.now = at('2026-11-21T15:00');
+    await made.report(pageTask('Catch a Dragon-type Pokémon'), [west(3)]);
+    await made.posts.flush();
+    const shown = made.said()[0] ?? '';
+    expect(shown).toContain('**Pawniard Community Day**: its tasks until <t:');
+    expect(shown).toContain(
+      `The day’s research comes back at <t:${String(PAWNIARD_DAY.end / 1_000)}:t> (2 stops).`,
+    );
+    expect(shown).toContain('Catch a Dragon-type Pokémon');
+    expect(shown).not.toContain('Catch 7 Pokémon');
+  });
+
+  it('says a multi-day event’s tasks hold until midnight, and its last day’s until its hour (B7)', async () => {
+    made = postsWith([INTO_THE_WILD]);
+    made.clock.now = at('2026-11-10T12:00');
+    await made.report(pageTask('Catch 7 Pokémon'));
+    await made.posts.flush();
+    expect(made.said()[0]).toContain('**Into the Wild**: its tasks until midnight.');
+    made.clock.now = at('2026-11-13T12:00');
+    await made.report(pageTask('Catch 7 Pokémon'), [west(2)]);
+    await made.posts.flush();
+    expect(made.said()[0]).toContain(
+      `**Into the Wild**: its tasks until <t:${String(INTO_THE_WILD.end / 1_000)}:t>.`,
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('unpins and deletes the post once its day has ended, and at start one a restart left', async () => {
+    made = postsWith();
+    await made.report(pageTask('Catch a Dragon-type Pokémon'));
+    await made.posts.flush();
+    const [first] = made.gateway.messagesIn(WEST_CHANNEL);
+    await made.posts.close();
+    // A restart after midnight: the post of yesterday goes.
+    made.clock.now = at('2026-11-22T08:00');
+    made.posts = made.make();
+    await made.posts.start();
+    expect(made.gateway.deleted.map((one) => one.messageId)).toEqual([first?.id]);
+    expect(made.gateway.pinnedIn(WEST_CHANNEL)).toEqual([]);
+    expect(made.storage.rows.size).toBe(0);
+  });
+
+  it('deletes the post at midnight by its timer, computed in the zone', async () => {
+    vi.useFakeTimers({ toFake: ['setTimeout', 'clearTimeout'] });
+    made = postsWith();
+    await made.posts.start();
+    await made.report(pageTask('Catch a Dragon-type Pokémon'));
+    await made.posts.flush();
+    expect(made.gateway.messagesIn(WEST_CHANNEL)).toHaveLength(1);
+    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(at('2026-11-22T00:00') - made.clock.now - 1_000);
+    expect(made.gateway.deleted).toEqual([]);
+    made.clock.now = at('2026-11-22T00:00:01');
+    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(2_000);
+    await made.posts.flush();
+    expect(made.gateway.messagesIn(WEST_CHANNEL)).toEqual([]);
+    expect(made.storage.rows.size).toBe(0);
+  });
+
+  it('draws today’s post at start where yesterday’s stood (A2)', async () => {
+    made = postsWith();
+    await made.report(pageTask('Catch a Dragon-type Pokémon'));
+    await made.posts.flush();
+    const [yesterday] = made.gateway.messagesIn(WEST_CHANNEL);
+    await made.posts.close();
+    // After midnight, a report stands while no post service listened (a restart).
+    made.clock.now = at('2026-11-22T08:00');
+    await made.report(pageTask('Catch 7 Pokémon'), [west(2)]);
+    made.posts = made.make();
+    await made.posts.start();
+    expect(made.gateway.deleted.map((one) => one.messageId)).toEqual([yesterday?.id]);
+    expect(made.said()).toEqual([expect.stringContaining('**Catch 7 Pokémon**')]);
+    expect([...made.storage.rows.values()].map((row) => row.day)).toEqual(['2026-11-22']);
+  });
+
+  it('draws the posts anew when the research events change, and keeps its timer (A5)', async () => {
+    vi.useFakeTimers({ toFake: ['setTimeout', 'clearTimeout'] });
+    made = postsWith();
+    await made.posts.start();
+    await made.report(pageTask('Catch 7 Pokémon'));
+    await made.posts.flush();
+    expect(made.said()[0]).not.toContain('Pawniard');
+    // The feed now has an event on today, from 09:00: the post shows it at once.
+    made.setEvents([{ ...PAWNIARD_DAY, start: at('2026-11-21T09:00') }]);
+    await made.posts.flush();
+    expect(made.said()[0]).toContain('**Pawniard Community Day**: its tasks until');
+    expect(made.said()[0]).toContain('The day’s research comes back at');
+    // Its end is the next change: the timer follows the events.
+    made.clock.now = PAWNIARD_DAY.end + 1_000;
+    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(PAWNIARD_DAY.end - at('2026-11-21T10:00') + 2_000);
+    await made.posts.flush();
+    expect(made.said()[0]).not.toContain('Pawniard');
+  });
+
+  it('keeps its timer when its start cannot read the kept posts (A5)', async () => {
+    vi.useFakeTimers({ toFake: ['setTimeout', 'clearTimeout'] });
+    made = postsWith();
+    made.storage.failing.set('all', new Error('database is down'));
+    await expect(made.posts.start()).rejects.toThrow('database is down');
+    expect(vi.getTimerCount()).toBe(1);
+    made.storage.failing.clear();
+  });
+
+  it('keeps a message of the post before it pins it (A9)', async () => {
+    made = postsWith();
+    const kept: string[][] = [];
+    const pin = made.gateway.pinMessage.bind(made.gateway);
+    const { storage } = made;
+    made.gateway.pinMessage = (channelId, messageId) => {
+      kept.push([...storage.rows.values()].flatMap((row) => row.messageIds));
+      return pin(channelId, messageId);
+    };
+    await made.report(pageTask('Catch a Dragon-type Pokémon'));
+    await made.posts.flush();
+    const [message] = made.gateway.messagesIn(WEST_CHANNEL);
+    expect(kept).toEqual([[message?.id]]);
+  });
+
+  it('draws today’s post anew at start', async () => {
+    made = postsWith();
+    await made.report(pageTask('Catch a Dragon-type Pokémon'));
+    await made.posts.flush();
+    await made.posts.close();
+    made.posts = made.make();
+    await made.posts.start();
+    expect(made.gateway.messagesIn(WEST_CHANNEL)).toHaveLength(1);
+    expect(made.gateway.messagesIn(WEST_CHANNEL)[0]?.edits).toBe(1);
+  });
+});

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..5ff3dbefd2e96e4eb67c3f5f05f63b89211fd4b5

+++ b/src/services/stop-posts.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,336 @@
+import { DateTime } from 'luxon';
+import { containment } from '@pine/wayspot-core/region-membership';
+import type { StopPostRecord, StopPostStorage } from '../db/repositories/stop-post-repository.js';
+import type { OutgoingMessage, PartyGateway } from '../discord/party-gateway.js';
+import type { StopReport } from '../domain/stops/report.js';
+import { nextPeriodChange } from '../domain/time/research-periods.js';
+import type { Logger } from '../log.js';
+import {
+  stopPostMessages,
+  stopPostText,
+  type PostTask,
+  type StopPostView,
+} from '../render/stop-post.js';
+import type { Region } from '../db/repositories/region-repository.js';
+import { periodEndWords } from '../render/research.js';
+import { Gathered } from './gathered.js';
+import { KeyedLock } from './keyed-lock.js';
+import type { ResearchEventProvider } from './raid-event-service.js';
+import type { StopReportService } from './stop-reports.js';
+
+/** How long after the last change of a channel's reports its post is drawn (design 6). */
+export const POST_DELAY_MS = 3_000;
+
+/** The longest delay `setTimeout` accepts. */
+const MAX_TIMER_MS = 2 ** 31 - 1;
+
+export interface StopPostServiceOptions {
+  storage: StopPostStorage;
+  reports: Pick<StopReportService, 'standing' | 'period' | 'listen'>;
+  events: ResearchEventProvider;
+  regions: { all(): readonly Region[] };
+  /** The row of a server in `Guild` (its regions name it so), by its snowflake. */
+  guilds: { idFor(serverId: string): Promise<number | undefined> };
+  gateway: Pick<
+    PartyGateway,
+    'sendMessage' | 'editMessage' | 'deleteMessage' | 'pinMessage' | 'unpinMessage' | 'mayPost'
+  >;
+  /** `settings.timezone`: the local day and its midnight. */
+  zone: string;
+  log: Logger;
+  now?: () => number;
+  delayMs?: number;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The pinned post "Today at the stops" of every region channel (plan 8R-1; design 6, 9.5–9.7,
+ * 9.11): made at the first report of the day in the region, pinned (Discord's notice of the pin
+ * deleted where the bot may; a channel at the pin limit, or a bot without Pin Messages, gets it
+ * unpinned, logged), drawn anew a few seconds after the reports change (`POST_DELAY_MS`,
+ * coalesced), spilling into a second and third message as it grows, and unpinned and deleted
+ * once its day has ended. One queue per channel does all of it, the midnight delete included;
+ * nothing is sent to Discord while a database lock is held (the reads are done first). A
+ * timer at the next period change (midnight, an event's start or end: `nextPeriodChange`, with
+ * Luxon in `settings.timezone`) draws the posts anew and deletes those of a day that ended;
+ * `start` does the same for what a restart left. Where the bot may not post embeds the post is
+ * plain text, as `spawnTextMessage`. Rehearsal mode makes none: the bot does not start it.
+ */
+export class StopPostService {
+  private readonly now: () => number;
+  private readonly queue = new KeyedLock<string>();
+  private readonly gathered: Gathered<string>;
+  /** The posts kept, by channel (one a day each; an older day's until it is deleted). */
+  private readonly posts = new Map<string, StopPostRecord>();
+  private timer: NodeJS.Timeout | undefined;
+  private closed = false;
+  /** The changes on their way to the queue (their server's regions being looked up). */
+  private readonly asking = new Set<Promise<void>>();
+  /** The redraws of every post a change of the research events started (`flush` waits). */
+  private readonly redraws = new Set<Promise<void>>();
+  /** Channels where pinning was refused, said once each in the log. */
+  private readonly pinRefusalsTold = new Set<string>();
+
+  constructor(private readonly options: StopPostServiceOptions) {
+    this.now = options.now ?? (() => Date.now());
+    this.gathered = new Gathered({
+      delayMs: options.delayMs ?? POST_DELAY_MS,
+      send: (channelId, serverId) =>
+        this.queue.run(channelId, () => this.draw(channelId, serverId)),
+      fold: (_older, newer) => newer,
+      onError: (err, channelId) => {
+        options.log.warn({ err, channel: channelId }, 'could not draw the post of the stops');
+      },
+    });
+    options.reports.listen({
+      changed: (serverId) => {
+        const asking = this.changed(serverId).finally(() => this.asking.delete(asking));
+        this.asking.add(asking);
+      },
+    });
+    // Another event, or one moved or gone (review A5): the timer and every post follow.
+    options.events.onResearchChange?.(() => {
+      if (this.closed) return;
+      // In a set of its own (review R2): what waits for one channel never waits for the
+      // redraw of all of them.
+      const redraw = this.turnOver()
+        .catch((err: unknown) => {
+          options.log.warn({ err }, 'could not draw the posts of the stops anew');
+        })
+        .finally(() => this.redraws.delete(redraw));
+      this.redraws.add(redraw);
+    });
+  }
+
+  /** The local day of a moment, `yyyy-mm-dd`. */
+  private dayOf(time: number): string {
+    return DateTime.fromMillis(time, { zone: this.options.zone }).toISODate() ?? '';
+  }
+
+  /** The reports of a server changed: the posts of its region channels are drawn anew. */
+  async changed(serverId: string): Promise<void> {
+    if (this.closed) return;
+    try {
+      const row = await this.options.guilds.idFor(serverId);
+      for (const region of this.options.regions.all()) {
+        if (row === undefined || region.guildId !== row || region.bounds === null) continue;
+        this.gathered.later(region.channelId, () => serverId);
+      }
+    } catch (err) {
+      this.options.log.warn({ err, guild: serverId }, 'could not find the posts of the stops');
+    }
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * At start: the kept posts read, every one drawn as things stand now (a day that has ended
+   * deleted, today's made where reports stand); then the timer of the next period change, which
+   * is set also when the kept posts cannot be read (review A5).
+   */
+  async start(): Promise<void> {
+    try {
+      for (const post of await this.options.storage.all()) this.posts.set(post.channelId, post);
+    } catch (err) {
+      this.schedule();
+      throw err;
+    }
+    await this.turnOver();
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Draws every kept post as things stand now (review A2: `draw` deletes the post of a day that
+   * ended and makes today's where reports stand, none where nothing does), and waits for the
+   * next change.
+   */
+  private async turnOver(): Promise<void> {
+    try {
+      await Promise.all(
+        [...this.posts.values()].map((post) =>
+          this.queue.run(post.channelId, () => this.draw(post.channelId, post.serverId)),
+        ),
+      );
+    } finally {
+      this.schedule();
+    }
+  }
+
+  private schedule(): void {
+    if (this.closed) return;
+    if (this.timer) clearTimeout(this.timer);
+    const now = this.now();
+    const next = nextPeriodChange(this.options.events.researchEvents(), now, this.options.zone);
+    this.timer = setTimeout(
+      () => {
+        this.timer = undefined;
+        void this.turnOver().catch((err: unknown) => {
+          this.options.log.error({ err }, 'could not turn the posts of the stops over');
+          this.schedule();
+        });
+      },
+      // A moment after the change: the period after it is the one drawn.
+      Math.min(Math.max(1_000, next - now + 1_000), MAX_TIMER_MS),
+    );
+    this.timer.unref();
+  }
+
+  /** The view of a channel's post: the reports of the period on now whose stop lies in its region. */
+  private async view(channelId: string, serverId: string): Promise<StopPostView | undefined> {
+    const region = this.options.regions.all().find((one) => one.channelId === channelId);
+    if (!region?.bounds) return undefined;
+    const inside = containment(region.bounds);
+    const now = this.now();
+    const period = this.options.reports.period(now);
+    const here = (await this.options.reports.standing(serverId)).filter((report) =>
+      inside(report.stop),
+    );
+    const shown = here.filter((report) => report.periodKey === period.key);
+    const waiting = here.filter((report) => report.periodKey === period.waiting?.key);
+    return {
+      day: DateTime.fromMillis(now, { zone: this.options.zone }).toFormat('cccc, LLLL d'),
+      tasks: grouped(shown),
+      event: period.event?.name,
+      until: period.kind === 'day' ? undefined : periodEndWords(period.end, now, this.options.zone),
+      waiting:
+        period.waiting && waiting.length > 0
+          ? { stops: waiting.length, at: period.waiting.at }
+          : undefined,
+    };
+  }
+
+  /** Draws a channel's post as its reports are now; in the channel's queue. */
+  private async draw(channelId: string, serverId: string): Promise<void> {
+    const { gateway, storage, log } = this.options;
+    const day = this.dayOf(this.now());
+    const kept = this.posts.get(channelId);
+    if (kept && kept.day !== day) {
+      await this.remove(kept);
+    }
+    const view = await this.view(channelId, serverId);
+    const post = this.posts.get(channelId);
+    if (!view) return;
+    // Nothing reported and no post yet: none is made (design 6: at the first report).
+    if (!post && view.tasks.length === 0 && view.waiting === undefined) return;
+    const messages: OutgoingMessage[] = gateway.mayPost(channelId)
+      ? stopPostMessages(view)
+      : stopPostText(view);
+    const ids: string[] = [];
+    const before = post?.messageIds ?? [];
+    for (const [index, message] of messages.entries()) {
+      const id = before[index];
+      if (id !== undefined && (await this.edit(channelId, id, message))) {
+        ids.push(id);
+        continue;
+      }
+      const sent = await gateway.sendMessage(channelId, message);
+      if (sent === undefined) {
+        log.warn({ channel: channelId }, 'the post of the stops could not be sent');
+        break;
+      }
+      ids.push(sent);
+      // Kept before it is pinned (review A9): a message sent is never lost to the storage.
+      await storage.save({ channelId, day, serverId, messageIds: [...ids], updatedAt: this.now() });
+      await this.pin(channelId, sent);
+    }
+    for (const extra of before.slice(ids.length)) {
+      if (ids.includes(extra)) continue;
+      await gateway.unpinMessage(channelId, extra).catch(() => false);
+      await gateway.deleteMessage(channelId, extra).catch((err: unknown) => {
+        log.warn(
+          { err, channel: channelId },
+          'could not delete a message of the post of the stops',
+        );
+      });
+    }
+    const record: StopPostRecord = {
+      channelId,
+      day,
+      serverId,
+      messageIds: ids,
+      updatedAt: this.now(),
+    };
+    this.posts.set(channelId, record);
+    await storage.save(record);
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Edits a message of the post; false when it is gone (or Discord refused a v2 message made
+   * plain, or the other way): then it is deleted and sent anew.
+   */
+  private async edit(
+    channelId: string,
+    messageId: string,
+    message: OutgoingMessage,
+  ): Promise<boolean> {
+    try {
+      return await this.options.gateway.editMessage(channelId, messageId, message);
+    } catch (err) {
+      this.options.log.warn({ err, channel: channelId }, 'the post of the stops is sent anew');
+      await this.options.gateway.deleteMessage(channelId, messageId).catch(() => undefined);
+      return false;
+    }
+  }
+
+  private async pin(channelId: string, messageId: string): Promise<void> {
+    const outcome = await this.options.gateway
+      .pinMessage(channelId, messageId)
+      .catch((err: unknown) => {
+        this.options.log.warn({ err, channel: channelId }, 'could not pin the post of the stops');
+        return 'failed' as const;
+      });
+    if ((outcome === 'not-allowed' || outcome === 'full') && !this.pinRefusalsTold.has(channelId)) {
+      this.pinRefusalsTold.add(channelId);
+      this.options.log.warn(
+        { channel: channelId, why: outcome },
+        outcome === 'full'
+          ? 'the channel has as many pins as Discord allows: the post of the stops stands unpinned'
+          : 'the bot may not pin in the channel: the post of the stops stands unpinned',
+      );
+    }
+  }
+
+  /** Unpins and deletes a post of a day that ended, and forgets it; in its channel's queue. */
+  private async remove(post: StopPostRecord): Promise<void> {
+    const { gateway, storage, log } = this.options;
+    for (const id of post.messageIds) {
+      await gateway.unpinMessage(post.channelId, id).catch(() => false);
+      await gateway.deleteMessage(post.channelId, id).catch((err: unknown) => {
+        log.warn({ err, channel: post.channelId }, 'could not delete the post of the stops');
+      });
+    }
+    if (this.posts.get(post.channelId) === post) this.posts.delete(post.channelId);
+    await storage.remove(post.channelId, post.day);
+  }
+
+  /** Draws what waits now, and waits for every draw. For tests and shutdown. */
+  async flush(): Promise<void> {
+    await Promise.all(this.redraws);
+    await Promise.all(this.asking);
+    await this.gathered.flush();
+    await this.queue.whenIdle();
+  }
+
+  /** Stops the timer; what waits is drawn first. */
+  async close(): Promise<void> {
+    await this.flush();
+    this.closed = true;
+    if (this.timer) clearTimeout(this.timer);
+    this.timer = undefined;
+  }
+}
+
+/** Reports grouped by task: most stops first, then by the first report. */
+export function grouped(reports: readonly StopReport[]): PostTask[] {
+  const bySubject = new Map<string, PostTask & { first: number }>();
+  for (const report of reports) {
+    const known = bySubject.get(report.subjectKey);
+    const stop = { stop: report.stop, reporter: report.reporter };
+    if (known) known.stops.push(stop);
+    else
+      bySubject.set(report.subjectKey, {
+        research: report.research,
+        stops: [stop],
+        first: report.madeAt,
+      });
+  }
+  return [...bySubject.values()]
+    .sort((a, b) => b.stops.length - a.stops.length || a.first - b.first)
+    .map(({ research, stops }) => ({ research, stops }));
+}

+  /**

+      this.pins.get(channelId)?.delete(messageId);
+      return true;
+    });
+  }
+

### Task 7: 8R-1 task 7: /want's dialog of boxes, TargetWant, max battles by their boxes

Prototype commit: `7e50421e3ee78f2caa9510b12cc12165772e6f74`

/want takes only a target: a Pokémon, a form, a raid tier, perfect or
zero IVs, or an item or Mega Energy of the task list (offered after the
Pokémon, tiers and IVs). A Pokémon or a form opens "Dratini: what for?",
one checkbox group of the boxes that can happen (Raids; Dynamax and
Gigantamax where the game master or the max boss list has it; Spawns where
it is met in the wild; Research but for a mega; Shadow where the game
master or a shadow raid boss of now has it), ticked as the member's rows
are, read within Discord's three seconds; a tier asks Raids and Shadow
raids. What can be only one thing (a mega, a tier without shadow raids),
IVs and rewards are written at once. The Submit (wantbox) writes the
shown boxes in one transaction under the member's lock
(WantBoxRepository over PokemonNotification and TargetWant; the scope rows
and the shadow row through the codec as before, raid now meaning raids
only); nothing ticked takes it off.

/wants lists each target once with its boxes; /unwant takes every box of
a target off and lists the member's targets so; /unwant-all and the DM
Stop buttons cover TargetWant (target and subject reasons in stopArgs).

maxWantsFiring reads the Dynamax and Gigantamax boxes (TargetWant)
instead of a species want; the hour per member, kind and boss stays.

diff --git a/src/commands/notifications/want-boxes.ts b/src/commands/notifications/want-boxes.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..b0cc35f3843c49530d9dd787ce7e009060da20ce
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/commands/notifications/want-boxes.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,262 @@
+import type { AppContext } from '../../app-context.js';
+import {
+  parseTargetWantToken,
+  targetWantToken,
+  type TargetWant,
+} from '../../domain/notify/target-wants.js';
+import type { PokemonEntry } from '../../domain/pogo/game-master.js';
+import {
+  notificationTiers,
+  type NotificationTarget,
+} from '../../domain/pogo/notification-target.js';
+import { raidTier, raidTierLabel } from '../../domain/pogo/raid-tier.js';
+import {
+  baseTarget,
+  heldBoxes,
+  pokemonBoxes,
+  subjectOf,
+  subjectOfTarget,
+  sameSubject,
+  targetWantLabel,
+  tierBoxes,
+  BOX_WORDS,
+  POKEMON_BOXES,
+  type BoxSubject,
+  type WantBox,
+} from '../../domain/pogo/want-boxes.js';
+import { appearsInWild } from '../../domain/pogo/wild.js';
+import type { WantList } from '../../domain/pogo/wants.js';
+import { foldTaskText } from '../../domain/research/task.js';
+import { searchTokens } from '../../domain/search/text.js';
+import type { TargetWantList } from '../../db/repositories/target-want-repository.js';
+import { truncate } from '../../render/text.js';
+import { listedRewards } from '../research/research-input.js';
+import { byName, CHOICE_NAME, type Choice } from '../choices.js';
+import { wildExceptionsOf } from './wild.js';
+import { typedWant, wantLabel } from './want-input.js';
+
+/*
+ * What `/want`, `/unwant` and `/wants` make of the boxes of the dialog (plan 8R-1; design 7, 9.1,
+ * 9.9): a target as a member names it (`Wanted`), the boxes a Pokémon's or a tier's dialog shows,
+ * the items and Mega Energy of the task list as targets of their own, and the member's wants
+ * grouped as the list shows them, one line per target with its boxes.
+ */
+
+/** What `/want` and `/unwant` were given: a subject of boxes, IVs, or a research reward. */
+export type Wanted =
+  | { kind: 'subject'; subject: BoxSubject; target: NotificationTarget }
+  | { kind: 'iv'; target: NotificationTarget }
+  | { kind: 'reward'; want: TargetWant };
+
+/** What a subject is called: `Dratini`, `Giratina (every form)`, `Mega Charizard Y`, `T5`. */
+export function subjectLabel(ctx: AppContext, subject: BoxSubject): string {
+  if (subject.kind === 'tier') {
+    const tier = raidTier(subject.level, false);
+    return tier ? raidTierLabel(tier) : subject.level;
+  }
+  return wantLabel(ctx, baseTarget(subject));
+}
+
+/** A research reward of `TargetWant`'s, named as the task list names its items. */
+export function rewardLabel(ctx: AppContext, want: TargetWant): string {
+  return targetWantLabel(ctx.gameData.catalogue, want, listedRewards(ctx).items);
+}
+
+/** The entries of a subject: every entry of a species, the one entry of a form. */
+function entriesOf(
+  ctx: AppContext,
+  subject: BoxSubject & { kind: 'pokemon' },
+): readonly PokemonEntry[] {
+  const { catalogue } = ctx.gameData;
+  if (subject.form === undefined) return catalogue.byDex(subject.dex);
+  const entry = catalogue.byKey(subject.form);
+  return entry?.dex === subject.dex ? [entry] : [];
+}
+
+/**
+ * The boxes the dialog of a subject shows (design 7: only what can happen): of a tier, Raids and
+ * its shadow raids where it has them; of a Pokémon, `pokemonBoxes` with the game master, the
+ * settings' wild exceptions, the max boss list and the raid boss list of now.
+ */
+export function shownBoxes(ctx: AppContext, subject: BoxSubject): WantBox[] {
+  if (subject.kind === 'tier') return tierBoxes(subject.level);
+  const entries = entriesOf(ctx, subject);
+  const keys = new Set(entries.map((entry) => entry.key));
+  const fits = (entry: PokemonEntry | undefined): boolean =>
+    entry !== undefined &&
+    (subject.form === undefined ? entry.dex === subject.dex : keys.has(entry.key));
+  const maxBosses = ctx.maxBosses.bosses();
+  const { species } = wildExceptionsOf(ctx);
+  const { catalogue } = ctx.gameData;
+  return pokemonBoxes({
+    entries,
+    wild: (entry) => {
+      const full = catalogue.byKey(entry.key);
+      return full !== undefined && appearsInWild(full, species);
+    },
+    canDynamax: (entry) => {
+      const full = catalogue.byKey(entry.key);
+      return full !== undefined && catalogue.canDynamax(full);
+    },
+    canGigantamax: (entry) => {
+      const full = catalogue.byKey(entry.key);
+      return full !== undefined && catalogue.canGigantamax(full);
+    },
+    dynamaxListed: maxBosses.some((boss) => boss.tier !== 'G' && fits(boss.entry)),
+    gigantamaxListed: maxBosses.some((boss) => boss.tier === 'G' && fits(boss.entry)),
+    shadowBoss: ctx.raidBosses.bosses().some((boss) => boss.tier.shadow && fits(boss.entry)),
+  });
+}
+
+/** Every box of a kind of subject: what `/unwant` and a list's Remove take away. */
+export function allBoxes(subject: BoxSubject): readonly WantBox[] {
+  return subject.kind === 'tier' ? ['raids', 'shadow-raids'] : POKEMON_BOXES;
+}
+
+/** Whether every typed word begins a word of a name. */
+function begins(name: string, words: readonly string[]): boolean {
+  const own = searchTokens(name);
+  return words.length > 0 && words.every((word) => own.some((one) => one.startsWith(word)));
+}
+
+/**
+ * The items and Mega Energy of the task list as choices of `/want` (design 7, 9.9: research
+ * rewards are targets of their own): those whose name every typed word begins, their value the
+ * `TargetWant` token.
+ */
+export function rewardWantChoices(ctx: AppContext, typed: string): Choice[] {
+  const words = searchTokens(typed);
+  const { items, energies } = listedRewards(ctx);
+  return [
+    ...[...items].map(([item, name]): [string, TargetWant] => [
+      name,
+      { kind: 'research-item', item },
+    ]),
+    ...[...energies].map(([dex, name]): [string, TargetWant] => [
+      name,
+      { kind: 'research-energy', dex },
+    ]),
+  ]
+    .filter(([name]) => begins(name, words))
+    .sort(([a], [b]) => byName(a, b))
+    .map(([, want]) => ({
+      name: truncate(rewardLabel(ctx, want), CHOICE_NAME),
+      value: targetWantToken(want),
+    }));
+}
+
+/**
+ * What the `target` option of `/want` or `/unwant` names: a research reward (a choice's token,
+ * or an item or Mega Energy of the task list named in full), else what `typedWant` reads (a
+ * Pokémon, a form, a tier, IVs; shadow raids are the Shadow box of their Pokémon's dialog, and
+ * the shadow raids of a tier its tier's).
+ */
+export function readWanted(ctx: AppContext, value: string, own = false): Wanted {
+  const token = parseTargetWantToken(value.trim());
+  if (token?.kind === 'research-item' || token?.kind === 'research-energy') {
+    return { kind: 'reward', want: token };
+  }
+  const folded = foldTaskText(value);
+  const { items, energies } = listedRewards(ctx);
+  for (const [item, name] of items) {
+    if (foldTaskText(name) === folded)
+      return { kind: 'reward', want: { kind: 'research-item', item } };
+  }
+  for (const [dex, name] of energies) {
+    if (foldTaskText(name) === folded) {
+      return { kind: 'reward', want: { kind: 'research-energy', dex } };
+    }
+  }
+  const target = typedWant(ctx, value, own);
+  const subject = subjectOf(target);
+  return subject ? { kind: 'subject', subject, target } : { kind: 'iv', target };
+}
+
+/** A line of `/wants`: what it is called, its boxes (none for IVs and rewards), and its Remove. */
+export interface WantEntry {
+  label: string;
+  boxes: WantBox[];
+  /** What the line's Remove takes away. */
+  remove:
+    | { kind: 'subject'; subject: BoxSubject }
+    | { kind: 'want'; target: NotificationTarget }
+    | { kind: 'target'; want: TargetWant };
+  /** The token a choice of `/unwant` gives for it. */
+  token: string;
+}
+
+/**
+ * A member's wants of both tables as `/wants` lists them (design 7): each Pokémon or form once
+ * with its boxes (`Dratini: Raids, Research, Shadow`), by name; the tiers in their order with
+ * their raids and shadow raids; the IV targets; the items and Mega Energy, by name.
+ */
+export function wantEntries(
+  ctx: AppContext,
+  wants: WantList,
+  targets: TargetWantList,
+): WantEntry[] {
+  const subjects: BoxSubject[] = [];
+  const add = (subject: BoxSubject | undefined): void => {
+    if (subject && !subjects.some((known) => sameSubject(known, subject))) subjects.push(subject);
+  };
+  const ivs: NotificationTarget[] = [];
+  for (const want of wants.wants) {
+    const subject = subjectOf(want.target);
+    if (subject) add(subject);
+    else ivs.push(want.target);
+  }
+  const rewards: TargetWant[] = [];
+  for (const want of targets.wants) {
+    const subject = subjectOfTarget(want);
+    if (subject) add(subject);
+    else rewards.push(want);
+  }
+  const entry = (subject: BoxSubject): WantEntry => ({
+    label: subjectLabel(ctx, subject),
+    boxes: [...heldBoxes(subject, wants.wants, targets.wants)].sort(
+      (a, b) => BOX_ORDER.indexOf(a) - BOX_ORDER.indexOf(b),
+    ),
+    remove: { kind: 'subject', subject },
+    token:
+      subject.kind === 'tier'
+        ? `tier:${subject.level}`
+        : `pokemon:${String(subject.dex)}${subject.form === undefined ? '' : `:${subject.form}`}`,
+  });
+  const pokemon = subjects
+    .filter((subject) => subject.kind === 'pokemon')
+    .map(entry)
+    .sort((a, b) => byName(a.label, b.label));
+  const tiers = notificationTiers()
+    .filter((tier) => !tier.shadow)
+    .flatMap((tier) =>
+      subjects.filter((subject) => subject.kind === 'tier' && subject.level === tier.level),
+    )
+    .map(entry);
+  const ivEntries = (['perfect', 'zero'] as const).flatMap((iv) =>
+    ivs
+      .filter((target) => target.kind === 'iv' && target.iv === iv)
+      .map((target): WantEntry => ({
+        label: wantLabel(ctx, target),
+        boxes: [],
+        remove: { kind: 'want', target },
+        token: `iv:${iv}`,
+      })),
+  );
+  const rewardEntries = rewards
+    .map((want): WantEntry => ({
+      label: rewardLabel(ctx, want),
+      boxes: [],
+      remove: { kind: 'target', want },
+      token: targetWantToken(want),
+    }))
+    .sort((a, b) => byName(a.label, b.label));
+  return [...pokemon, ...tiers, ...ivEntries, ...rewardEntries];
+}
+
+/** The boxes in the order a line names them. */
+const BOX_ORDER: readonly WantBox[] = [...POKEMON_BOXES, 'shadow-raids'];
+
+/** A line's boxes in words: `Raids, Research, Shadow`. */
+export function boxWords(boxes: readonly WantBox[]): string {
+  return boxes.map((box) => BOX_WORDS[box]).join(', ');
+}

diff --git a/src/db/repositories/want-box-repository.db.test.ts b/src/db/repositories/want-box-repository.db.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..a0a8fb8d4b5081a6b5a9602023e063907d39b156
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/db/repositories/want-box-repository.db.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,53 @@
+import type { Kysely } from 'kysely';
+import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import { startMigratedDatabase } from '../../../test/support/migrated-db.js';
+import { ASH, WANT_SERVER, WANTED_AT } from '../../../test/support/target-want-cases.js';
+import { wantBoxCases } from '../../../test/support/want-box-cases.js';
+import { fixtureForms } from '../../../test/support/wants.js';
+import type { DB } from '../types.js';
+import { PokemonNotificationRepository } from './pokemon-notification-repository.js';
+import { TargetWantRepository } from './target-want-repository.js';
+import { WantBoxRepository } from './want-box-repository.js';
+
+describe('WantBoxRepository', () => {
+  let stop: () => Promise<void>;
+  let db: Kysely<DB>;
+
+  beforeAll(async () => {
+    ({ db, stop } = await startMigratedDatabase());
+  });
+  afterAll(async () => {
+    await stop();
+  });
+
+  const fresh = async () => {
+    await db.deleteFrom('TargetWant').execute();
+    await db.deleteFrom('PokemonNotification').execute();
+    const forms = fixtureForms();
+    return {
+      boxes: new WantBoxRepository(db, forms),
+      wants: new PokemonNotificationRepository(db, forms),
+      targets: new TargetWantRepository(db),
+    };
+  };
+
+  wantBoxCases(fresh);
+
+  it('runs two Submits of one member one after the other, under the member’s lock', async () => {
+    const { boxes, wants, targets } = await fresh();
+    const dratini = { kind: 'pokemon', dex: 147 } as const;
+    const shown = ['raids', 'research', 'shadow'] as const;
+    await Promise.all([
+      boxes.set(ASH, WANT_SERVER, dratini, new Set(['raids', 'research']), shown, WANTED_AT),
+      boxes.set(ASH, WANT_SERVER, dratini, new Set(['shadow', 'research']), shown, WANTED_AT),
+    ]);
+    // Whichever came last, each table holds what one Submit made: never a mix of rows doubled.
+    const held = await boxes.held(ASH, WANT_SERVER, dratini);
+    expect([
+      ['raids', 'research'],
+      ['research', 'shadow'],
+    ]).toContainEqual([...held].sort());
+    expect((await targets.list(ASH, WANT_SERVER)).wants).toHaveLength(1);
+    expect((await wants.list(ASH, WANT_SERVER)).wants).toHaveLength(1);
+  });
+});
diff --git a/src/db/repositories/want-box-repository.ts b/src/db/repositories/want-box-repository.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..b9909c813d81fc73b545caf23ff2b9fad7e65c46
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/db/repositories/want-box-repository.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,190 @@
+import type { Kysely } from 'kysely';
+import { parseTargetWantToken, targetWantToken } from '../../domain/notify/target-wants.js';
+import {
+  tierCode,
+  type EncodedNotification,
+  type NotificationScope,
+  type NotificationTarget,
+} from '../../domain/pogo/notification-target.js';
+import {
+  baseTarget,
+  heldBoxes,
+  planBoxes,
+  shadowTarget,
+  targetWantsOf,
+  type BoxSubject,
+  type WantBox,
+} from '../../domain/pogo/want-boxes.js';
+import {
+  planSetWant,
+  readWants,
+  rowsOfWant,
+  type FormReader,
+  type WantRow,
+} from '../../domain/pogo/wants.js';
+import { raidTier } from '../../domain/pogo/raid-tier.js';
+import type { DB } from '../types.js';
+import { findMemberInGuild, withMemberLocked, type MemberInGuild } from './member-rows.js';
+import { RowIds } from './row-ids.js';
+import { changeTargetWants } from './target-want-repository.js';
+
+/** What a Submit of `/want`'s dialog changed: the boxes before and after. */
+export interface BoxChange {
+  before: Set<WantBox>;
+  after: Set<WantBox>;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The boxes of `/want`'s dialog over the rows they map onto (plan 8R-1; design 9.1): a subject's
+ * `PokemonNotification` rows (its own, its shadow one) and its `TargetWant` rows. Its twin in
+ * memory is `MemoryWantBoxes` (`test/support/want-boxes.ts`); both run `wantBoxCases`.
+ */
+export interface WantBoxStorage {
+  /**
+   * The boxes a member holds of a subject in a server: the dialog's read, by the keys of both
+   * tables (the member's rows of one Pokédex number or tier, of one set of tokens).
+   */
+  held(memberId: string, guildId: string, subject: BoxSubject): Promise<Set<WantBox>>;
+  /**
+   * Makes the boxes the dialog showed (`shown`) as `ticked`, the others as they are, in one
+   * transaction under the member's lock (`withMemberLocked`); nothing ticked takes them away.
+   * `at` is when, for a `TargetWant` row that is made.
+   */
+  set(
+    memberId: string,
+    guildId: string,
+    subject: BoxSubject,
+    ticked: ReadonlySet<WantBox>,
+    shown: readonly WantBox[],
+    at: number,
+  ): Promise<BoxChange>;
+}
+
+/** The numbers of `PokemonNotification.pokemon` a subject's rows may hold. */
+function numbersOf(subject: BoxSubject): number[] {
+  if (subject.kind === 'pokemon') return [subject.dex];
+  return [false, true].flatMap((shadow) => {
+    const tier = raidTier(subject.level, shadow);
+    const code = tier && tierCode(tier);
+    return code === undefined ? [] : [code];
+  });
+}
+
+/** The `PokemonNotification` and `TargetWant` tables, for the boxes of a subject. */
+export class WantBoxRepository implements WantBoxStorage {
+  /** `forms` reads a stored form (`formReader`); `ids` the process's memory of rows. */
+  constructor(
+    private readonly db: Kysely<DB>,
+    private readonly forms: FormReader,
+    private readonly ids: RowIds = RowIds.none,
+  ) {}
+
+  private async rows(
+    db: Kysely<DB>,
+    member: MemberInGuild,
+    subject: BoxSubject,
+  ): Promise<WantRow[]> {
+    const rows = await db
+      .selectFrom('PokemonNotification')
+      .select(['id', 'pokemon', 'type', 'form', 'shadow'])
+      .where('userId', '=', member.userId)
+      .where('guildId', '=', member.guildId)
+      .where('pokemon', 'in', numbersOf(subject))
+      .orderBy('id')
+      .execute();
+    return rows.map((row) => ({
+      id: row.id,
+      pokemon: row.pokemon ?? 0,
+      type: row.type,
+      form: row.form,
+      shadow: row.shadow !== 0,
+    }));
+  }
+
+  private async tokens(db: Kysely<DB>, member: MemberInGuild, subject: BoxSubject) {
+    const asked = targetWantsOf(subject).map(([, want]) => targetWantToken(want));
+    if (asked.length === 0) return [];
+    const rows = await db
+      .selectFrom('TargetWant')
+      .select('target')
+      .where('guildId', '=', member.guildId)
+      .where('userId', '=', member.userId)
+      .where('target', 'in', asked)
+      .execute();
+    return rows.flatMap((row) => parseTargetWantToken(row.target) ?? []);
+  }
+
+  private async heldIn(db: Kysely<DB>, member: MemberInGuild, subject: BoxSubject) {
+    const rows = await this.rows(db, member, subject);
+    const { wants } = readWants(rows, this.forms);
+    return { rows, held: heldBoxes(subject, wants, await this.tokens(db, member, subject)) };
+  }
+
+  async held(memberId: string, guildId: string, subject: BoxSubject): Promise<Set<WantBox>> {
+    const member = await findMemberInGuild(this.db, memberId, guildId, this.ids);
+    if (!member) return new Set();
+    return (await this.heldIn(this.db, member, subject)).held;
+  }
+
+  set(
+    memberId: string,
+    guildId: string,
+    subject: BoxSubject,
+    ticked: ReadonlySet<WantBox>,
+    shown: readonly WantBox[],
+    at: number,
+  ): Promise<BoxChange> {
+    const adds = shown.some((box) => ticked.has(box));
+    return withMemberLocked(
+      this.db,
+      memberId,
+      guildId,
+      adds,
+      async (trx, member) => {
+        if (!member) return { before: new Set<WantBox>(), after: new Set<WantBox>() };
+        const { rows, held } = await this.heldIn(trx, member, subject);
+        const plan = planBoxes(subject, held, ticked, shown);
+        await this.setRow(trx, member, rows, baseTarget(subject), plan.base);
+        const shadow = shadowTarget(subject);
+        if (shadow) await this.setRow(trx, member, rows, shadow, plan.shadow ? 'raid' : null);
+        await changeTargetWants(trx, member, plan.targets, at);
+        return { before: held, after: plan.after };
+      },
+      this.ids,
+    );
+  }
+
+  /** Makes a target's rows say `scope`, or takes them away for null (as `WantStorage` does). */
+  private async setRow(
+    trx: Kysely<DB>,
+    member: MemberInGuild,
+    rows: readonly WantRow[],
+    target: NotificationTarget,
+    scope: NotificationScope | null,
+  ): Promise<void> {
+    if (scope === null) {
+      const ids = rowsOfWant(rows, target, this.forms);
+      if (ids.length > 0)
+        await trx.deleteFrom('PokemonNotification').where('id', 'in', ids).execute();
+      return;
+    }
+    const plan = planSetWant(rows, target, scope, this.forms);
+    const columns = (values: EncodedNotification) => ({ ...values, shadow: values.shadow ? 1 : 0 });
+    if (plan.insert) {
+      await trx
+        .insertInto('PokemonNotification')
+        .values({ ...columns(plan.insert), userId: member.userId, guildId: member.guildId })
+        .execute();
+    }
+    if (plan.update) {
+      await trx
+        .updateTable('PokemonNotification')
+        .set(columns(plan.update.values))
+        .where('id', '=', plan.update.id)
+        .execute();
+    }
+    if (plan.remove.length > 0) {
+      await trx.deleteFrom('PokemonNotification').where('id', 'in', plan.remove).execute();
+    }
+  }
+}

diff --git a/src/domain/pogo/want-boxes.test.ts b/src/domain/pogo/want-boxes.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..82de9ae9c61ee6b657b8279e10d4ce7aeb3cedc2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/domain/pogo/want-boxes.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,108 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import { boxTarget } from '../notify/target-wants.js';
+import { pokemonTarget, type Want } from './notification-target.js';
+import {
+  heldBoxes,
+  planBoxes,
+  pokemonBoxes,
+  subjectOf,
+  tierBoxes,
+  type BoxFacts,
+  type BoxSubject,
+} from './want-boxes.js';
+
+const DRATINI: BoxSubject = { kind: 'pokemon', dex: 147 };
+const T5: BoxSubject = { kind: 'tier', level: 'T5' };
+
+describe('the boxes of /want’s dialog', () => {
+  it('reads what a member holds from both tables', () => {
+    const wants: Want[] = [
+      { target: pokemonTarget(147), scope: 'both' },
+      { target: pokemonTarget(147, undefined, true), scope: 'raid' },
+      { target: pokemonTarget(148), scope: 'raid' },
+    ];
+    expect([...heldBoxes(DRATINI, wants, [boxTarget('research-pokemon', 147)])].sort()).toEqual([
+      'raids',
+      'research',
+      'shadow',
+      'spawns',
+    ]);
+    // A form is a subject of its own: the species' rows are not its.
+    expect([...heldBoxes({ kind: 'pokemon', dex: 147, form: 'dratini' }, wants, [])]).toEqual([]);
+    const tiers: Want[] = [
+      { target: { kind: 'tier', tier: { level: 'T5', shadow: true } }, scope: 'raid' },
+    ];
+    expect([...heldBoxes(T5, tiers, [])]).toEqual(['shadow-raids']);
+  });
+
+  it('plans the rows a Submit makes, leaving a box the dialog did not show as it was', () => {
+    const plan = planBoxes(
+      DRATINI,
+      new Set(['raids', 'spawns', 'dynamax']),
+      new Set(['raids', 'research']),
+      ['raids', 'dynamax', 'research', 'shadow'],
+    );
+    expect(plan).toEqual({
+      base: 'both',
+      shadow: false,
+      targets: {
+        add: [boxTarget('research-pokemon', 147)],
+        remove: [boxTarget('dynamax', 147)],
+      },
+      after: new Set(['spawns', 'raids', 'research']),
+    });
+    // Nothing ticked: everything shown goes.
+    expect(
+      planBoxes(DRATINI, new Set(['raids', 'shadow']), new Set(), ['raids', 'shadow']),
+    ).toMatchObject({
+      base: null,
+      shadow: false,
+    });
+    expect(
+      planBoxes(T5, new Set(), new Set(['shadow-raids']), ['raids', 'shadow-raids']),
+    ).toMatchObject({
+      base: null,
+      shadow: true,
+    });
+  });
+
+  it('shows only what can happen', () => {
+    const facts = (overrides: Partial<BoxFacts>): BoxFacts => ({
+      entries: [{ kind: 'species', shadow: false, key: 'x' }],
+      wild: () => true,
+      canDynamax: () => false,
+      canGigantamax: () => false,
+      dynamaxListed: false,
+      gigantamaxListed: false,
+      shadowBoss: false,
+      ...overrides,
+    });
+    expect(pokemonBoxes(facts({}))).toEqual(['raids', 'spawns', 'research']);
+    expect(
+      pokemonBoxes(
+        facts({
+          entries: [{ kind: 'species', shadow: true, key: 'machamp' }],
+          canDynamax: () => true,
+          gigantamaxListed: true,
+        }),
+      ),
+    ).toEqual(['raids', 'dynamax', 'gigantamax', 'spawns', 'research', 'shadow']);
+    // A legendary: no spawns; a shadow raid boss now: Shadow.
+    expect(pokemonBoxes(facts({ wild: () => false, shadowBoss: true }))).toEqual([
+      'raids',
+      'research',
+      'shadow',
+    ]);
+    expect(pokemonBoxes(facts({ entries: [{ kind: 'mega', shadow: false, key: 'm' }] }))).toEqual([
+      'raids',
+    ]);
+    expect(tierBoxes('T5')).toEqual(['raids', 'shadow-raids']);
+    expect(tierBoxes('Mega')).toEqual(['raids']);
+  });
+
+  it('takes a shadow want for its Pokémon’s subject, and none of IVs', () => {
+    expect(subjectOf(pokemonTarget(645, undefined, true))).toEqual({ kind: 'pokemon', dex: 645 });
+    expect(subjectOf({ kind: 'tier', tier: { level: 'T5', shadow: true } })).toEqual(T5);
+    expect(subjectOf({ kind: 'iv', iv: 'perfect' })).toBeUndefined();
+  });
+});

+import {
+  boxTarget,
+  sameTargetWant,
+  type PokemonBoxKind,
+  type TargetWant,
+} from '../notify/target-wants.js';
+import type { PokemonCatalogue } from './catalogue.js';
+import type { PokemonEntry } from './game-master.js';
+import { pokemonWantName, speciesNameOf } from './wants.js';
+import {
+  isNotificationTier,
+  pokemonTarget,
+  sameNotificationTarget,
+  type NotificationScope,
+  type NotificationTarget,
+  type Want,
+} from './notification-target.js';
+import { raidTier, type RaidLevel } from './raid-tier.js';
+
+/*
+ * The boxes of `/want`'s dialog (plan 8R-1; design 7, 9.1, Matt's answers 2 and 9): what a
+ * member wants a Pokémon, a form or a raid tier for. They map onto rows of two tables: Raids and
+ * Spawns are the scope of the `PokemonNotification` row (`raid`, `spawn`, `both`; `raid` means
+ * raids only from now on), Shadow is its shadow row (shadow raids and, with plan 8R-2, Team GO
+ * Rocket catches), Research, Dynamax and Gigantamax are `TargetWant` rows; a tier's two boxes are
+ * its row and its shadow tier's. Pure.
+ */
+
+/** The boxes of a Pokémon or a form, in the dialog's order. */
+export const POKEMON_BOXES = [
+  'raids',
+  'dynamax',
+  'gigantamax',
+  'spawns',
+  'research',
+  'shadow',
+] as const;
+export type PokemonBox = (typeof POKEMON_BOXES)[number];
+
+/** The boxes of a raid tier. */
+export const TIER_BOXES = ['raids', 'shadow-raids'] as const;
+export type TierBox = (typeof TIER_BOXES)[number];
+
+export type WantBox = PokemonBox | TierBox;
+
+/** What a dialog is about: a Pokémon (a species, or one form: its catalogue key), or a tier. */
+export type BoxSubject =
+  { kind: 'pokemon'; dex: number; form?: string } | { kind: 'tier'; level: RaidLevel };
+
+/** The boxes as members read them. */
+export const BOX_WORDS: Readonly<Record<WantBox, string>> = {
+  raids: 'Raids',
+  dynamax: 'Dynamax',
+  gigantamax: 'Gigantamax',
+  spawns: 'Spawns',
+  research: 'Research',
+  shadow: 'Shadow',
+  'shadow-raids': 'Shadow raids',
+};
+
+/** What a box of a Pokémon says under its name in the dialog. */
+export const BOX_DESCRIPTIONS: Readonly<Record<PokemonBox, string>> = {
+  raids: 'Its raids and the eggs it hatches from',
+  dynamax: 'Its Dynamax max battles, 1 to 5 stars',
+  gigantamax: 'Its Gigantamax max battles',
+  spawns: 'Wild ones reported with /wild',
+  research: 'Field research that may reward it',
+  shadow: 'Shadow raids and Team GO Rocket catches',
+};
+
+/** The subject a want is part of: a Pokémon's or a tier's (its shadow want too); none for IVs. */
+export function subjectOf(target: NotificationTarget): BoxSubject | undefined {
+  if (target.kind === 'pokemon') {
+    return target.form === undefined
+      ? { kind: 'pokemon', dex: target.dex }
+      : { kind: 'pokemon', dex: target.dex, form: target.form };
+  }
+  if (target.kind === 'tier') return { kind: 'tier', level: target.tier.level };
+  return undefined;
+}
+
+/** The subject of a `TargetWant` that is a box of a Pokémon (Research, Dynamax, Gigantamax). */
+export function subjectOfTarget(want: TargetWant): BoxSubject | undefined {
+  if (want.kind === 'research-item' || want.kind === 'research-energy') return undefined;
+  return want.form === undefined
+    ? { kind: 'pokemon', dex: want.dex }
+    : { kind: 'pokemon', dex: want.dex, form: want.form };
+}
+
+/** Whether two subjects are one. */
+export function sameSubject(a: BoxSubject, b: BoxSubject): boolean {
+  if (a.kind === 'tier') return b.kind === 'tier' && a.level === b.level;
+  return b.kind === 'pokemon' && a.dex === b.dex && a.form === b.form;
+}
+
+/** The subject's own want: the Pokémon or form in raids and spawns, or the tier's. */
+export function baseTarget(subject: BoxSubject): NotificationTarget {
+  if (subject.kind === 'pokemon') return pokemonTarget(subject.dex, subject.form);
+  const tier = raidTier(subject.level, false);
+  if (!tier) throw new Error(`no tier ${subject.level}`);
+  return { kind: 'tier', tier };
+}
+
+/** The subject's shadow want; undefined for a tier without shadow raids. */
+export function shadowTarget(subject: BoxSubject): NotificationTarget | undefined {
+  if (subject.kind === 'pokemon') return pokemonTarget(subject.dex, subject.form, true);
+  const tier = raidTier(subject.level, true);
+  return tier && isNotificationTier(tier) ? { kind: 'tier', tier } : undefined;
+}
+
+const TARGET_BOXES: readonly [PokemonBox, PokemonBoxKind][] = [
+  ['research', 'research-pokemon'],
+  ['dynamax', 'dynamax'],
+  ['gigantamax', 'gigantamax'],
+];
+
+/** The `TargetWant` rows of a Pokémon's boxes, by box. */
+export function targetWantsOf(subject: BoxSubject): [PokemonBox, TargetWant][] {
+  if (subject.kind !== 'pokemon') return [];
+  return TARGET_BOXES.map(([box, kind]) => [box, boxTarget(kind, subject.dex, subject.form)]);
+}
+
+/** The boxes a member has ticked, as their rows say: what pre-ticks the dialog. */
+export function heldBoxes(
+  subject: BoxSubject,
+  wants: readonly Want[],
+  targets: readonly TargetWant[],
+): Set<WantBox> {
+  const held = new Set<WantBox>();
+  const base = wants.find((want) => sameNotificationTarget(want.target, baseTarget(subject)));
+  const shadow = shadowTarget(subject);
+  const shadowHeld =
+    shadow !== undefined && wants.some((want) => sameNotificationTarget(want.target, shadow));
+  if (base?.scope === 'raid' || base?.scope === 'both') held.add('raids');
+  if (subject.kind === 'tier') {
+    if (shadowHeld) held.add('shadow-raids');
+    return held;
+  }
+  if (base?.scope === 'spawn' || base?.scope === 'both') held.add('spawns');
+  if (shadowHeld) held.add('shadow');
+  for (const [box, want] of targetWantsOf(subject)) {
+    if (targets.some((one) => sameTargetWant(one, want))) held.add(box);
+  }
+  return held;
+}
+
+/** What the rows of a subject become (`planBoxes`). */
+export interface BoxPlan {
+  /** The scope of the subject's own row; null for none (the row goes). */
+  base: NotificationScope | null;
+  /** Whether its shadow row stands. */
+  shadow: boolean;
+  /** The `TargetWant` rows to add and to remove. */
+  targets: { add: TargetWant[]; remove: TargetWant[] };
+  /** The boxes ticked after the change. */
+  after: Set<WantBox>;
+}
+
+/**
+ * What a dialog's Submit makes of a subject's rows: the boxes it showed (`shown`) as ticked, and
+ * every other box as it was (a box the dialog did not show, such as a spawn want of a Pokémon
+ * that is no longer met in the wild, is left alone).
+ */
+export function planBoxes(
+  subject: BoxSubject,
+  held: ReadonlySet<WantBox>,
+  ticked: ReadonlySet<WantBox>,
+  shown: readonly WantBox[],
+): BoxPlan {
+  const after = new Set<WantBox>(
+    [...held].filter((box) => !shown.includes(box)).concat(shown.filter((box) => ticked.has(box))),
+  );
+  const raids = after.has('raids');
+  const spawns = after.has('spawns');
+  const base: NotificationScope | null =
+    raids && spawns ? 'both' : raids ? 'raid' : spawns ? 'spawn' : null;
+  const shadow = after.has(subject.kind === 'tier' ? 'shadow-raids' : 'shadow');
+  const add: TargetWant[] = [];
+  const remove: TargetWant[] = [];
+  for (const [box, want] of targetWantsOf(subject)) {
+    if (after.has(box) && !held.has(box)) add.push(want);
+    if (!after.has(box) && held.has(box)) remove.push(want);
+  }
+  return { base, shadow, targets: { add, remove }, after };
+}
+
+/** What decides which boxes a Pokémon's dialog shows. */
+export interface BoxFacts {
+  /** The subject's entries: every entry of a species, the one of a form. */
+  entries: readonly Pick<PokemonEntry, 'kind' | 'shadow' | 'key'>[];
+  /** Whether an entry is met in the wild (`appearsInWild` with the settings' exceptions). */
+  wild: (entry: Pick<PokemonEntry, 'kind' | 'shadow' | 'key'>) => boolean;
+  /** Whether the game master says it can Dynamax / Gigantamax (`catalogue.canDynamax`). */
+  canDynamax: (entry: Pick<PokemonEntry, 'key'>) => boolean;
+  canGigantamax: (entry: Pick<PokemonEntry, 'key'>) => boolean;
+  /** Whether the max boss list has it at a Dynamax tier, at G. */
+  dynamaxListed: boolean;
+  gigantamaxListed: boolean;
+  /** Whether it is a shadow raid boss now. */
+  shadowBoss: boolean;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The boxes a Pokémon's dialog shows (design 7: only what can happen): Raids always; Dynamax
+ * and Gigantamax where the game master has it so or the max boss list does; Spawns where it is
+ * met in the wild; Research for anything but a mega; Shadow where the game master says it can be
+ * a shadow or it is a shadow raid boss now (8R-2 adds today's Rocket lineups). A mega: Raids only.
+ */
+export function pokemonBoxes(facts: BoxFacts): PokemonBox[] {
+  const { entries } = facts;
+  if (entries.length > 0 && entries.every((entry) => entry.kind === 'mega')) return ['raids'];
+  const any = (test: (entry: BoxFacts['entries'][number]) => boolean): boolean =>
+    entries.some(test);
+  const shown = new Set<PokemonBox>(['raids']);
+  if (facts.dynamaxListed || any(facts.canDynamax)) shown.add('dynamax');
+  if (facts.gigantamaxListed || any(facts.canGigantamax)) shown.add('gigantamax');
+  if (any(facts.wild)) shown.add('spawns');
+  if (any((entry) => entry.kind !== 'mega')) shown.add('research');
+  if (facts.shadowBoss || any((entry) => entry.kind !== 'mega' && entry.shadow))
+    shown.add('shadow');
+  return POKEMON_BOXES.filter((box) => shown.has(box));
+}
+
+/** An item's name made of its key, where the list does not name it: `rare-candy` is Rare Candy. */
+export function itemNameOf(key: string): string {
+  return key
+    .split('-')
+    .map((word) => word.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + word.slice(1))
+    .join(' ');
+}
+
+/**
+ * What a `TargetWant` is called in a list, an answer and a direct message: `Dratini (research)`,
+ * `Rare Candy (research)`, `Charizard Mega Energy (research)`, `Dynamax Machamp`, `Gigantamax
+ * Machamp`; a Pokémon as `pokemonWantName` names it (`(every form)` for a species of several).
+ * `items` names an item as the task list does (else `itemNameOf`). Not made plain here.
+ */
+export function targetWantLabel(
+  catalogue: PokemonCatalogue,
+  want: TargetWant,
+  items: ReadonlyMap<string, string> = new Map(),
+): string {
+  switch (want.kind) {
+    case 'research-item':
+      return `${items.get(want.item) ?? itemNameOf(want.item)} (research)`;
+    case 'research-energy':
+      return `${speciesNameOf(catalogue, want.dex) ?? `Pokémon #${String(want.dex)}`} Mega Energy (research)`;
+    case 'research-pokemon':
+      return `${pokemonWantName(catalogue, pokemonTarget(want.dex, want.form), { everyForm: true })} (research)`;
+    case 'dynamax':
+      return `Dynamax ${pokemonWantName(catalogue, pokemonTarget(want.dex, want.form))}`;
+    case 'gigantamax':
+      return `Gigantamax ${pokemonWantName(catalogue, pokemonTarget(want.dex, want.form))}`;
+  }
+}
+
+/** The boxes a tier's dialog shows: Raids, and Shadow raids where the tier has shadow raids. */
+export function tierBoxes(level: RaidLevel): TierBox[] {
+  const shadow = raidTier(level, true);
+  return shadow && isNotificationTier(shadow) ? ['raids', 'shadow-raids'] : ['raids'];
+}

+import { expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import type { WantBoxStorage } from '../../src/db/repositories/want-box-repository.js';
+import type { TargetWantStorage } from '../../src/db/repositories/target-want-repository.js';
+import type { WantStorage } from '../../src/db/repositories/pokemon-notification-repository.js';
+import { boxTarget } from '../../src/domain/notify/target-wants.js';
+import { pokemonTarget } from '../../src/domain/pogo/notification-target.js';
+import type { BoxSubject } from '../../src/domain/pogo/want-boxes.js';
+import { ASH, GARY, WANT_SERVER, WANTED_AT } from './target-want-cases.js';
+
+const DRATINI: BoxSubject = { kind: 'pokemon', dex: 147 };
+const ALOLAN_VULPIX: BoxSubject = { kind: 'pokemon', dex: 37, form: 'vulpix_alola' };
+const T5: BoxSubject = { kind: 'tier', level: 'T5' };
+const EVERY = ['raids', 'dynamax', 'gigantamax', 'spawns', 'research', 'shadow'] as const;
+
+/** A store of boxes over these tables, fresh and empty, as the cases need it. */
+export interface BoxTables {
+  boxes: WantBoxStorage;
+  wants: WantStorage;
+  targets: TargetWantStorage;
+}
+
+/**
+ * What the boxes of `/want`'s dialog do to the rows of both tables, run against the repository
+ * and its twin in memory alike.
+ */
+export function wantBoxCases(made: () => Promise<BoxTables>): void {
+  it('writes the ticked boxes into both tables and reads them back', async () => {
+    const { boxes, wants, targets } = await made();
+    const change = await boxes.set(
+      ASH,
+      WANT_SERVER,
+      DRATINI,
+      new Set(['raids', 'research', 'shadow']),
+      EVERY,
+      WANTED_AT,
+    );
+    expect(change).toEqual({ before: new Set(), after: new Set(['raids', 'research', 'shadow']) });
+    expect(await boxes.held(ASH, WANT_SERVER, DRATINI)).toEqual(
+      new Set(['raids', 'research', 'shadow']),
+    );
+    expect((await wants.list(ASH, WANT_SERVER)).wants).toEqual([
+      { target: pokemonTarget(147), scope: 'raid' },
+      { target: pokemonTarget(147, undefined, true), scope: 'raid' },
+    ]);
+    expect((await targets.list(ASH, WANT_SERVER)).wants).toEqual([
+      boxTarget('research-pokemon', 147),
+    ]);
+    expect(await boxes.held(GARY, WANT_SERVER, DRATINI)).toEqual(new Set());
+  });
+
+  it('changes what a later Submit changes, and takes everything away with nothing ticked', async () => {
+    const { boxes, wants, targets } = await made();
+    await boxes.set(ASH, WANT_SERVER, DRATINI, new Set(['raids', 'dynamax']), EVERY, WANTED_AT);
+    await boxes.set(ASH, WANT_SERVER, DRATINI, new Set(['spawns', 'raids']), EVERY, WANTED_AT);
+    expect((await wants.list(ASH, WANT_SERVER)).wants).toEqual([
+      { target: pokemonTarget(147), scope: 'both' },
+    ]);
+    expect((await targets.list(ASH, WANT_SERVER)).wants).toEqual([]);
+    const gone = await boxes.set(ASH, WANT_SERVER, DRATINI, new Set(), EVERY, WANTED_AT);
+    expect(gone).toEqual({ before: new Set(['raids', 'spawns']), after: new Set() });
+    expect(await wants.count(ASH, WANT_SERVER)).toBe(0);
+  });
+
+  it('leaves the boxes it did not show as they are, and a form apart from its species', async () => {
+    const { boxes, wants } = await made();
+    await wants.set(ASH, WANT_SERVER, pokemonTarget(147), 'spawn');
+    await boxes.set(ASH, WANT_SERVER, DRATINI, new Set(['raids']), ['raids', 'shadow'], WANTED_AT);
+    expect((await wants.list(ASH, WANT_SERVER)).wants).toEqual([
+      { target: pokemonTarget(147), scope: 'both' },
+    ]);
+    await boxes.set(ASH, WANT_SERVER, ALOLAN_VULPIX, new Set(['gigantamax']), EVERY, WANTED_AT);
+    expect(await boxes.held(ASH, WANT_SERVER, ALOLAN_VULPIX)).toEqual(new Set(['gigantamax']));
+    expect(await boxes.held(ASH, WANT_SERVER, { kind: 'pokemon', dex: 37 })).toEqual(new Set());
+  });
+
+  it('writes a tier’s raids and its shadow raids', async () => {
+    const { boxes, wants } = await made();
+    await boxes.set(
+      ASH,
+      WANT_SERVER,
+      T5,
+      new Set(['shadow-raids']),
+      ['raids', 'shadow-raids'],
+      WANTED_AT,
+    );
+    expect((await wants.list(ASH, WANT_SERVER)).wants).toEqual([
+      { target: { kind: 'tier', tier: { level: 'T5', shadow: true } }, scope: 'raid' },
+    ]);
+    expect(await boxes.held(ASH, WANT_SERVER, T5)).toEqual(new Set(['shadow-raids']));
+  });
+}

new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..5945c8f19455e9a8283326c5fc4283611e0dd951
--- /dev/null
+++ b/test/support/want-boxes.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,59 @@
+import type { BoxChange, WantBoxStorage } from '../../src/db/repositories/want-box-repository.js';
+import {
+  baseTarget,
+  heldBoxes,
+  planBoxes,
+  shadowTarget,
+  targetWantsOf,
+  type BoxSubject,
+  type WantBox,
+} from '../../src/domain/pogo/want-boxes.js';
+import type { TargetWantStorage } from '../../src/db/repositories/target-want-repository.js';
+import type { WantStorage } from '../../src/db/repositories/pokemon-notification-repository.js';
+import { MemoryTargetWants } from './target-wants.js';
+import { MemoryWants } from './wants.js';
+
+/**
+ * The boxes of `/want`'s dialog in memory: the twin of `WantBoxRepository` over the wants and
+ * the target wants of a test (`wants`, `targets`, which a test reads), running `wantBoxCases`
+ * as it does. It writes one table after the other (nothing here can fail half-way but a
+ * `failing` of either).
+ */
+export class MemoryWantBoxes implements WantBoxStorage {
+  constructor(
+    readonly wants: WantStorage = new MemoryWants(),
+    readonly targets: TargetWantStorage = new MemoryTargetWants(),
+  ) {}
+
+  async held(memberId: string, guildId: string, subject: BoxSubject): Promise<Set<WantBox>> {
+    const { wants } = await this.wants.list(memberId, guildId);
+    const targets = await this.targets.of(
+      memberId,
+      guildId,
+      targetWantsOf(subject).map(([, want]) => want),
+    );
+    return heldBoxes(subject, wants, targets);
+  }
+
+  async set(
+    memberId: string,
+    guildId: string,
+    subject: BoxSubject,
+    ticked: ReadonlySet<WantBox>,
+    shown: readonly WantBox[],
+    at: number,
+  ): Promise<BoxChange> {
+    const held = await this.held(memberId, guildId, subject);
+    const plan = planBoxes(subject, held, ticked, shown);
+    const base = baseTarget(subject);
+    if (plan.base === null) await this.wants.remove(memberId, guildId, base);
+    else await this.wants.set(memberId, guildId, base, plan.base);
+    const shadow = shadowTarget(subject);
+    if (shadow) {
+      if (plan.shadow) await this.wants.set(memberId, guildId, shadow, 'raid');
+      else await this.wants.remove(memberId, guildId, shadow);
+    }
+    await this.targets.change(memberId, guildId, plan.targets, at);
+    return { before: held, after: plan.after };
+  }
+}

### Task 8: 8R-1 task 8: research wants and their DMs

Prototype commit: `909136f00281d3e8bd4358aa87515e0baae22a7f`

Who wants a reward of a reported task (a Pokémon's Research box, an item,
Mega Energy: researchTargets and researchWantsFiring over TargetWant) is
told at the normal priority (NotifyService.researchReported, from the stop
report service's listener): one DM per report and region channel, naming
the report's stops there with their addresses, the rewards ("one of" where
one is drawn) and until when; only members who can view the region
channel, never the reporter, only under features.notifications. The DM
ends with the report and links to the message of the pinned post that
holds the task (StopPostService.messageOf: the post's layout says which
message holds each task; the channel's waiting change is drawn first,
Gathered.flushKey); no link in rehearsal mode.

A member told of a task at a stop in a period is not told of it there
again (in memory, by server, member, period, task and stop): "Same task at
more stops…" sends a second DM naming only the new stops. An announcement
may now vary per member beyond its reasons (variant).

+/**
+ * The targets a want for a research task's rewards may be stored under (`TargetWant`; plan 8R-1,
+ * design 7): each encounter's species and its own entry, each item, each species' Mega Energy.
+ * What `TargetWantStorage.wanting` is asked for. A reward the game data does not know has none.
+ */
+export function researchTargets(rewards: readonly TaskReward[]): TargetWant[] {
+  const targets: TargetWant[] = [];
+  const add = (want: TargetWant): void => {
+    if (!targets.some((known) => targetWantToken(known) === targetWantToken(want)))
+      targets.push(want);
+  };
+  for (const reward of rewards) {
+    if (reward.kind === 'encounter' && reward.dex !== null && reward.key !== null) {
+      add(boxTarget('research-pokemon', reward.dex));
+      add(boxTarget('research-pokemon', reward.dex, reward.key));
+    } else if (reward.kind === 'item') {
+      add({ kind: 'research-item', item: reward.item });
+    } else if (reward.kind === 'energy' && reward.dex !== null) {
+      add({ kind: 'research-energy', dex: reward.dex });
+    }
+  }
+  return targets;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Those of a member's targets a research task may reward (design 7, "Matching"): a Pokémon's
+ * Research box that fits one of its encounters (`pokemonWantFits`: the species in any form, the
+ * one form), an item it gives (whatever the quantity), the Mega Energy of a species it gives.
+ */
+export function researchWantsFiring(
+  catalogue: Pick<PokemonCatalogue, 'byKey'>,
+  wants: readonly TargetWant[],
+  rewards: readonly TaskReward[],
+): TargetWant[] {
+  return wants.filter((want) => {
+    switch (want.kind) {
+      case 'research-pokemon':
+        return rewards.some(
+          (reward) =>
+            reward.kind === 'encounter' &&
+            reward.dex !== null &&
+            reward.key !== null &&
+            pokemonWantFits(
+              catalogue,
+              pokemonTarget(want.dex, want.form),
+              { dex: reward.dex, key: reward.key },
+              false,
+            ),
+        );
+      case 'research-item':
+        return rewards.some((reward) => reward.kind === 'item' && reward.item === want.item);
+      case 'research-energy':
+        return rewards.some((reward) => reward.kind === 'energy' && reward.dex === want.dex);
+      default:
+        return false;
+    }
+  });
+}
+
 /** A reported wild Pokémon as far as wants are matched against it. */
 export interface SpawnSighting {
   /** The catalogue entry that was reported. */

+/** How many stops a direct message about research names; the rest are counted. */
+const DM_STOPS_SHOWN = 10;
+
+/**
+ * The first line of a direct message about field research (plan 8R-1; design 7): where it was
+ * reported and by whom, and the task. Everything in it through `plainNoLinks` (it reaches other
+ * members' DMs).
+ */
+export function researchDmSentence(view: {
+  research: Pick<ResearchDetail, 'text'>;
+  regionChannelId: string;
+  reporter: NamedMember;
+}): string {
+  return (
+    `Field research has been reported in <#${view.regionChannelId}> by ` +
+    `**${memberName(view.reporter)}**: **${plainNoLinks(truncate(view.research.text, 120))}**.`
+  );

+/**
+ * Field research in brief, for a direct message (`notifyDm`): the rewards ("one of" where one is
+ * drawn), a line per stop with its address (ten at most, the rest counted) and until when
+ * (`periodEndWords`: the day too when it is not today, review B7), with the first reward's
+ * picture and the colour of research.
+ */
+export function researchDmBrief(view: {
+  research: Pick<ResearchDetail, 'rewards'>;
+  stops: readonly Pick<ReportedStop, 'name' | 'address'>[];
+  /** When the reports end, as a sentence ends (`periodEndWords`). */
+  until: string;
+}): { accent: number; picture?: string; lines: string[] } {
+  const { rewards } = view.research;

+  const stops = view.stops.slice(0, DM_STOPS_SHOWN).map((stop) => {
+    const name = `**${plainNoLinks(truncate(stop.name, 80))}**`;
+    return stop.address === null
+      ? `- ${name}`
+      : `- ${name} · ${plainNoLinks(truncate(stop.address, 80))}`;
+  });
+  const more = view.stops.length - DM_STOPS_SHOWN;
+  const { until } = view;
+  return {
+    accent: RESEARCH_COLOUR,
+    ...(picture === undefined ? {} : { picture }),
+    lines: [
+      ...(short === '' ? [] : [`**Rewards** ${rewards.length === 1 ? short : `one of ${short}`}`]),
+      ...stops,
+      ...(more > 0 ? [`- …and ${count(more, 'more stop')}`] : []),
+      `${until.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}${until.slice(1)}.`,
+    ],
+  };
+}

+  /**
+   * Sends what waits for one key without waiting for its delay, and waits until that key's
+   * messages are out: for a caller that needs the message as it stands now (a DM that links to
+   * the post of the stops, plan 8R-1). Other keys keep their delay.
+   */
+  async flushKey(key: string): Promise<void> {
+    while (this.waiting.has(key) || this.due.has(key)) {
+      this.now(key);
+      // Behind everything of the key in its chain: what was due has gone out by then.
+      await this.chain.run(key, () => Promise.resolve());
+    }
+  }
